Review: So easy and the family loved it!!!  I would rate it six stars if I could
Awesome recipe, very easy to make and DELICIOUS!

Excellent!!  Easy to make, and so delicious!  Everyone had seconds and thirds.  We're definitely keeping this recipe!  I did add minced garlic to the melting butter, and also added a few dashes of nutmeg, which I think is a must for alfredo sauce.  Thanks for sharing!

Very excellent recipe. So much smoother, creamier, and easier than other alfredo recipes I've tried. I did make a few of my own adjustments; I used 1 cup of cream and 1 cup of milk like a few others suggested, I used nutmeg instead of garlic powder and pepper, and used parmesean and romano cheeses. It was so luxurious, and reheats slightly better than some homemade sauces. Great for tossing with pasta or more substantial items like meat and veggies. Definately a keeper!
Just made mines with fat free cream cheese, low fat butter, and fat free half & half. The best and easiest pasta I have ever made. Thank you for this awsome recipe!
Great sauce & pretty darn quick & easy!

I've made this twice now and the second time I discovered what it needed. The first time I tried adding some basil and oregano - that was delicious and beautifully creamy, but it still tasted a little weak. The second time I added that, some extra parmesan, two more teaspoons garlic powder and a teaspoon of cornstarch - and it did the trick. Fabulous.

Instead of adding garlic powder I sautéed 1 small chopped onion for 7-8 mins in the butter. I only used a 1/2 stick of butter instead of the whole stick. After 5 mins I added 4 crushed garlic cloves to the sautéed butter and onions. Then after whisking all the cheeses and milk together I added a lg. bag of frozen organic peas. I used tortellini for the pasta. Yummy
Fabulous and easy!!

I had a similar recipe in a church cookbook so this was exactly what I was looking for. I love it with the cream cheese...we add sauteed mushrooms and peas Delish! Made exactly as directed took a while to thicken.

Ah, cream cheese... I ate a white pizza the other day made by my neighbor's BFF in which she used this sauce. I loved it, so I tried it on a few of my own pizzas. Topped one with Italian sausage crumbles. The other pizza got grilled chicken and blanched broccoli florets. Husband was not crazy about sauce, but he has a cream cheese mental block. I thought it was totally great on the pizzas. The recipe was so easy to make and turned out thick and creamy just like everyone said it would. I used about 2 cups finely shredded Parmigiano Reggiano and it made the sauce more tangy and flavorful. The sauce also needed salt and onion powder, and I didn't use all the milk.

This sauce is outstanding. I love Alfredo and have tried every package and jarred kind I can find, and this beats them all hands down. It keeps very well in the refrigerator and works great for a quick dinner for kids.
It is very good.   I used minced garlic and low fat cream cheese.   Serving size very large, I got two meals out of  1 serving.
Awesome stuff!
I have made this recipe several times, and we LOVE it!!  Super quick and easy!
This sauce is very good!  However, it can be a bit overpowering if you like to drench you noodles, just be sure to have bread/rolls as well.  Either way, I would call it a keeper!

Absolutely loved this recipe! Made it exactly as it was, and it came out perfect. I thought this alfredo sauce tasted better than Olive Garden. Even leftover sauce was super yummy! Will definitely make again!!
Quick and delicoous

Instead of using garlic powder I used real garlic (2 cloves) and grated it up. I also substituted some shredded mozzarella cheese for some of the parmesan since I had the Kraft stuff and didn't want to use it all up. I did't measure it but went by consistency of the sauce. I thought it was delicious and my family enjoyed it too. Much much tastier than the sauce from jars. After I finished making the sauce I added a few big hand fulls of spinach, grilled chicken, and roasted red pepper (brushed with oil and put on the BBQ). Would have added mushrooms but didn't have any around.

Very very good! My sister and I loved this recipe. I added a few things to make it even better. I cut up 2 small chicken breasts, I added a small container of fresh mushrooms and then used about half of a small onion in tiny pieces and fried it all together. Then while boiling the pasta I added some frozen broccoli florets to the water. It truly tasted like something from a fine restaurant. I had a lot left over so I put it all in a large bowl and in the fridge. I honestly didn't expect it to heat up well the next day but I microwaved it and it was just as good  as the night before. Very creamy and no milk needed.  Cant ask for a easier Alfredo sauce!

After making this, I would never buy jar sauce again!  The flavor was incredible!  The only change I made was to use 4 cloves of real garlic because we love garlic!  Very easy and quick to make.  A definite keeper!
So good but so unhealthy! Lmao! This was quick and easy. love it.

I looked this recipe up at the last minute. It was a great base recipe. I did add other seasonings to create more flavor, but it was easy, quick, and I had everything to make it. Will use again, but with less butter or other substitute.

Super yummy and couldn't be simpler!  I scaled it for 1 person; two of us split it over our side of fettuccini. Used half & half I had on hand (instead of milk); a garlic clove minced (instead of powder); & a pinch of nutmeg, as others suggested. Delicioso!
my son and I love alfredo sauce, I could not beleive how easy this was.  I gave it 4 stars because the cheese made it a little salty.  Next time I will not use as much, but I loved it.
I loved this recipe. Very Yummy!

I have fixed this multiple times and can never get it to thicken and I followed the directions exactly. However, the flavor more than makes up for it being a bit runny. We just eat it with a spoon! :)
Very quick and easy to make, I love to make this in my veggie lasagna. It makes it taste unbelievable.

Excellent...I was a bit leary at first but it turned out beautifully!

I did add fresh garlic and parsley!

This is a must recipe!  Loved it!
Wonderful! Absolutely positively wonderful. So simple and delicious. Will definately be using this for many other pasta dishes.
Just as it is titled, very quick and very easy.

I gave this 4 stars because it makes a great base sauce but needs help to make it an awesome sauce. I doubled this sauce for two adults and three children( we like left overs). Besides what the basic list of ingredients I added 2 cups of heavy whipping creme, 6 small to medium sized gloves of garlic finely minced, 2 sticks of unsalted butter, and a cup of finely grated Parmesan cheese. I also added a teaspoon of cilantro, oregano, Mediterranean basil. overall the family loved the sauce.
Really good and fast! I made with the tantalizing turkey and blue cheese meatballs from this site and it was delicious. Will definitely make again!

While there is nothing quite like authentic homemade alfredo, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight meal. It's so quick and delicious! I try to use roasted garlic, if I have time, and more parm cheese. I also add chicken or seafood and broccoli.

This is a family favourite - my kids like it better than what they get at a restaurant we frequent on birthdays. I can get home from work and have it whipped up from scratch in less than 1/2 hour :) Fantastic, delicious and easy!

An excellent, quick alfredo sauce.  Adjust the amount of cream cheese to your personal tastes, and the result will be a perfect alfredo sauce!  I use about 4 oz. cream cheese with 6 oz. parmesan.  Also, I mellow out the flavor with a small handful of shredded mozzarella.  Don't add too much or your sauce WILL turn rubbery. Very, very tasty!!
This recipe is very good. I had a lot of fun with it. I ended up running out of parmesean so I halved it and put in mozzerella with it. It made it very cheesy.

For taste, this was terrific.  But what do you expect from butter, cream cheese and milk mixed with garlic salt?  I sampled just a wee bit and it was phenomenal.  That said, I just couldn't bring myself to eat more than a teaspoon on account of the guilt.  Husband LOVED it!!
This recipe is sooooo good and easy to make. My 3yr old daughter and husband love it. Thank you
This was quick and easy but I found the sauce to be really thick and heavy.
Amazing and easy!  It had great flavor and so easy to make!  I always use fresh pharm when making alfredo.
We used this for a pizza sauce and it was delicious.  Instead of garlic powder we used minced garlic, and lots of it.  Very creamy.
Just like the title says..."quick and easy"...and really good.  Served it over angel hair pasta.  Will try again with chicken and broccoli.  Thank you for the post!

This is a really good, and really easy sauce to make.  I used skim milk and reduced fat cream cheese and the taste was excellent.  The Parmesan did not melt completely.  I might try cooking a bit longer next time.  I recommend that you add 1/8 tsp. of nutmeg.

This is the recipe I lost 2 years ago.  Or darn close to it.     Darn darn good.    Thanks.  We love it.   Added chopped cooked chicken and it was such a delicious sauce.   Add a salad and garlic bread.  Yum yum!!!!!!!

I just made this and it tastes wonderful. The sauce is done before the pasta that tells you how fast and easy it is to make. I will be making this again.I followed a few of the suggestions by using minced garlic and 1 1/3 cup of milk. Thank you for sharing your recipe.
Love this recipe because all of the ingredients are what we always have on hand!  The kids love it - easy and delicious.

This recipe is incredible.  I have worked with Chefs in the past and this is on the same calibur as the Chefs!  My entire family loved it!

HINT!!!  If you want CREAMIER sauce, use 2 Cups of Heavy Cream instead of milk.
This is the best Alfredo sauce I've ever made!!  I made it for our 2 month wedding anniversary and my husband loved it!!  Thank you!!

This did not turn out as good as I had hoped it would.  I could not get it to thicken, no matter how long I let it sit.  I finally had to add a flour/water mixture to get it to thicken, and then it got too thick, and I had to thin it!  I also thought it was too bland, and had to add extra garlic powder, salt and pepper.  I also feel 1/2 cup of butter is too much.  Not sure if I will make this again.  If I do, I will cut down on the butter, and add some extras to the recipe as suggested by other reviewers.

This was very easy sauce to prepare.  It tasted great!  I added it to rotini, ham and peas ..... it was a great meal that my husband and I loved.  The picky daughter loved it and the son who loves everything was not very enthusiastic about his meal.  Just goes to show that you can't please everyone!  Thanks I will use this recipe again.

Cook/Chef
Smith Family :)
What a great way to use cream cheese.  This was really good, really fast and I doctored it up the way my family likes.  I will keep this trick in my back pocket for quick thick sauces.

This was good, my husband loved it so much that he had seconds. However I felt that this was missing something, it tasted a little bland. It probably needed more parmessan cheese or salt, not sure? I used fresh garlic instead of garlic powder which made the sauce smell really good, other that that I used about 1 1/2 cups of milk and added the oregano and nutmeg as suggested. I will make this again. Thanks for sharing.

This was wonderful!! I followed the recipe EXACTLY except that I added some parsley and a pinch of basil. My husband pan-seared chicken strips in an Italian seasoning blend and it was the perfect compliment to the sauce. Much better than store bought, and almost as good as Olive Garden at a fraction of the cost!. Make sure you add the milk AND Parmesan cheese very slowly. I will definitely make this again.

This was a very simple recipe that turned out great!  I loved the idea of using cream cheese.  I made this sauce to go on a pizza, and it was a little runny... I might hold back on the milk next time to give it a little thicker consistency.  The taste was great!  I added 1/8 tsp of white pepper along with the black which gave it a little extra punch.  I will definitely be using this recipe again in the future.

This recipe would be hard to beat...and of course, you can add ANYTHING to the top (though unnecessary, it's great as the recipe reads) - broccoli, bacon pieces, sauteed mushrooms...goes on and on. Very good. Thank you.
I use fresh garlic instead of powder. Perfect consistency and taste.
This was a fast, better than average alfredo sauce. I am a alfredo snob. Thank you for sharing, this is great for a quick meal throw together. Thank you Dawn

YAY! I made this as a sauce for shrimp pasta (I went a little heavy on the garlic because we love it) and it was PERFECT. Much, much better than store bought. Mine turned out thinner than expected, but I'm glad it did. Not too thick and heavy...just creamy and delicious! Safe to say I'm now an alfredo sauce eater!
very,very,very good.Its makes a lot so I passed it on everyone love it.

Wow this was delicious.  And fairly easy to make, once I got past My own mistakes and faulty cookware.  Will definitely make this again (and again)!

I have to recommend using whole milk and real butter; that's actually in most recipes but particularly in one such as this one, where those ingredients are so important.  Also, if you have the time/energy/equipment, I cannot tell you how superior freshly grated Parmesan cheese is to the store bought Kraft stuff.  The difference is very pronounced.

I made a double batch and used one 8-oz wedge of Parmesan.  I also slightly reduced the amount of milk (I didn't actually MEAN to do that, but the container I put the milk in before adding it to the pot leaked a little).  Also used fresh ground black pepper, as in everything I eat or cook.  Buying a pepper grinder at the store is really not that much more expensive than a pepper shaker, and it makes a world of difference.

One thing that did horrify Me in the instructions though: using a wire whisk in a non-stick pot.  NO!  NO!  A thousand times NO!  Just use a wooden spoon or a non-metal whisk unless you feel like replacing your pot frequently, since metal utensils scratch up the non-stick coating unless you're REALLY careful.

All in all, this turned out even better than I could have imagined.  I used it on some pasta with freshly sliced mushrooms and a sprinkle more of Parmesan (just a sprinkle, so I did use the store-bought Kraft in this instance).  Absolute heaven.  It's like an

What a surprise! I really enjoyed this recipe. At first glance, I thought it would not taste any good, never mind the texture! But desperate times called for desperate measures and I used this recipe! I will definitely be using it again.

Excellent!  This was the first time I made an Alfredo Sauce.  The only change I made to the recipe was to add a little  fresh grated mozzarella cheese because I was about  2 oz. short of having enough parmisan cheese.  The rest of the recipe I followed exactly then served it over gnocchi.  Hubby loved it!

Will make again for sure.
This is the best alfredo sauce I've made at home- maybe the best I've ever eaten.
this is a great easy recipe and very quick to make. the key for me was to just keep stirring so everything would come out smooth.

So easy and SO good! I used about 1/2 tbsp. of minced garlic, added when butter was almost melted, and a dash of nutmeg. If you want thick sauce like we do, I'd suggest using about 1/2 the amount of milk...I just whisked in a little at a time until I got it to the consistency I wanted.
Easy and relatively tasty. Good for a night that you don't have enough time for cooking.
Very, very rich.

As Alfredo Sauce is my son's favorite, I was really hoping to surprise him with this easy sounding recipe. Unfortunately, it was butter soup. I followed the recipe to a tee. So I don't know what I did wrong. I would love to make it again. Any advice?
This was great! I followed the recipe to a T and served with broccoli and chicken. Thank you!

This recipe is so easy and quite good.  I served one half with alfredo and to the other half I added some pesto sauce.  Took the leftovers into the work and the men loved it - one even asked for the recipe!

This is the first time making this sauce and  I thought it was a great fast Alfredo sauce, I made a few changes, instead of using plain cream cheese, I used Kraft Philadelphia Herb & Garlic spreadable cream cheese. I also added about 4 clove of minced fresh garlic instead of garlic powder. The main thing to remember when melting the cheese is keep the heat low and slow and it will turn out smooth and creamy.

We tried this for dinner tonight...what a great sauce! Creamy, though I added a lot of garlic since we love garlic! I used lowfat evaporated milk, and half the cheese called for. Easy, yummy, and a sure hit!  Thanks for a great recipe.
It was good but I've had better!
Very good!I used fresh garlic sauteed in the butter instead of garlic powder. Delicious!!!
Sublime!  The hubby and I will definitely be making this again.  It's so nice not having to eat store-bought Alfredo sauce in the jars.  I'll never eat it from a jar again.  Thanks for the recipe!

SO Easy and SO Yummy!  Used FF cream cheese (there's enough fat in the butter!) and extra parmesan.  It thickens up quite a bit AFTER cooking, I had to thin mine out w/milk (I let it sit to cool and it thickened a LOT).  Both my girls (ages 2 & 4) wanted seconds!
Who would have dreamed that a rich and delicious alfredo sauce could be so easy to make?  I added shrimp to the sauce since Hubby likes a bit of seafood in his.  We loved this!!!

I've used this for years as it's always worked well for me.  The only problem I have noticed it after you refrigerate it, it doesn't really heat back up well.  It's not horrible but definitely not the same consistency as when you poured it over the pasta.  Also, it develops more of a cream cheese look after it's been refrigerated.  If you mix it directly with the pasta and plan to have any leftovers, keep this in mind.  It might be better to store the sauce separately from the pasta if you plan on using some of it later.  A good recipe, just the storing and later usage is the only issue I had with it.....and that could have just been me.

Anyways, for taste, I highly recommend this.  You can also use shredded Parmesean, if you have any of that lying around.  I've also substituted a 4 cheese Italian blend and it turned out well, with a slightly milder taste.
I've been trying to master alfredo sauce for years and just when I thought I had it down, I see this recipe.  It's amazing.  The only thing I changed was using only 1 cup of milk.  Yummy!
Good, but needs a little tweeking, overall a really easy recipe
Pretty darn good. Used reduced fat cream cheese and skim milk and it still tasted nice and creamy. As other's suggested used minced garlic instead of the powder.

This recipe is awesome!  Quick and easy with grilled chicken and light cream cheese.  Definitely add a couple of teaspoons of nutmeg for a more authentic taste.  It's nice not to fuss with fattening cream and egg yolks.
AMAZING!!! Cooked it for my family of 8 and they loved it!!
Easy easy easy..... Amazing amazing AMAZING! We enjoy this twice a month, we have added broccoli as well as chicken. A family favorite.
I tasted the cream cheese. Left me disappointed.

I made this recipe with the ingredients exactly measured.  I have made many alfredo sauces which were anywhere from fair to excellent, but all were time consuming.  This was the easiest and best home prepared alfredo I have ever made.  
My review is based on the exact recipe.
After completing the recipe I decided to make it a "creole" alfredo and add 1 1/2 tsp of Tony Chacere's Creole Seasoning.  I would give the creole version 6 stars if I could!  We used it as a sauce for baked tilapia.  We served it with fresh oven fries and a green salad.  Yummmmm.
***if you decide to make a creole version please adjust the amount of seasoning to suit your personal taste.  I would start with no more than 3/4 tsp***

The cream cheese in this recipe made this the silkiest sauce ever!!  Absolutelty delicious!  You do have to be patient and whisk and whisk on low to medium heat, however the time spent cooking this the right way makes it all worthwhile! One thing I did change was I used heavy cream instead of milk and added more parm cheese!!  YUM!
Wow!!! First time I ever attempted Alfredo sauce...VERY EASY!!!! and to die for
I thought I would regret making it after I put in the cream cheese, but it was surprisingly delicious.  Add used fresh garlic and added a little corn starch and nutmeg.  Will make again!

This sauce is fabulous.  If you're into alfredo sauce, I strongly recommend it.
I also added a little oregano and some mushrooms sauted in garlic.  Enjoy!

It was ok/good.   Mainly it was really bland.

I did have to make some substitutions for health reasons.  Full fat cream cheese became light cream cheese.  6 oz of Parm (I use the real very salty stuff) was changed to 4 oz of Mozzarella & 2 oz of Parmesan.  I don't think that was an issue though, it tasted like alfredo.  I cracked a lot of pepper, added some salt and it was ok.  The texture was great.  The flavor was close, but again...it was kinda bland.  May have been my fault for substituting Moz.  but seriously, 6 oz of Parm (with all that salt) and all that butter seemed like it would be too rich.  Anyway, I'm ranking it as "Good" since it was "OK" with substitutions.
I did not care for this recipe.
Loved it!

Thanks Dawn for this easy and great tasting recipe for alfredo sauce.  I have tried many but couldn't find the one that is a match for resturant quality.  I used Smart Balance instead of butter and used reduced fat cream cheese and milk.  It was creamy and tasking great. After I was done with this sauce, I mixed pasta sauce and my god, my pasta was very tasty.  My 2 year old finished her first serving without talking a single word and asked for seconds.  My husband had three serving.  It is a definate keeper.
This was so fast and so easy and so good!
I pulsed two cups of fresh basil with two teaspoons of fresh minced garlic in the food processor and then added it to the simmering sauce.  YUM!

This was great!! Very easy to make, and delicious. I used low fat cream cheese, and a little extra garlic, just because I love garlic. Added some cooked chicken, mushrooms and broccoli to it, and folks at work asked for the recipe too.!!  Great recipe!
Easy and delicious!

Not in ten minutes, the cream cheese and butter would not easily mix, I heated it to near boiling and had to use an electric whisk and the Parmesan was hard to blend in, it took around 20+ minutes until the milk was slowly added and it finally did come together somewhat. The flavor was good, but next time will use Gorgonzola or Bleu cheese instead of cream cheese

I followed the suggestions of reg927 for making this sauce, then used probably 1/4 cup cream in place of some of the milk reg927 suggested.  I served this with the baked herb perch fillet recipe...minus the bread crumbs, doubling the Parmesan cheese and baking in the melted butter in a 9x13 pan...on this website and steamed cauliflower.  A monochromatic meal but garnered me great compliments. :-)

This sauce is amazing! just the right amount of every flavor and DEFINITELY not bland at all! I made this up using real garlic and shredded Parmesan instead (its what i had) and it was awesome. For the dinner i was making though i added in 2 cans of regular rotel and it turned it into a spicy tomato alfredo. I also put in 2 green and 1 yellow bell pepper for a little more substance. served it over three cheese spinach ravioli and WOW what an amazing meal! next time i'm adding in chicken and black olives.

This recipe is so easy and tastes so much like the real thing. Many times the 'real' alfredo sauce I make turns greasy. This was so creamy. I agree that no one would ever know it had a cream cheese base. I added a little nutmeg and it made it taste like any restaurant's alfredo sauce.
Wonderful, easy recipe.  I followed the instructions and it turned out great.  I served it over tiny bowtie pasta.

This recipe was great, very easy and quite tasty.  I made it as directed but threw in about 1/2 c of Italian blend shredded cheese.  Was a huge hit with my son and even my husband who isn't a big fan of alfredo liked it.

Yum, yum, yum! I was in the mood for some pasta with alfredo one evening but didn't want to run to the store for any missing ingredients like heavy cream. I figured I'd try looking online for an easy alternative & came upon this recipe. I had just enough cream cheese to make a serving for myself & I loved it! I threw in some chopped broccoli...yum. It is such an easy recipe & tastes just like the alfredo from my favorite restaurants. I volunteered to make this for an upcoming holiday pasta dinner & I never typically partake in bringing anything for the holiday meals :)

We loved this recipe. I didn't have nutmeg as others suggested so I added a dash of all spice.  I also used half cream and half milk. The only thing we didn't live was how quickly the sauce thickened as it cooled while we were eating but overall it was a big hit!
Too much fat tastes like thick cream cheese

OH MY GOSH! SO SO good! I used fresh garlic. Next time I'll cut the fresh parm in 1/2. I also combined with fresh asparagus, bowties, put in oven with mozzarella on top on broil for about 5 minutes. I will make this over and over and over!  I also added about 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley to the sauce (at the point which you add the pepper and parm). I cannot say how easy and totally wonderful this is!

For something more healthy, this is a good recipe to overhaul.  I used skim milk, fat free cream cheese, low fat butter, and reduced fat grated parmesan cheese.  Quite yummy and you feel a little better about eating that extra helping.  :)

Best alfredo sauce I have ever tried.  I used just a stick of butter because I added bacon oil (I wanted meat in my pasta) I didn't have a whisk so I just used a wooden spoon.  I was afraid that the cream cheese would be just fried in the butter but adding the milk slowly made the mixture blend together eventually.  You just need to be patient.  Garlic powder and fresh parsley gave this sauce a nice blend of flavor.  This makes is a very good base sauce for any white sauce recipe.  I can imagine using this for tuna fettuccine or chicken breast + broccoli.  I will definitely make this again.
Very Good!  Any easy to make too.  This is definately a keeper.
Hmmm this was ok, i'm eating it as I type.  Although i LOVE the idea of using cream cheese, its just kinda bland.
Tasted good.  But even with two attempts to make it, the texture was still watery with lumps.  If anyone has more hints, please post them here!

This was wonderful!! It was my first attempt at making alfredo sauce  and it turned out delish! I will make sure I use unsalted butter next time as the parmesan is salty enough for my taste. Thanks so much for the recipe!

THIS WAS DELICIOUS. BECAUSE I DIDN'T HAVE CREAM CHEESE ON HAND,I SUBSTIUTED WITH RONDELE CHEESE (A CHEESE SPREAD THAT COMES IN A 8OZ TUB) AND USED ONE CUP OF HEAVY CREAM INSTEAD OF 2 CUPS OF MILK.MY FAMILY RAVED AND RAVED. CAN'T WAIT TO SHARE WITH MY FRIENDS.THANK YOU!
This sauce tastes just as good with low fat cream cheese and is a bit healthier.  Reduced fat milk can also be used.
This was the easiest sauce I've ever made that turned out so fantastic. Thank you very much!!
Great sauce!  Finally an easy alfredo sauce that tastes great!

This is a fantastic recipe. Nobody can tell that it isn't made with heavy cream. As others have stated, you can't taste the cream cheese. I usually put in some peas and shrimp and toss over fettuccini noodles and everyone loves it. I have tried subbing minced garlic for the powder and it is somewhat better, but not necessary. So easy to make!
Needs a little bit of salt otherwise very good. Will definitely make again.
we loved it, I used half box or half LB.Fettuccine, I large chicken breast, that I seasoned with mcCormick, Montreal steak seasoning.

This really was not appetizing. I was surprised that my husband and I felt so strongly about it despite the awesome reviews it received. I rarely ever disagree with the ratings on recipes. This, however, did taste like the alfredo sauce you would find at an italian fast food restaurant, or maybe even in a jar somewhere. It doesn't taste authentic. I was disappointed :(

this recipe is FABULOUS - served 5 over here and my friends couldn't stop raving about it! i totally forgot to add the parmasean cheese tho *lol* had bacon, brocoli, fresh mushrooms, onions, green peppers and chives.... mmm-mmmmmmmm!!! might have to try a low-fat variation at this rate hehe..

I needed half this recipe to put with other ingredients in my crockpot, so I halved it and it was better than the store bought Alfredo.  I will never buy it from the store again, this was a great recipe and my husband loved it.
I made no changes since I wanted to see how this recipe would turn out when followed to the tee. It was a huge hit! I would not make any changes in the future. Good as is! Try it :)

Really easy/real good.  Second time I made it, I used an asiago/Romano/Parmesan blend.  It sharpened it up a little bit.  Good as is though.  So much better than jar sauce!  Hubby's favorite with shrimp, spinach, grape tomatoes over spinach fettichini.
Yumm!  Made it with a teaspoon of garlic and 1-1/3 cup milk.  Otherwise as written.  I thought it was delicious and so did my family!  It's a keeper!
Yummy that is the best I have ever had! I just added a touch of flour at the end because it was a little thin. It was great Thanks so much! A+

I loved this recipe, but the "better-half" wasn't won over with it, so I can only rate as a 4 star. Regardless, the cream cheese was the key to achieving a wonderful texture, and didn't affect the taste (in my opinion).

We Just finished up eating this for dinner. I used Ziti and threw in some chicken. I am overdue for grocery shopping and was looking for something quick and easy with what we had! Only had 4 ounces of Parmesian cheese, and no garlic powder and it still came out amazing! Everyone loved it, and even my sisters friends (all teens!!) enjoyed it!
This was very good and very easy to make.  I have made it several times already.  Thanks!

Anything with butter, cream cheese and garlic has to be terrific!!!  I mixed this with smoked salmon and fettuccine noodles...fantastic!!!  I just won't be eating very much of this at a time due to the high fat content...probably best to save for potlucks.
I tried another recipe that made the Alfredo sauce from scratch. But it took to long to make. Yours is much easier to make and it taste a lot better. It will be one of my favorites.
Soooooo good! I chose this one because it had the highest rating which doesn't always work out but it did this time! I didn't change a thing.
I love this recipe! I have never given any recipe 5 stars, but this one deserves it. It is so simple and delicious you don't have to change or add anything. Great recipe!

Loved this!  I used lowfat butter, lowfat cream cheese and skim milk and it tasted fantastic.  Mixed it with some spinach and sauteed mushrooms then served over linguine.  Can't wait to use it on other pasta and add some blackened chicken.  I highly recommend this easy and very tasty sauce!
Yum! This sauce was excellent! Best alfredo i've ever had. i had to add a little salt tho. otherwise, delicious!

I made this tonight and it was so easy and good.  I used two cloves of garlic because I did not have the powder, and because I had just a tub of cream cheese (16oz) I eye-balled half of that for the requisite 8oz. Very good - I used fresh garlic, 2 cloves added to the butter, and nutmeg at the end of the cooking.  Yum.
Omg this is stupid easy and amazing. Thank u for posting it.

Delish!  It even reheats well, and doesn't get separated & funky like Alfredo. I added some roasted peppers for some variation & color.
This alfredo sauce is absolutley fantastic. It has a great consistency and works well with chicken or shrimp.
this was so easy to make and delicious.  I never thought making alfredo could be this easy.  This will be a keeper!

Upon making this recipe for the first time, I was quite pleased with the ease of making this, not only did it taste exceptional, but I was happy upon looking in my kitchen to find that I always have all the ingredients it required, that was an added plus for me. I have been making a variation for years.  In mine I use veggie cream cheese - started with just a T of it, but now I use all the veggie type.  I make with shrimp and always sprinkle tiny chopped tomato pieces on the top for color.
MMMMMM!  This was fast, easy, and absolutely delicious!!!
I added a touch more garlic powder and used almond milk. Love it!!
This is an amazing recipe!! I made it in under 10 min while my hubby threw some chicken on the grill. This will be a regular at our house from now on, delicious!!

The name of this says it all! The kids LOVED this and are asking me to make it again. My youngest daughter LOVES alfredo so I tried this recipe not knowing what to expect and it was sooooooo good! Definitely going to use this when I am short on time! Thank you for such a great recipe!

AWESOME! just when you think its not going to work it all comes together. This is good enough to serve guest and super easy. By the way, I use skim milk and its still creamy and delicious. Thanks for sharing!
I followed this recipe exactly as written.  It turned out really good!  Very rich though so I couldn't eat much of it.  Thanks for sharing!

This was a very good sauce, I served it with chicken and fettuccini noodles, definetely do not use crumbled parmesan, it makes it too gridy stick with fresh shredded parmesan also too much garlic. But very good

This recipe makes a really good Alfredo sauce. My husband and I both loved it ( he usually complains when I tell him we are having Alfredo anything for dinner). I made the mistake of using kraft Parmesan because it was all I had and it was very gritty.  Will definately use real Parmesan cheese next time.
I've been using this recipe for years. I have never had it not work and I have never heard one complaint! The only thing I do different is I use half and half instead of milk.

I have never been able to find a store-bought alfredo sauce that I like, but this was AMAZING!  And really easy and fast to make.  My husband and 2 year old love it too. Made this for two picky teenagers and a picky wife, was a big hit and just a little tweeking needed, was a little gritty with the parm. but good. the best part is from stove to table very little time needed. it takes longer to peel the shrimp than it does to make this.
It was okay. It was quick and easy and didn't taste like cream cheese, but I think it was on the same level as jarred alfredo.

This sauce was fantastic!  I added a few slices of gargonzola cheese, the last of some Cougar Cheese that I had, and added the parm. It was wonderful. And I always have cream cheese in the fridge. I just added shrimp, onions, and sun dried tomatoes. Yum!
Easy & YUMMY!

This was delicious and so easy.  The only change was I used fresh chopped garlic which I sauted in the butter before adding the other ingredients.  I am just amazed that cream cheese is one of the main ingredients!  I think I may try whipped cream cheese next time so that when it cools slightly it may not be so thick.

We LOVE this in our house!  My husband can't get enough of this.  I always half the recipe since I cook for two.  The first batch we made was a little thin. The second batch, I used 3/4 cup of milk, and it was perfect!  We will never use another alfredo recipe!
This recipe is not only delicious, but easy!!! I do not taste the cream cheese, I taste the parmesean. It is sooo good! Everyone loved it! Thanks for the great recipe.

Easy and tasted great. This will be my standard alfredo sauce from now on. Highly recommended.

after you add the parm. dont be worried if its not very thick, once you take it off the heat it will start to thicken pretty fast.

My family did not enjoy this sauce at all :(

We prefer the "To Die For Fettuccine Alfredo" recipe on this site.

This recipe is not only easy, but delicious.  No need to change anything as it is great as is.
Easy and delicious! My daughter asked for this to be our go to alfredoz

Thank you for a wonderful recipe!
I used heavy whipping cream in stead of milk. Wonderful!!!!!
I loved this! I did add ricotta cheese 2 tbs. to it, frozen peas, broccoli and chicken and it was fantastic!

This sauce is AMAZING. Roomie #1 took the first bite of his pasta and went, "Mmm! This is good!" I love how easy it was to make this. It's great that I don't have to buy any of that jar stuff anymore.
This was really good!! I followed as another reviewer said and used 1 1/3 cup of milk and I used low fat cream cheese as well as minced garlic and it was a hit! Great recipe

I loved this recipe exactly as written!    My husband and daughter loved it as well!  When it comes to an easy Alfredo sauce this is going to be the recipe I reach for from now on!  Thank you for sharing this great recipe!

Made this tonight and it was delicious! Would cut back on the Parmesan a little, and I added minced garlic and a tiny bit of white wine. This is the best and easiest sauce I have ever made the only thing I did different (and I always do) was to add nutmeg it's an Italian thing.

Just browsing for something quick and good to do with chicken and spaghetti. I threw in some green pepper that I had left over.  This was awesome. good flavor and easy.  wish it wasn't so runny.  Will add less milk next time.

Wow, so good and so easy.  Way better than store-bought and probably way cheaper too.  I paired this with Spinach Noodles from this site and it tastes awesome.  Thanks!

I like this sauce.... but it doesnt taste like alfredo to me and thats why it doesnt get 5 stars. I may have done something wrong though I read the directions over and over and cant see what I might have misunderstood. It just wasnt spectacular.

oh my goodness! this was awesome i made it with alfredo noodles and the dish of the day which was garlic parmesan chicken and it was outstanding!! a total keeper, you wont regret trying this at all. delicious!

Very easy! and good the serving sizes where very large.

Great sauce.

This is a five star recipe for a few reasons:
1. Minutes before I wanted to cook dinner I found this recipe and had all of the ingredients.  It uses cream cheese instead of cream.  I do not use cream often I don't have it on hand typically.  I would be able to make this recipe anytime.
2. It’s so easy to make, anyone could do it. Just make sure you keep on stirring while cooking.
3. It goes with almost anything. I mixed some nice looking pasta with chicken pieces.  Presto - chango! Chicken Pasta Alfredo - Restaurant style.
4. It's Delicious - for anyone from infants to grandparents.  My one year old loved it. Me too!

Well, I have to say that I am a LOVER of all things cream cheese, and use it as a base for just about any cream/cheese sauce I am making instead of a traditional rue. With that being said, I have NEVER used cream cheese as the base for an Alfredo sauce! I am a traditionalist when it comes to Alfredo, and always went through the painstaking task of making it entirely from scratch. I have to say, though. This is just as good, if not better than most I have made/tried. The best testament to the sauce was a girlfriend of mine who was visiting while I was cooking. I was making homemade fettuccine noodles to go with the sauce. She kept making the comment that she HATED Alfredo sauce. I did take the suggestion of a few posters and added a dash of nutmeg and oregano, along with half heavy cream and half milk, you know if you are going to eat, go all out! The depth and flavor added by these simple changes made it outstanding! I tried it just by the recipe guidelines and it was also really great! I topped the pasta with the sauce and a mixture of marinated chicken breasts, and bacon-SINFUL! This is a meal I will be making again and again! Thank you so much for the posting! Great idea!
Easy and tasty, better than jarred.
Easy n awesome perfect flavor

I loved this recipe. I read through it and added my own touch. I also added ricotta cheese and fresh parsley. It was wonderful!!!! I baked mine and made a little extra sauce to pour on when the baked pasta was done. Delicious.

Just as the name suggests, this recipe is quick, easy and with a few modifications, one of the healthiest Alfredo sauce recipes I've come across! Used only 2 tbsp of low fat butter, fat free cream cheese and low fat Parmesan. Will definitely revisit this recipe soon!

It sounds so simple, but this is incredibly good. I use it with sauteed, chunked chicken breast...removed and set aside, boil up the garlic/cheese tortellini and and then toss both into the sauce...really rich.

This was so easy and tasted great!!! I added some Nutmeg and served the sauce over Linguine and grilled chicken strips. I will definitely make this again and might try the lower fat version that other reviews have suggested.

Quick, easy and delicious. I always have the ingredients on hand and don't have to make a run to the store for heavy cream or special cheeses. No worries about burning the milk. It has the same consistancy and flavor everytime.

This recipe is dangerous----it is sooo good that you could hurt yourself eating it.  I was looking for an alfredo sauce recipe since, I had never made it before, and came across this one.  My whole family loved it.  It is also great to dip breadsticks in.  All I can say is "Yum!!"  Super recipe!

Great! I used 2 slices of fresh garlic in the butter, cooked 2 minutes. Complete the rest of the recipe, add a little sea salt, but don't over salt, add pepper, and thin with heavy cream. Top with parsley. Serve over ziti with Parmesan and chopped seeded tomatoes.

The most amazing sauce!!  It made more than 4 servings, but that is fine with me, I just froze it!   It was creamy, and just velvety.  Its important to make sure the cream cheese is warmed and it will incorporate with the butter much easier!    I definitely will pass this on to all my friends!!
this was decent for my first attempt at alfredo sauce. i used fresh garlic. too much garlic, actually! so that was over powering. also, my sauce never really got thick. i will try this recipe again!

Absolutely nothing wrong with this sauce, but I don't think it's exactly what I'm looking for.  It needs something more, but I don't know what.
I made this sauce with light cream cheese and it tasted great.  Will definetely make again.
Recipe was great but I substituted a minced clove of garlic for the powder. I think 2 cups of milk made it a bit runny so next time I'll use one or some half and half.

My daughters and I wanted an alfredo sauce for our fettucine.  This one is outstanding!  It was so easy and very delicious. I don't know what these cooks didn't like who scored it so low.  It was fabulous, my daughters agree.

Fantastic Alfredo sauce! I do not use quite as much milk because we like it a bit thicker and I used fresh garlic because I had it on hand. Thanks for sharing such a great recipe, Dawn.

This was the best alfredo sauce I have ever had! I did substitute Heavy Cream for milk. I did 1 cup milk and 1 cup hevay cream and it came out fantastic! My whole family loved it and I would make it again anytime!
It was quick and easy . I substituted margarine for the butter because that is all I had on hand. I did not put any nutmeg in cause I did not have any.  But the taste was very good.

This was so quick and easy and one of the best sauces I've ever tasted. I will probably never buy an over-priced, under-delicious plate of alfredo again. I have the pickiest husband in the history of picky husbands, and he even loved it.
For simplicity alone - 5 Stars.  Add 5 more stars for taste and versatility.  This recipe is very forgiving, a definite keeper.

this tastes just like olive garden's cheese alfredo sauce. it was perfect!

I would give this a 3.5. My biggest problem was the consistency. It seemed like it was too thin, so I kept on adding more and more parmesan cheese. After the sauce sat awhile, it tasted gritty when we had 2nds. I added grilled chicken and served it over bow-tie pasta. It was good, but it might be easier just to stick with the can variety.
I absolutely love this recipe. I never cared for alfredo sauce out of the jar so this is a delight. I make it exactly as the recipe states every time. YUMMM!!!

It really doesn't get much easier than this recipe.  I added cooked broccoli for color and substituted a good spoonful of minced garlic for the powder.  I also used heavy cream instead of milk and low-fat cream cheese (-it balances, right? lol).  Is this recipe healty? NO.  Is this recipe tasty, easy and showy? Yes.   A definite keeper.
It was great!  I put some sauteed garlic in it.

One of the easiest and most delicious pasta dishes I've ever had! I scaled the sauce down to 4 servings, even though I only used angel hair pasta for one. As others have subbed the milk, I also used non-fat dairy creamer in its place with great success....also added a little white wine. I used two cloves of garlic but I would even add more, I love it so much. I topped with parsley, and I found it needed salt, as well. Absolutely delish! Thanks for sharing your creation, Dawn!

This was great! I used the suggestion of skim milk and light cream cheese. I added fresh sage and basil also.  I used mince garlic not powder and I added mushrooms on top of the pasta! YUM! Thanks!!!!
Perfect. Changed nothing.  My husband hates alfredo and loved this sauce.  Will make again.
Very easy and actually tastes good.  I even used lowfat ingredients and a little less cream cheese. Still creamy and everyone loved it!
This was soooooo good. It was so easy and used things that were on hand. I much more likely to have cream cheese than heavy cream on hand. I will be making this often. Thanks for the great recipe!!

I can't believe that such an easy recipe could be SO good! I'm a huge Fettuccine Alfredo lover and this sauce is the best I've made. However, I was shocked to find that my fiance, who doesn't really care for Alfredo sauce, thought this was to die for! So it's good enough to please both Alfredo-lovers and non-lovers. I make just a few tiny modifications: I mince a few cloves of garlic and saute with the butter (we are garlic lovers) and cut back on the garlic powder. I also add a few shakes of ground nutmeg at the end; this adds just a little something special (but it doesn't taste "nutmeg-y" so don't worry). I also add a bit of coarse Kosher salt or sea salt and I put the parmesan on the table instead of stirring it into the sauce so everyone can choose how much they want. My final tip: use a wire whisk to mix the cream cheese into the butter (and again when you add the milk). When I do this, it's always 100% lump-free!
This was quick and easy. Thanks for the recipe.

Wow! Creamy, creamy, creamy! I made this twice in one week. The secret really is the cream cheese. A very sensual meal served hot over linguine or fettucine. Pair it with a tangy caesar salad. Be sure not to rush the prep time. Constantly stir and add all of the ingredients alittle at a time. It really makes a difference in the consistency.
Awesome flavor. Easy to make! Make sure you use wisk for cream cheese it makes a huge difference!!
Great recipe, quick and easy and I didn't have to buy it in a jar! Thanks.
love this recipe and it was so easy!
Great idea to use cream cheese really wanted to try it. Had used plain yogurt in different dishes just to see what effect it had. Turned out very well and simply delicious.
Wow!  Easy and delicious.  So much better than store bought.  Everyone in my very picky family liked it - that's a miracle!!  Thanks for this recipe.
WOW! This was easy and delicious! Not very healthy or diet friendly so I don't make it often as I would like.

I gave this 5 stars becuase this recipe ROX!!! It was so quick and easy! I was apprehensive about making it but all my fears vanished when my family said they loved it!! I was counting on having leftovers for 3 days but we finished it off at dinner the next day! No question about it, this is definately a keeper!!!!
This is the best alfredo sauce I've ever tasted but since I just joined Weight Watchers, I'll have to find a lighter alternative as the points on these equal two days worth of meals.

Bravo!  I was looking for a last minute recipe that was delicious.  This fit the bill to a tee.  I had fresh garlic and low fat cream cheese, but that was my only change to this recipe. It was creamy, and delighful and when my 3 boys tasted it, they said it was out of the park.  This is definitely a keeper.  Thanks for sharing!
This recipe was great and super easy!  I added grilled chicken, mushrooms and finely cut up, cooked onions as well.  This is a keeper!
Tastes pretty good .. I sauteed small pieces of chicken breast in olive oil and added to it.
I doubled the recipe for a party and was absolutely a hit, the only thing i did different was add a little mozzerella cheese.  will definitely make again.

It is in fact quick & easy. Tasted delicious. I've made it exact to recipe as well as a few times with some onion powder added. Perfect with pasta and chicken. My family loves it. Also great as a large batch to freeze for later.

This was so easy and had an absolutely FANTASTIC flavor!   I added a little cajun seasoning to mine and omitted the pepper.  I also did not have garlic powder, so I added minced garlic to the melted butter.  I sauteed bay scallops in olive oil, garlic and cajun seasoning, then I transferred them to the sauce and poured it all over pasta!  This is a real keeper!  TRY IT, you will not be dissapointed.

Hands down, this is my go-to recipe for alfredo sauce and my family loves it.. I also add a couple of dashes of nutmeg to give it a little more flavor, but all in all, this is a great and easy recipe.

Well after finding out my G/F liked Alfredo and I wanted to do something a little more special on Valentines Eve then jar Alfredo I decided to try this recipe with Linguini .  I also picked up a jar of Alfredo just as a backup.  Well certainly didn't need any backup as this recipe was awesome.  She even wanted to take the rest home with her.  

I don't know why people are saying they can taste the cream cheese.  I couldn't at all.  I did have to make one modification, it called for Roasted Garlic and Olive oil butter from L.O.L. I didn't see that so I used just the L.O.L. Butter with Olive oil.  I will also try minced Garlic next time instead of Garlic Powder.

My family loves alfredo, and this recipe is the best!  We make it a few times a month and keep some in the freezer for last minute meals.  It's quick, easy, and way better than anything in a jar or even from many restaurants.

I really did like this, but I did change it to suit how we eat.  To lighten it up, I use only 1/4 cup of butter.  It still comes out rich and creamy, and I feel better about it.  Second, I use half the amount of garlic powder.  The first time I made it, I used all the garlic powder to rave reviews, but it was too strong for me.  I serve this over whole grain penne with sauteed chicken breasts and fresh vegetables like zucchini, summer squash, asparagus, mushrooms-- whatever is on hand and in season.  With delicate fresh vegetables, I want their flavor to stand out. This sauce comes together quickly and easily, and is good with all the garlic or half, but I definitely recommend cutting the butter in half.  The kids have requested to have this more often.  High praise!

This sauce is amazing! I followed a few other reviewers suggestions and used 1/2 heavy whipping cream and 1/2 milk, a dash of nutmeg and fresh garlic. I also added 1/2 a chopped shallot.  I tossed it with some penne pasta and sauteed yellow & red peppers, mushrooms and carrots. Served a grilled chicken breast on top.  The whole family left the table groaning because they ate too much. Thanks for the great recipe!
I added one chopped garlic glove and "shredded" parmesan cheese. I used the sauce to make Nachos that I topped with fresh spinach, chopped tomatoes, black beans, and ground beef..Just lovely!
so easy!

I made this last night with Grilled chicken Ravioli from Sam's because I didn't have any Alfredo Sauce on hand. I LOVED it! I did read the reviews and make the changes suggested....1 tsp minced garlic with the butter, only used about 1 1/3 cups milk and 4 oz. of parmesean (half a container of kraft grated), about 1/4 tsp black pepper and a few grinds of sea salt. Next time, I would probably add a little more parmesan...maybe the 6 oz. It also did not thicken quickly, it took a good 5-10 minutes. 

I will definitely not be buying canned sauce again! The cream cheese does give it a little of a different flavor than traditional Alfredo, but it is a really good white sauce to use with your Italian dishes!
WONDERFUL AND EASY - I was running low on milk and used 1 cup cream and 1 cup milk - This is a SUPER recipe.  Thanks!

This was excellent.  I used fat free half and half and fat free cream cheese and it came out delicious.  I also substitued the garlic powder for fresh garlic, and sauteed it in the butter for a few minutes before adding the other ingredients. Very creamy and delicious.
Wow...I really wanted alfredo sauce but didnt have the heavy cream my usual recipe calls for so I decided to try a new one....I am soooo glad I did. PERFECT and DELICIOUS!!
Tasted good, but for some reason, my sauce did not thicken.  I cooked it for ten minutes more than the recommended time.  I'm not sure if it was me, but I followed the directions exactly.
Perfect.  Restaurant quality as written.
I usually have trouble finding a good alfredo. This one was the perfect texture and not too rich!
Made as directed. Turned out perfect. Best alfredo I've made.
I made this my go to recipe for Alfredo sauce when I don't want to use jars. My boyfriend and I love it and it's very very easy to make! Thank you :)
i like pasta,my mama taught me to made pasta
Very Tasty...Made it for a Pasta Bar and received rave reviews!
this isn't quite like any alfredo sauce i've evr had but it taste very yummy!!! served it with baked chicken, rotini, and broccoli. My 4 yr old even liked it!!
Excellent, very similar to OG.
Despite what several reviewers have said about not being able to taste the cream cheese, it was evident and not authentic alfredo sauce in the opinion of my family. We will not eat this again.
This was great! It was very rich and easy. I think its a great recipe to use in a pinch but I still prefer the "real" thing.

Definitely a go-to recipe! 2nd time making this. 1st time it was too rich & I had to thin it out w/ water. Everyone still raved about it. This time around I wanted more of a garlic butter cream sauce. Sauteed shrimp, chicken sausage, roma tomatoes, & bella mushrooms in (approx 1 1/4 cup) EVOO (instead of butter) w/ 1tbsp of minced garlic. Added 1/2 pack of cream chz, approx 1/4 cup of shredded parmesan, romano & asagio chz & 2tbsp of grated parmesan. Reduced with some white wine & voila!! Tossed with angel hair pasta & it was perfect.   *All measurements are approximate due to the fact that I rarely measure when cooking.

This was so wonderful and very easy! I followed the popular reviewer's tips (1 and 1/3 cup of milk, 4oz parm, etc) and it turned out wonderfully. The next time I made it, I used 1 oz of grated parmesan and 3 oz of store brand italiano cheese and it was more delicious this time! It's a keeper
Way too soupy. Half the butter and milk.  Plus add fresh garlic and another 6ounces of good parmesan (stay clear of the pre-grated).

This is probably the easiest and best Alfredo sauce I've made. Rather than powder garlic I use fresh minced garlic. Then I fry up some fresh mushroom in garlic butter and add it to the sauce just before serving. Sometimes we add either cooked chicken or bacon to be served with the pasta and Alfredo sauce. Even with the mushrooms, the Alfredo sauce does freeze well.
EXCELLENT! I used this recipe for my philly steak pizza and chicken alfredo pizza ..............EVERYONE LOVED IT!!!!
Delicious just as it is
YUM! Made exactly as stated and it was a big hit and S-I-M-P-L-E.

This recipe is so simple to make and tastes waaaayyyy better than the generic jarred kind from the grocery store. I'll never use the kind in the jar again. Instead of Parm, I use the shredded Sargento Italian blend cheese. Delish!!! :)

Did Olive Garden get their recipe for this sauce here?! Seriously amazing. I used garlic salt instead of garlic powder, and replaced butter with Blue Bonnet. Two words: simply marvelous! I put this sauce over bow-tie pasta and kielbasa turkey sausage (a recipe from this side) and it was a major hit.  :)

I had this recipe in my recipe box for over a year and kept forgetting about it.  I made it one night and my son RAVED about how much he loved it with his noodles.  I used the lower fat cream cheese with no problem.  I did use a fresh garlic clove instead of the powdered stuff.  A great and easy cheese sauce, yum!
EXCELLENT but VERY  easy. The best of this recipe is that with no flour, there are NO LUMPS. Really, this is very good. My 20 y/o son said, "this is a keeper"!!!!

This is such an awesome recipe!  I was 100% satisfied.  I was surprised that it called for cream cheese, but decided to go ahead with it since it got such high ratings...I am SO glad I did!  

The first time I used this recipe, I used one cup of heavy cream and one cup of milk, and added maybe one extra ounce or so of cheese.  It turned out really nice, but very rich.  I joked around by calling it "sophisticated macaroni and cheese" because the consistency was very thick and almost clung to the pasta, which is NOT a bad thing if you're in the mood for that!    

The second time I tried it, I used the 2 cups of milk the recipe called for, and it was still stellar.  I have shared this recipe with several friends, and they have had perfect results also.
This recipe is great!  It makes a huge amount, so count on leftovers.  Very easy and very tasty.
Very yummy! And simple to make. Will definitely be making again. Thanks for sharing!!!

OMGOODNESS!  This is the best alfredo sauce I've ever made.  The recipe was dead easy BUT I revamped it a little for the fat content factor (cholesterol watchers take note!).  Since I live in Canada, I used Becel instead of butter and I used low fat Philadephia cream cheese instead of the regular.  And to top it off, I used skim milk!  Worked like a charm and my hubby said to put it on the `to do again` list!  Excellent!
This works well even with low fat ingredients.  It does thicken really fast (thus the 4 stars)--too fast, I had to add more milk (and more cheese for flavor).

I read a few poor reviews and was worried, but all for naught.  This was DELICIOUS, exceeds most restaurant quality sauces in my opinion.  I put the sauce over angel hair pasta and added added lemon pepper seasoned chicken and broccoli florets.  I did use a bit less milk, as 2 full cups makes it rather thing.  The dash of oregano & nutmeg really added depth to the sauce like others have suggested.  I will never use another jar of crappy alfredo sauce again with all the preservatives.  This was just superb...will definitely be making again when I can afford to splurge on my diet!

ABSOLUTELY WON-DER-FUL The kids asked to have just a bowl of the sauce. I only used 1 1/2 cups of milk and added some parsley for color. So easy to make and delicious. Try this before you buy storebought.
Not my Dad's Alfredo sauce, but tasty nonetheless, plus quick & easy.

This is a good substitute to traditional Alfredo sauce when you are fresh out of cream. Please please please use fresh, REAL Parmesan cheese. Not the pre shredded or stuff in a container, it truly makes all the difference.   The nice thing about this sauce is that it doesn't seperate upon reheating like the traditional Alfredo.  Also, fresh garlic is always better, I used 5 cloves.   My family really enjoyed it over spinach ravioli.
our family favorite - we love it with chicken, broccoli & ziti.

Found this recipie and I make it ALL the time!.  I add 4-5 fresh chopped basil leaves to give it a little added flavor.  I also add tomatos and spinach to make a full meal.  never takes longer than 15 minutes to make!
Best and easiest alfredo sauce recipe I have made. I used skim milk and it still turned out great.

I have tried dozens of different alfredo recipes and this is hands down the best.  I was skeptical about getting a smooth sauce because that's always been my problem, but I followed the instructions exactly and it came out velvety smooth and didn't separate at all.  Next time I think I will try adding fresh garlic instead of the garlic powder for a more bold flavor, but I will definitely make this again!!

This sauce was amazingly tasty. Like a few of the others, I changed it slightly. I used fresh minced garlic instead of the powder, 1 part whipping cream to 3 parts milk, and added a dash of nutmeg. It was absolutely delicious!

Easy, yummy, and quick. This was the first homemade alfredo sauce I made and I loved it. Not ony did I love it but also my family including my picky seven year old.  I would suggest using real butter opposed to margarine just as a side note.

ok, I used 4 oz. of cream cheese b/c it's all I had left.  Increased parmesan to 8+ oz. Also, sauteed 1 clove of minced garlic and 1 T. minced fresh onion in the butter before adding the cheeses. Seemed a little thin so made a slurry w/2 T. each of flour and butter which I whisked in to thicken b/c my intention was to serve over warm biscuits. Most importantly, I stirred in cooked carrots and broccoli and 3 cans of drained tuna. Guess you could call it Tuna Alfredo over biscuits! Delicious!

This recipe changed my cooking experience! I always cooked from packages, frozen dinners, using cream of something soup. I am a baker, through and through. I love baking anything and everything, and am extremely experimental when it comes to baking new things, but never cooking. This recipe is absolutely remarkable. The simplicity is amazing, and it creates something you never thought you'd be able to create out of those ingredients. I love using small pastas like penne, rotini (corkscrews), and bowties (farfalle) for this recipe as I find it absorbs sauce better. I always add chicken, and sometimes broccoli and fresh cherry tomatoes, but it absolutely sublime on it's own for a midnight meal. I'm a cheese girl, if I was asked what food I'd  want for the rest of my life it would be cheese (or this alfredo), and I love adding in some extra mozzarella as it's cooking for some thickness and texture. This pasta sauce has become my life, and if you follow the directions correctly it is extremely simple.

I roughly used this recipe last night using two cloves of garlic and some tumeric for color.  Added it to sauteed broccoli and summer squash, then tossed the whole thing with some rotini.  It was pretty good!  Will definitely use this instead of the Alfredo in a jar.
This was really good! My husband said "This is good" about 4 times, he likes chicken alfredo, so I added chicken to a pasta with this sauce and it was so easy and delicious!

I was in search of an alfredo sauce recipe that incorporated cream cheese and I came across this one.  I must say, hands down, this is the best alfredo sauce I've ever tasted!!  I adjusted the recipe to serve about 15 people and the recipe was definitely quick and easy to follow.  I tossed  rotini in the sauce and the end result was FANTASTIC!!!  Better than I imagined!  I received many compliments.  This is a wonderful recipe and I highly recommend!!
For a fast recipe, this was excellent.  I combined the sauce w/cooked tortellini, spread into a pan, covered w/mozerella slices and baked it for 25 minutes.  Yum!
Great recipe. I added chopped chicken breast & broccoli & made with shell pasta for a one dish meal.

Awesome, tasty, easy recipe!! So convenient and way tastier than any jarred sauce.  Its easier to blend when the cream cheese is room temperature or either warmed in the microwave that way you're not adding cold cream cheese to warm butter...also, try warming the milk for easier combining.  I used some fresh garlic in addition and also some parsley.  Perfect!! Will def keep this around to make over and over.
LOVE this recipe my boyfriend and I have been looking for a easy alfredo sauce because the stuff in a can is terrible. We fell in love with this one its a good crowd pleaser definatley a keeper!!!
I've made this recipe twice and simply love it! I mix it with pasta, chicken, and broccoli (or whatever I feel or have left in the fridge). It's easy and tasty! I didn't change anything.
Great recipe if you want it quick and easy.
Great recipe, works best if cream cheese and butter are left at room temp for an hour before making the sauce.
magnifico!!!...the sauce was nice and greamy...

This was definitely very quick and very easy, and the taste was really good (creamy and cheesy.)  I halved the recipe and it still made plenty for two for dinner and two servings for lunches the next day.  I added a little more fresh ground pepper than called for, a little parsley, and a dash of nutmeg.  Family really enjoyed it.  I think it would still be as delicious with using only half the called for amount of butter.  The butter and cream cheese mixture did not come together immediately, but I kept whisking and adding the milk slowly and the texture came out perfectly (just be careful not to splatter hot butter on yourself!)  Will make again and again.
I never cared for the alfredo in a jar, so when I found this I was very excited!! I made it just as stated, perfect!

I really like this idea.  The cream cheese makes a very yummy sauce that's quick and easy to make.  With all food, there will be some adjustments based on personal taste/preference.  For me, this needed a lot less milk. I used almost half as much as the recipe called for.  I also used a pecorino romano cheese.  The type of cheese you use will make a big difference as to whether or not your sauce tastes like cream cheese.  Mine did not.  It was just rich and creamy with a lovely pecorino romano taste.

I've used Allrecipes for years and have always MEANT to leave a review, but never got around to it.  I HAD to for this recipe! It's just wonderful, the best Alfredo I've ever had.  It's so creamy but then you add all the Parmesan and it's incredible!  And easy easy easy...thanks!
This is easy.  All I had on hand was a combination Asiago/Parmesan cheese.  The Asiago cheese gave it a little punch.
I've only tried an alfredo sauce maybe once before, coz I HATE adding flour- this one was BOMB. Fam of 6 LOVED it- 5-11yr olds mowed. Kudos to your cream cheese genius discovery!

I really liked the recipe.  I'm trying to watch my calorie intake and fat so I used fat free cream cheese and low fat milk.  It was still really good.  I made shrimp alfredo pizza and then shrimp alfredo wraps the next day.  Both dishes were great.

I use this recipe when I make cheese tortellini and everyone absolutely LOVES it!  My favorite alfredo sauce by far!  I usually don't use quite as much milk though (I half it down to 1 cup or just a little over), just because I like my sauce a little thicker.

Ok this is fantastic!  I halfed the recipe and added fresh garlic to sauted shrimp and broccoli, threw that in. I can't wait to try other add ins and pasta varities this is going to be a staple for sure!

I never knew making my own alfredo sauce could be so simple and delicious. The only changes I made were that I used fresh chopped garlic (and I'm so glad that I did) and I only used 1.5 cups of whole milk because I like my sauce thick. I added shrimp and served it over linguini. YUMMY!!
This is fantastic! I didn't change anything and it was perfect for our taste! Even my picky 2 year old loved it!

THIS IS AWESOME!!  Smooth and rich and delicious.  It could be a base for a lot of imagination, but just like this, it is great too.  I hate it when people give a rating based on what they added, or took away.  I like to know how the recipe was...as written.  It is not a fair review otherwise, whether the review is favorable or not.  As written, this recipe is wonderful.
I put lobster meat in it and a little creole season in it.

Followed a combination of reviews: added oregeno and nutmeg. Also used a clove of garlic while the butter was melting. Added salt. I did use the whole 2 cups of skim milk and the full amount of parm and cream cheese.
Wonderful
Definitely quick and easy, and tastes okay when made as written. See “View Notes”.
Great recipe! Wouldn't change a thing.

OMG this was SO yummy and easy! Way way better than any jarred alfredo sauce. This will be my go to recipe for ever! I did sub minced garlic for the garlic powder. Next time I make it I will definitely have to have bread sticks to dip in it.

This was so easy to make and tasted fantastic!  I used the leftovers, reheated them in a pan with a bit of butter and sauteed crushed garlic and had a fantastic garlic alfredo sauce.  I love this recipe!
I've tried multiple recipes even much more complex recipes that sound like they would be tastier.  This one I keep going back to.  It's my favorite and easiest to make.  Great recipe
Fantastic, I only had chive and onion cream cheese at home, and it turned out great and flavorful. Everything I was looking for in a quick and easy homemade alfredo sauce

FANTASTIC ALFREDO SAUCE. Its very hard to find a good alfredo sauce and the jar stuff is disgusting, but this one was delicious. I used half &half rather than milk for a more creamy sauce and it was wonderful!
Better than what comes in the jar, but not really Alfredo Sauce.  It's excellent as a white cheese sauce though.
Excellent, but could use more herbs/spices

This recipe is great, and so simple to make. The quality and taste is maybe even better than what you would expect to find in a good Italian restaurant. It is very rich and full of flavor, and we used light cream cheese and skim milk to lighten up the fat and calories. You can add whatever you like- parsley, basil, shrimp, chicken- so many possibilities! Thanks for this great recipe.

this was a really good tasting recipe.  I followed the suggestions of the 'most helpful review' and added about 6 oz parm. cheese instead to thicken it up a bit.  Also added just a pinch of onion powder.  SO good!  Thanks for sharing this one.
It was delicious! I think I should've let the sauce get a bit thicker, it tasted fine anyway. I'll definitely make this again :)

I made this today withOUT any changes. None needed! Incredible and sooo easy. I served it with fresh cheese tortellini with broccoli florets added. Delicious. Thank you for this recipe. It is now, and will always be in my rotation.I served this with garlic toast.

Very easy to make, you definitely need to cook low and keep whisking.  I made with kraft parmesan and that was the only thing I could taste.  Next time will make with fresh grated parm and use a little less.

This was very, very good!  I did make a few changes to cut down a bit on the fat calories.  I used 6 Tablespoons of butter instead of the 1/2 cup and used Neufchatel cheese instead of the cream cheese.  It was still fantastico!!

We loved this sauce.  I used half and half instead of milk and fresh grated Parmesan and it turned out great.  I think its important to adjust the garlic to taste gather than starting out with 2 teaspoons.  If your garlic powder has been on the shelf for a while it won't be as potent. I Served it over bow tie pasta and grilled chicken, but I think it would also be great with any kind of seafood and pasta.
I tried this with provolone and it was amazing! Thanks for the tip of the cream cheese, the light stuff I had in my fridge kicked ! I also did a variation using sambal for a bit of a jalepeno kick.

This recipe was an instant hit!  We love garlic so instead of using garlic powder, I minced 2 garlic cloves and added it to the melting butter in the saucepan.  This made a HUGE difference in the flavor.  I am NEVER buying alfredo sauce again.  Thanks for an excellent recipe!  Definitely a keeper!

The first time I made it, I had to use margarine, since I didn't have butter. It turned out great! It thickened in couple minutes and it's nice that it didn't call for extra salt. Today, I made it again, using butter this time. This time, it got really oily when I dumped the milk in, and pretty much stayed that way. It also didn't thicken nicely as it it did the first time. It wasn't still an okay consistency, and still tasted good, but I'd give it 5 stars if it would've worked out just as nicely (or, if the recipe called for margarine, instead).
This recipe is AWESOME! What I did was buy the shrimp scampi from Sam's Club and I used the garlic/butter sauce from the shrimp as the butter and garlic in the recipe! Fabulous!
I had this over my homemade noodles. It was delicious!
I used fresh garlic, added it to the melted butter.  Used low fat cream cheese And added some steamed broccoli. Delicious!

It's... edible. I used fresh garlic, rather than garlic powder and added a little dried minced onion; other than those changes, I followed the recipe exactly. To begin, it tastes nothing like a traditional alfredo sauce. I love cream cheese so I wasn't concerned about some of the reviews that said that flavor was strong -they were right. The cream cheese lends richness but it overpowers the other ingredients and creates an odd taste. I served the sauce with leftover chopped pork and whole wheat pasta. It wasn't bad, hence the two stars, but I wasn't rushing back for seconds. It's a decent basic white cream sauce that's easy to put together but be prepared to make adjustments. It needs something to make the flavors blend. As it is now, it tastes as if something is missing. If I make it again, I'll play with the seasonings. It's a good starting point for a creamy sauce but in no way is it comparable to alfredo.
Great recipe.  Just like olive garden!

This was amazing! It definitely tasted like I was eating Alfredo from a restaurant. Definitely making Alfredo sauce at home like this for now on. I did make a slight adjustment and used fat free cream cheese, half a container of parmesan, and 1 tsp of garlic powder.

Awesome!  I never have heavy cream so this is perfect.It tastes just like a restaurant and not fake like out of the jar. So easy too!! Perfect! Thanks for sharing!! No curdling problems here either this sauce was smooth as silk just soften the cream cheese first!
Update: I have been making this for years and still never a problem...this is an awesome recipe. I just throw a little salt in sometimes veggies and meat but always do the recipe as written. Perfect every time and everyone loves it! I have been making this forever...
Another update: to reheat cover with plastic wrap and it will stay creamy...
Pat liked this more than the traditional recipe. Quick and easy. Even reheated wonderfully (didn't separate like the real stuff does).

This was so yummy! My very picky daughter ate this up with no problem. The first time I made it I used shrimp..delicious! With the left-overs (which was quite a bit) I used turkey italian sausage. Double yummy! I even liked it & I do not like Italian Sausage, but with the sauce, it was so delicious! I can't say enough about this recipe! It is quick, yummy & makes a ton! Eat on!

This is a great easy recipe!!!

I cut the butter to five tablespoons; used the Parm in the green shaker jar (gasp); and added a sprinkle of oregano and cayenne. We thought the sauce was excellent. Not sure how that compares to Alfredo that’s NOT quick and easy!
I thought this came out incredibly good!  I used real butter, but fat free cream cheese and fat free milk...tasted great!

This recipe is wonderful!  I change it up for what I need.  I use cheddar when I want Mac and Cheese (and it doesn't have that flour taste in it). This is a great recipe to make extra of one day and then you have a second different kind of meal for later in the week. We LOVE this recipe!

It still tasted very good, but the flavor was MUCH richer and it was significantly thicker overall.  If you have trouble with the parmesan being too grainy or sticking to the bottom of the pot, try adding it right after mixing in the cream cheese and whisk well.  It will be super thick before adding the milk, but the parmesan will blend better.  If you are worried the 2c milk is too much, try mixing everything together and leaving it on low heat while you boil water for the pasta.  It will thicken alot as it cools too.  Other than that, the only real tweaking that I have done is to always ALWAYS add a healthy dash of oregano.  Other seasonings may come and go, but I find oregano essential for rounding out that Italian flavor. **update** Since a few reviews suggested nutmeg I decided to experiment on what I thought was already perfection and it was definitely worth it!  A good dash or two of nutmeg really adds depth and compliments the oregano too. **more update** For those who say they taste too much cream cheese, make sure you are using the whole 6oz of Parmesan. If you are using enough Parmesan it should become the dominant flavor.

This was fantastic! My only suggestion is adding the parmesan at the same time as the cream cheese, and leaving it on low while you boil noodles to allow it to thicken. Oregano also adds a really nice touch.

Yum and so easy to make!
This was good but mine turned out grainy.  Not sure if it's the type of Parmesan Cheese I used or what.  I would try again with didn't cheese.
I'm living in Bosnia and can't always find all the ingredients I need, but this was so easy and ingredient friendly, that I served up a terrific Chicken Alfredo.

This is a great recipe if you want Alfredo fast. I followed the recipe exactly and found it almost on the runny side (even after setting it aside) and ever so slightly bland (but I usually prefer foods to be saltier than the norm), and no, I didn't find the cream cheese to be overwhelming. Regardless, this is definitely a recipe worth trying, and it's a good one to customize to your own tastebuds with!
This was very easy to make and tasted really good. My son wont eat regular spaghetti sauce but he ate this stuff up. Looks like we are switching to this from now on
I sauteed fresh garlic, used 4 oz of parm., cheese, instead of 6 then before serving grated fresh parm cheese on top of dish.  It was very good
