To die for delicious!  Who would of thought cream cheeeese in alfredo sauce, WOW!

Outstanding recipe!! I lightened it up a bit by using fat-free half and half and reduced fat cream cheese. Also added steamed broccoli, cauliflower and carrot cuts and some grilled chicken. Everyone raved!

This was quick and easy and tasted so much better than the jarred stuff. I did use extra freshly grated parmesan, and a dash of nutmeg. I agree with the others, it does make a large portion of sauce, I mixed it with a bag of brocolli, carrot and shell blend with chicken breasts cut up in strips and browned. Excellent!
This recipe is incredibly quick and easy.  The sauce was great!  I added a bit more parmesan than advised, personal taste.

My husband and I love this alfredo sauce recipe. It is easy and quick. We love a rich sauce so I sometimes substitute the milk with whipping cream. No calorie counting here. It is wonderful. YUM!! May 8, 2003: I have made this sauce a hundred times with no problems and much success...until today when I used lowfat ingredients. I had a terrible time with it, the ingredients (which are the same as when previously made, except I used lowfat cream cheese and milk instead of half & half/cream in combination with milk) did not want to blend and the sauce never did get thick. I ended up adding additional Parmesan cheese and cream cheese...still no luck. Maybe I am used to a thick sauce but using the lowfat items was very disappointing. PS. I used the lower fat products because I am planning on freezing the sauce and was told that sometimes high fat items do not freeze well.

I followed the advice of a few other readers and used 1 1/3 cup milk, but I didn't have enough parmesan cheese, so I used grated mozarella too. It was very creamy and had great flavor, but a bit too much garlic for my taste...my husband loved it though, so it's a keeper. Next time I may cut the garlic in half and make sure I have enough parmesan. Great recipe, and you can't taste the cream cheese- easy super to make too.

I rated this recipe a 4.5 because there could have been more flavor to it. I added a bit of Italian herbs to it, and it seemed that it could have been a bit more salty. And, if you're eating for one, then scaling down the recipe to a serving size of one is more than enough for a plate of pasta. Good luck!

We loved this recipe, it was so simple and easy. I did make a couple changes. I added a tad of nutmeg to it to give it some zing. And I addes shrimp when I cooked the butter and let it simmer in the butter and garlic...it turned out very flavorful and tender-not chewy! I also added some salt, but it was unnecessary, I will omitt next time. The only down side is that I had way too much left over(its just me & dh), I will half the recipe next time.

This sauce is really delicious and easier than any Alfredo sauce I've ever made. I did, however, make one substitution - I used mascarpone instead of cream cheese to avoid that tangy cream cheese flavor. Everyone loved it and I will definitely make this again.
delicious! never buying store bought Alfredo again!!
This recipe is awesome! Super easy and tastes amazing...I used non-fat milk and added a bit of basil to it and it came out great. I highly recommend this Alfredo recipe to everyone.
Love this recipe

I found this recipe to be right on the money.  It was an absolute breeze to prepare, and the taste and texture were perfect.  I added two cans of chunk light tuna, in order to make a tuna alfredo for my 4 through 13 year old children.  They all loved it.  Next I will add some chopped ham instead of tuna, and ladel it over some sausage filled tortellini.

This is a great alfredo sauce.  I used real garlic, half the recommended amount of butter, and shredded refridgerated parmesan (not the fake stuff).  It's the perfect consistency for me.  Thick and creamy.  Wonderful!
Very easy. Great tasting

Love it! Tastes even better the next day, and doesn't get all weird and oily after being microwaved. I like to make this with chicken, broccoli and mushrooms. Don't worry if your sauce seems too thin when you're cooking it. It'll thicken a bunch as it cools!
Delicious but it makes a lot more than 4 servings - probably more like 8-10 servings.
Loved it!!!  Used low fat cream cheese and 1% milk. Was very good!!
Amazingly delicious base recipe. Super easy and tastes like I know what I'm doing, even if I don't.

Loved this! The only thing I did different from the suggested ingredients, is not use all 2 cups milk. I used approximately 1 1/2 cups skim milk. Thanks for sharing! This is now my go to recipe for Alfredo sauce!!

I followed the recipe exactly as written and used fresh grated parmesan. Although it looked great & was very creamy and smooth, it didn't taste great. We just didn't like the flavor. Four of the five in my household didn't like it. Next time I will try a more traditional Alfredo sauce.

This was delicious and very easy to make!  The only drawback was it was a little on the runny side so I had to add a thickening agent to it.  Next time I'll use only a cup and a half.  It looks scary when making as the cream cheese looks like its curdling or something but when you add the milk it turns right into the perfect sauce.  Def will use this again, thank you!
awesome sauce......thanks for sharing.....
LOVED this! I have never liked store boughten Alfredo Sauce and needed some to make Alfredo Potatoes. I cut the recipe in half and it was so easy to make and very delicious!

oooooooohhhhhhhhh ya! i'm all about quick and easy recipes that call for stuff i already have. this is definitely one of those. and it's awesome. made this with pasta, canned chicken, and some garlic bread and there's none left over. none. just awesome. thanks.
Husband loved the alfredo sauce.  Was very good.

This was delicious and super-easy!  I will definitely make this again.  The only thing I will do differently next time would be to either cook it a little longer or cut down on the milk.  It was a little runnier than I would have liked (but whether that's due to the recipe or the cook is yet to be seen).  Good stuff!
Easy and delicious, of course I added a few of my own favorites like extra garlic

A word of warning: this recipe calls for an absurd amount of garlic, and believe me, I love my garlic! I probably used half of a teaspoon and it was more than enough. It will look gross and scary while you're mixing the cream cheese and butter together, but it will magically turn into a perfect, creamy sauce as soon as you add the milk. This is great for people who are bad at making sauces, like me! Everyone loved it!
I use this recipe anytime I need a meal and I dont want to go to the store. It is delicious and since I started using it, I cant go back to the pre-made jar stuff! Its so easy and tastes 100x better!

this recipe is delicious. i usually don't change a thing when i make it but last time i did 1 1/2 c milk and a 1/2 c white wine. awesome. this also works great as a sauce for white pizza. thanks for the wonderful recipe!!

Wow, where was this recipe the first time I attempted Alfredo Sauce? This recipe is perfect exactly as written. I didn't change a thing except the quantity. I changed the portion size to one, and still ended up with 2 servings.
I don't change a thing and it the best alfredo sauce ever!!!
The melted butter and the cream cheese would not mix together at all! All I really tasted was the cream cheese. This did not taste anything like alfredo sauce.

I used fat-free cream cheese and reduced calorie margarine, and it still tasted great. I ate this with pasta shells and wished I had made enough for 10 more servings! The only thing was that I think it needed more garlic, I couldn't really taste it in this recipe. Just my tastes, though.

THIS WAS AMAZING!!! I was worried with some of the reviews I read but everyone who tasted this loved it. some of the reviews were correct it doesn't taste like the bland regular alfredo sauce, this has flavor and is just great!

Very rich and tasty, but really unhealthy. I made the following changes: same amount of butter, 1/4 package of cream cheese, 2 cups milk, a little extra parmesan,  1 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper, and corn starch to thicken it.
this sauce is almost pure fat... felt guilty all the way through eatingit...   however it tasted OK

This alfredo sauce was great! I had a chipolte pasta so I spiced up the sauce a little bit with 3/4 tsp of chili powder and 1/8 tsp of cayenne  pepper, 1 tsp onion powder and a little more black pepper. I will definitely be using this recipe again :)

I halved the recipe since I was only cooking for myself, and I used a cheese other than Parmesan. It's really really good but I would add a little less cream cheese and a bit more salt if I made it again!

This is my "old standby" recipe.  My whole family (including my very picky 3 year old) loves it.  I love that it doesn't seperate like most Alfredo suaces when refrigerated, and it is just as good the next day.  This recipe makes plenty for lunch the next day. This is one of the best Alfredo sauces we have ever had and it's so easy.  I will try adding nutmeg next time, but I can't imagine it getting any better!
Oh my gosh, the reviews don't lie!!! Olive Garden eat your heart out!!!

Excellent Sauce, my husband doesn't like much of anything made with pasta. I made this added a little parsley and poured it over pasta shells and imitation crab. Believe it or not he ate three helpings!
By far the best Alfredo Sauce that me or my family have tried.
I greatly enjoyed eating this, however it didn't thicken as quickly as I hoped.  I also didn't particularly care for the garlic powder.  Next time I will most likely use fresh garlic.

This is an excellent base for Alfredo sauce. What I did to beef it up a bit was to add Basil (didn't have fresh, so used dried). I started with 1/4 tsp., whisked it in, added a wee bit more (by the pinch) until I got the level of Basil that I liked.  I also added a scant 1/4 tsp. of ground nutmeg, some chopped freeze-dried Italian parsley.  I did up the Parmesan to 1 cup, though.  I was making Italian stuffed chicken breasts and instead of using a marinara sauce on top, I topped it with some of this sauce after baking them sprinkled with more Parmesan cheese before baking.  The remainder of the sauce I added to Fettucine, after blending in some steamed chopped broccoli for a side dish.  Serve with a crusty Italian bread, some herb-olive oil for dunking the bread and an Italian salad--complete meal!

Wonderful!!! this is so good and so easy! I've made other Alfredo recipes from this site, but this is by far the best!!! I made mine for a party. Once it was the right consistency I added peeled shrimp and served atop whole wheat spaghetti. Added a dash of oregano and parsley on top as garnish which next time I'll actually include while simmering. A+++++ a real winner with the whole family!

This sauce was really good but nothing special. I have used other recipes on this site before that I think I like better. However like I said it was very good and would make again. I like how few ingredients you need for this recipe. I used a little more cheese then called for and added nutmeg. I think if I make this again I will use half milk and half and half or whipping cream to thicken it up so I dont have to use so much cheese.

I'm Italian, and pride myself on knowing good Italian food. And this sauce seriously surprised me. The only thing I did differently was scale the recipe down to two servings. That was still enough for my husband and me to have 2 bowls each.
Easy, easy Alfredo sauce. The next day, when heating up the pasta, it doesn't separate into that oil yucky mess that some sauces do. It makes a huge batch and is a bit rich...but YUM!
This was really good and it was super fast to make! Everyone loved it!

Wow!  This tastes exactly like the chicken alfredo from Olive Garden!  This was so easy, I had it made in 30 mins. Wow!  When I first saw this recipe I was thrown by the cream cheese and never would have tried it if it weren't for all the good reviews.  I'm so glad I did. I love this recipe. I use fresh garlic when i have it on had. I have gotten dozens of compliments on it. Thanks for this simple delicious dish!!

Great alfredo sauce!  I too had the cream cheese get clumpy, but when i added the milk it mixed in fine.  I served this for company (I used the pesto chicken florentine recipe from this site) and everyone loved it!

Tasted pretty good and was easy to make. I used neufchatel cheese which is the lower fat cream cheese and I wouldn't recommend that because it created a texture that was a bit grainy. This also could use some salt.  I think anyway, I'm pregnant and I think my taste buds changed a bit.  I definitely added a lot of salt :) I will still make this because, as the title indicates, it is quick and easy to make.
I liked this sauce a lot. I think that a problem for me though was the sauce was kind of grainy.

Wow, I just made this for dinner and it was wonderful! My husband was floored and said it was better than Olive Garden's! I for sure think it is a very close second! I can only imagine the fat content but oh my is it worth it! Print this out and save it forever more! I will never make another alfredo sauce :o)

Easy and yummy. I use the low fat cream cheese, reduced fat Parmesan and 2% milk and it's creamy and thickens nicely. We toss it all together with pasta, chicken, and broccoli and the whole family - including a 4 and almost 2 year old - loves it!

I've used this many times now, and everyone loves it in my house (me, husband, 2 small kids).  It's super easy to make and tastes oh so good!   If it looks too lumpy in the early stages, don't worry, once you add the milk, it smooths right out. Yum!
Made This && It Was So Good! Never Buying Any Can Made Sauce Again!
This is delicious. I made it with whipped garlic and herb cream cheese and being from New Mexico I added Green Chile! Sublime
Love this recipe! It tastes so good! This is a keeper!
Excellent! Very creamy and easy to make. A definate keeper.

I just made this recipe (halved since I didn't have tons of macaroni to top) and I thought it was very good. Excellent recipe and so easy to make. I sauted fresh garlic in the butter instead of using garlic powder and the taste is awesome! I also saute some vegetables on the side (onions, bell peppers, mushrooms and zucchini) seasoned with dried basil and oregano and add it to the sauce in the end. The recipe is a definite keeper.
This recipe is just as easy as a packet and tastes better, courtesy of no added preservatives. My husband did suggest adding a bit more pepper next time.

Thanks for posting this! This was really good!  I think like anything with parmesan cheese, the quality of your cheese will really make a difference in the flavor. perfection!
As promised this is both quick and easy! Super delish as is or with a little buffalo sauce added for a quick Louisiana Fettuccine. Yummy!
I made this exactly as stated, delicious!!!! I did have to use more milk to thin the consistency. When it was all done my shrimp & broccoli surpassed Copper River's!

If you follow the recipe exactly, you will end up with a delicious Alfredo Sauce. But this recipe is perfect for 'tweeking' to your liking too. I often add roasted garlic instead of powdered garlic and I use low fat cream cheese - scrumptious!! I also occasionally add some Italian spices like basil and oregano and sometimes parsley. This is just a super easy, super delicious sauce that you can customize to your family's tastes.

I followed another reviewer's advice and added tsp minced garlic and reduced milk to 1 1/3 cups and parmesan to 4 oz (good thing - only had 4!). When whisking the cream cheese into the butter I did panic at first. It was VERY lumpy and didn't look like it would smooth out. Even though it said "until smooth" I didn't think it was smooth. The cream cheese just wouldn't incorporate totally with the butter. It almost looked like curdled milk. So I just added the milk anyways a little at a time. The more milk I added, the smoother it became. It wasn't lumpy at all and was quite yummy. The whole family agreed!  Oh and I also added about a Tbsp of dried parsley near the end too - just for a bit more flavor and color.  Definitely recommend and will make again!

This is a great recipe! So easy and so delicious! I made this for a last minute fix for dinner. And it was a HIT! I made this with linguini, steamed broccoli and Lasagna Fritters and it made the perfect meal!

I LOVE this sauce.  It's creamy, easy and delicious.  I used fresh garlic rather than garlic powder, and sauteed it in the butter before adding the cream cheese.  I also took some reviewers' advice and added nutmeg, oregano and basil.  It turned out wonderfully.

You HAVE TO try this recipe!  It is soooo YUMMY!  The first time I made this I used fat-free cream cheese and I didn't like it at all. My go-to recipe. Tastes just as good with half the butter, and shredded Parmesan is much easier to work with than grated.

Would make it again, but I liked just the cream cheese, butter and garlic. After adding the Parmesan it had a funny texture too it. Very quick and very easy though

Best ever!! All the same ingredients as it said just did my own moderation. Everyone in my house loved it! Never will I buy it from a store! Thanks!! ??

Added a medium chopped onion, some sliced mushrooms, and fresh garlic to the butter. I was disappointed to say the least not tasty at all.
Made it exactly as written - excellent!!

used whipping cream instead of milk because it was what I had on hand and it worked out great! We also used fresh garlic instead of the garlic powder and just browned it in the butter. DELICIOUS! Quick and easy. Who could ask for more?!
Absolutely delicious, used shrimp. The best Alfredo we have ever had!
Love it!! super easy, had to add some salt for a little more taste and used fresh garlic.

I love alfredo sauce, but I rarely find one that I really like.  This sauce was amazing.  My husband doesn't care for pasta, and this is one of his new favorites.  I used hamburger with this sauce, on top of macaroni noodles.  I also added more cheese to it.  Wonderful!

My family loved it!  I used half and half instead of milk and also used minced garlic along with the garlic powder!  I peared it with chicken and have enough left over to use shrimp another day as I made enough for leftovers.
This is an awesome recipe. Will be making again!

Wow! I have gone to many expensive italian restaurants and my mom and I think that this is the best fettucine that we have ever had before! Thanks for sharing this:) You really do have to add the cream cheese a little bit at a time and only add about half of the garlic that is called for.
add cream cheese for a creamier sauce. 8 oz should be good.

I haven't had too many alfredo sauces, but this is by far the best I've had. I even made a mistake and put the parmesan in with the garlic before putting in the cream cheese. No more jar or dry envelope alfredo sauce for us here, definitely will be making this one again.
so good! and it uses ingredients i usually keep on hand. love it!

my husband LOVES this one!!  Thank you!!

As advertised it's quick and easy, tastes great.  I added a bit of salt and a pinch of fresh ground nutmeg to enhance and make a simple dish seem gourmet.

Excellent recipe: cheap, quick and easy (ideal for students, even)! This is the kind of recipe that doesn't test my cooking expertise, and makes me come off as a pro. My boyfriend loved it. So good did chicken in small cubes with onion and fresh garlic stir fried browned a little let it sit with lid on while I made the sauce
Absolutely wonderful!!! Made this with fettuccini. Added steamed broccoli and grilled chicken. My entire family LOVED it. Also re-heats very well for left overs.

Made this sauce and poured it over some thin spaghetti noddles and chopped chicken breast and it was delicious. I really didnt expect it to turn out so well, but this sauce was extremely tasty. it was an extra dish for a party and everyone thought it tasted great.
This is my husband's favorite Alfredo recipe.  If he knows that I am planning to make it the following weekend, he will spend the entire week talking about it at work.

This is simple and yummy.  I followed the recipe exactly.  I did half the recipe for just me and my husband without leftovers and it was perfect!  Very easy and very flavorful.

this was wonderful!! i added some frozen spinach  and had spinach Alfredo! amazing and cheap!

not bad, but not like an alfredo. Is a quick tasty white sauce that seems easy to change the seasonings with

I would ABSOLUTELY give this ecipe four stars if i could as well, with a few changes (which others mentioned).  Namely, fresh minced garlic in place of the powder, less milk.  And be patient! This was awesome.  I had all the ingredients at hand.  The only negative part was that I wayyyyy overate!

Thank you for this easy recipe!  It's great because I always have these ingredients on hand, and it so simple!  Taste great too! I only had onion and chive cream cheese on hand, but still it turned out outstanding.  Thank you!  His is a keeper!

This was easy and tasted ok.  I am a salt freak so I had to add alot and the garlic powder wasn't enough garlic flavor for me.  I did add some extras to this recipe.  (shrimp, sun dried tomatoes, red pepper).  Overall was easy and good.
followed revised recipe

Truth be told, I am an awful cook. I can mess up even the simplest recipes...but not this one! So easy, ingredients are cheap and are generally on hand, and very tasty. I had it with basil pesto-filled pasta - a great combo!
This sauce tasted wonderful!  Mine was a little grainy, but that's because I used that dry parmesan in the plastic can, next time I will use freshly grated.
By far the best.  Much better than store bought.

This is soooo good. Excellent. Thanks Dawn.
WOW!!! I have never tasted a yummier alfredo sauce...even in the fanciest of pasta restaurants!!! Definitely quick and easy to make as well =)
This is my husbands favorite meal! Thank you for such a simply delicious recipe!

Delicious and easy to make healthier! I used fat-free cream cheese, lowfat butter made from yogurt, and added in some fat-free sour cream to make a lower fat cream sauce.  It went wonderfully with chicken and vegetables!
This recipe was great.  I added some fresh parsley, spinach, and some pork sausage seasoned with italian seasonings.  I also added 1 Tbsp of cornstarch to help thicken it.  Definitely a keeper.

Really great sauce, I just added some onions and shrimp to it and it was amazing!!!!!

THE best alfredo sauce I have come across!! I knew with the reviews it had to be good but once we tasted it..it was out of this world. Made this for the  Support Our Troops motorcycle ride on an open gas BBQ grill. It was easy and very good.

It was easy and tasty - a good base sauce - I sprinkled some salt on my portion and of course my meat eater husband wanted some chicken in it ;) I used half and half but I am sure milk would have been fine

This made a very good, creamy sauce. I added some extra spices: lemon pepper, nutmeg, and italian seasoning. Didn't quite need all the milk... had about 1/2 cup left over. Served over bucatini and broccoli. Yum! Thanks.

Great recipe.  I took the advice of other reviewers and added 1/2 chopped onion and 2 garlic cloves to butter as it melted, and used less milk (about 1 1/4 cup). I also added some Italian herbs and a few red pepper flakes.  DELICIOUS.

Amazing recipe! Very delicious!

LOVE this recipe, for so many reasons!  The kids LOVED it, it has a great garlic flavor w/out bits of garlic.  The consistency is perfect and it reheats beautifully!

This is a FANTASTIC recipe!! I decided to try it after reading all the great reviews and everyone is right...it is just as good if not better than Olive Garden and so quick and easy! My husband is very hard to please and he loved it! Thanks so much for posting such a terrific sauce!!!!!

This was soooo good!! I had to try making it a couple times, tweak it to my tasting, and now I will never go jar again!! Only two things I did different was a dash of nutmeg and I used Kraft 3 cheese blend (Parmesan, Romano & Asiago).... Thanks for this recipe!!
Delicious and so easy to make! Made it for my Bible Study group and everyone loved it! I made the recipe exactly as written and wouldn't change a thing. Thanks Dawn for sharing!

The base to this recipe is wonderful! But, I changed it up a bit, like I always do haha probably why I am so fat! My family kept saying it was better than a restaurant.....MMM MMMM! We had this with the Chicken Cordon Bleu II from this site.

This is an excellent alfredo sauce that is easy to make and delicious.  You would never guess that it is made with cream cheese.  There might be a little too much garlic powder for some.  Thanks for a great recipe!

Excellent recipe and soooo delicious! I scaled it back to one serving and it made enough for at least 2 people! needs more garlic and fresh or dried parsley. otherwise it was awesome. my husband raved! i added frozen broccoli to the sauce. i made the simply Parmesan chicken with it. very fast and delicious dinner!

I LOVED this sauce!  It tasted great, and totally fooled my foodie date.  I put it in a lasagna so I wasn't too worried about the consistency. It does not taste jarred at all, unlike what some other reviewers had to say.  Jarred sauce is disgusting.  Make sure you use regular cream cheese, and not low fat.
Aweaome, delicious and straight to the point.. i tweaked it with Italian seasoning but that is just for my taste... bingo bango boom its dinner... thank you

Excellent!  I used real garlic cloves and only 2 tbsp light margarine, skim milk, and low fat cream cheese.  My family couldn't get enough of it.

This is the best alfredo I have ever had!  This completely outshines Olive gardens alfredo.  When I made mine, my brother was supposed to be helping but he walked off so the butter burnt a bit, but it still tasted amazing in the end.

One thing is probably key...use freshly grated Parmesan cheese. That junk that is pregrated has ingredients in it to prevent it from clumping together in the package, which also prevents the cheese from melting smoothly in a sauce recipe (same with other pregrated or preshredded cheeses...these are okay as toppings for things like tacos, but terrible for melting/using in sauces). This was how I made it: 1/2 cup butter with 2 cloves minced garlic heated just under medium till melted, added 8oz cream cheese and "whisked" (stirred around) until it became "smooth" (almost like a cottage cheese consistency... it never actually gets "smooth" at this stage), slowly added 1 3/4 cup almond milk and cream and water mixture (mostly cream) because I didn't have straight milk, whisked till smooth, added 1 cup of grated parm (a little more than 6oz) and stirred till melted, added about 1/8 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp of italian seasonings by the end and about 1/2 tsp of salt. Thickened up nicely even after being tossed with pasta. Nom nom nom nom nom.

My husband is on board to do Low Carb diet and has already lost 8 lbs! Here are the Changes I made: I DID use the REAL stick BUTTER , not margarine I used Spreadable Whipped Cream Cheese (All I had on hand) I used 1 cup Half & Half and 1 cup milk instead of the two cups of milk (to reduce carbs) To reduce carbs even more I could have used two cups half and half but I didn't want to use up all my half and half that I need in the morning for my coffee LOL. I used the Kraft REAL grated Parmesan cheese that comes in the plastic shaker tube thing. I did not use 6 ounces. I used less .. about 4. When I placed 6 ounces of the cheese on my scale it was a HUGE pile and the smaller amount seemed fine. It takes a long time to melt the real harder pieces of parmesan grated cheese. They take forever to melt .. but patience is KEY.  Because you don't want to boil it or the milks can curdle.  The sauce was SO SCRUMPTIOUS. Smooth. RICH. Too bad I can't have it over pasta LOL since I am watching my carbs right now.  They do make Dreamfields low carb pasta but I am not sure I trust that it is Truly low carb. I did 'steal' a few ingredients from my old one to spice this one up a bit such as 1/4 cup of olive oil added to 1/4 cup of butter to cut down on some of the fat.  I also used a 1/4 cup of white wine, 1/4 cup of half and half milk and 3/4 cup of whole milk.  Instead of garlic powder I used minced garlic.  Along with the grated Parmesan cheese (yes, in the green can), I used a handful of shredded Kraft Mexican Four Cheese Blend.  Spices/herbs thrown in (just a dash) were ground red pepper, nutmeg, oregano, parsley, and basil.  We didn't taste the cream cheese either.  I know I changed the recipe quite a bit, but I've been making the same Alfredo sauce for a few years now and I know what we like.  Adding these other ingredients to this recipe made it taste like the sauce we have come to love....it was just quicker and easier for me to make.  Thanks for sharing the secret of cream cheese.

Everyone knows that jarred alfredo sauce is nasty, so I gave this a try instead. While it was really easy to make (delightfully so, actually) I would definitely cut down on the garlic in the future as it was all I could taste. My mother thought it was great, however, so I guess it's just my own personal preference.

good! It took kind of a while to thicken, so I added a little more parmesan cheese to help speed things up a little. Definitely stir often, or this will scorch on the bottom of the pan. I used this both on pasta and as the alfredo sauce for Artichoke & Spinach Dip Restaurant Style. Very yummy :)
This is the easiest alfredo sauce I have ever made and it tastes Delicious! This is definitely a favorite in my house :)
This easy recipe has become a monthly dish in our home.  Can't get enough of it!

I had to use part butter part margarine, but it was good. A little salty by itself, but good for flavoring the noodles and broccoli. I guess I don't eat the sauce by itself anyway, except for tasting. Lol.mine looked clumpy until milk was in, but thinned out beautifully.  I did low- medium until the milk was added, then turned to low, stirring occasionally, and it thickened a little, then turned off heat, and just left it on the burner, and it has a great consistency. Will make again.

Very good sauce and easy to make.  Usually I would not have cream cheese on hand but I did today.
I added some garlic salt as my stick butter was unsalted also more cheese, yay!!  Really good!!

Doubled the Ingredients to make enough for 6 people and added some Italian seasoning  and frozen broccoli to sauce. For meat I baked 3 chicken beast @ 400 for 45 min with salt, pepper, and paprika. I cut the chicken into diagonal medallions and placed on top  of sauce ,over peni regatta  mixed with butter, garlic powder, and pepper. I am a stay at home dad trying to learn how to cook for 3 picky teenagers and they loved it. I thought it was awesome as well.
I'm not a huge Alfredo fan but my daughter loved this.  Very easy to make. Followed recipe as written.
This is by far the best Alfredo sauce I have made, and I've tried many.  My children and husband all complimented me with how yummy it was.  Simple, easy, and delicious.
Super quick and easy!! This will be my go to when I need to whip up something fast for dinner. I added chicken to my pasta and my 8year old loved it!
love it! Use it all the time!

This was very good, although it was less 'creamy' than I was hoping and the parmesan still felt a little grainy, even after thorough cooking. In the pan, the sauce looked very watery. Once it got on the pasta, though, it thickened up much more than I had expected...put more on than you think! I agree with other reviewers, this makes a lot of sauce; half this recipe was comfortably enough for 3 people. Overall satisfying on many levels; easy, inexpensive, quick, and tasty!
FANTASTIC! Used 1/3 fat cream cheese and reduced fat margarine. Probably the best alfredo sauce I've ever made.

I didn't have Parmesan but I did have Gruyere!  I used that and added some chopped fresh basil and chopped fresh oregano. This sauce made my head explode with flavor! It was AWESOME. I don't think I'll be able to buy alfredo in a jar ever again after this.
Excellent Recipe and so easy.  Thanks for sharing this with us.

I used both grated gouda cheese, parmesan cheese, fresh garlic and doubled the recipe, it  turned out AMAZING.
Definitely have this recipe saved for use more often.

Very good and easy. However, I like to use fresh pressed garlic instead of garlic powder. I sautee it with the butter. I added shrimp to the sauce at the end and then stirred in some cooked penne pasta. Yummy.
easy and delicious, what more is there? made almost exactly as written (used fresh garlic instead of powder) and it was enough for two meals. I'll be making this again, maybe add some nutmeg
Love it! Soooo good and easy :D
Great recipe!  I used minced garlic insted of powder because I was out.  My wife and I loved it!

Yummy!  And definitely super easy, which was the best part.  I'll certainly make it again!  I used skim milk and light cream cheese, and next time I might try dropping some of the butter to lighten things up a bit more, but it was definitely easy and tasty.

This quite simply is the best alfredo sauce!!  Everyone I have made this for absolutely loves it.  Very quick and easy and I haven't had to change a thing.  I also tried many other alfredo sauces and nothing comes close to this one!
This is a wonderful recipe! You can omit the parmesan cheese if you don't have any, and it is good as well. I have tried it both ways.
Awesome.  Delicious every time!
Very nice and easy to make.

Very easy and very delicious! I used whole milk. I did have a little trouble at first, it seemed that the butter and cream cheese were never going to mix but I added a tbsp of flour and started adding the milk and it came together.

I made a double batch of this for a dinner party this past weekend. I was skeptical because of the lack of heavy cream but it was fantastic! I used fresh garlic sautéed in the butter and a touch of nutmeg. I did add chicken to the top of mine. I also have to say this was even better the next day! I am making this again tonight, great recipe!
Incredibly easy, rich and tasty sauce.  You can lighten it up too use low fat products.  I LOVED it!  Thanks!!!

I was able to make this recipe which turned out well but I had to substitute a few items.  I found that I only had 1/2 a block of cream cheese and no milk but heavy cream.  I didn't have garlic powder but garlic salt and I added two tablespoons of sugar.  It turned out really good.  My son says it had great flavor.
best alfredo I have ever made

This is not only quick and easy, but very delicious. It got rave reviews from my family as well! For those who are wondering about how the cream cheese works with this recipe, you can't even detect that it is an ingredient, it adds a wonderful creaminess to the sauce though. I used half skim milk and half cream. Stir occasionally to prevent lumps from forming, sauce will thicken as it cooks and as it cools. Season to taste and you'll have the perfect alfredo sauce. Wonderful creation Sarah, thanks so much for sharing.

Delicious!!!! I love Alfredo but rarely eat it because the heavy cream upsets my stomach, so the cream cheese is an awesome factor here! I stuck with the recipe except for  substituting margarine for butter and adding some parsley flakes in!! Will definitely make again!!
I did add a little Cajun seasoning to spice it up....my family loves this recipe and it is a cheap quick meal !
love it!!
Great with "zoodles"!!

So delicious!  I don't understand anyone who DOESN'T love this recipe.  It's simple, full of flavor, and reheats well.  It's a heck of a lot cheaper than those prepackaged sauces, plus tastes far more authentic to me.  I do add a bit more garlic powder & pepper than what's called for, plus some salt.  YUM CITY.
Easy and the kids loved it!
This was a phenomenal alfredo sauce. I made it as is and it turned out perfectly. Next time, I think I might add a bit less milk and some oregano like some other reviewers suggested.
I would rather just use heavy cream and make Alfredo the traditional way.  You could totally taste cream cheese in this which doesn't belong in Alfredo sauce!!

It was definitely cheesier than store bought, but the texture came out just a little grainy.  Taste was fine.  I cut down the calories by using neufchatel cheese.  Still used whole milk b/c I was concerned about altering the recipe too much.

Update:  I added more milk when reheating to thin out the sauce, and it turned out markedly better.
Tasty bit for the record if you go to Alfredo's in Rome you will ind out all that goes in Alfredo sauce is butter and Parm CHeese Period

Absolutely amazing! I had used another recipe from this site with an equally high rating & it doesn't even compare with this one. I tripled the garlic, as I can't get enough. Also, I did what other reviewers had suggested and added some nutmeg. C'était si bon!
This recipe is a staple in my kitchen. I rarely use jarred sauce anymore, this is just so simple!
Very delicious and easy! I did use a fresh garlic clove, an changed 1 cup to half and half.

this is a GREAT alfredo-type sauce.  I don't put garlic powder in it.  I do add a grating of fresh nutmeg though and it is wonderful.
thanks for this easy recipe - I can't stand that jarred alfredo stuff!!

WOW!!  I tried this tonight - as the recipe stated... WOW!  Season to taste- that's all I can say.  It's rude to say you "tweaked" the recipe.  As is- season to taste - wowowowoweeee.....  My kid- who is picky- very picky.... Gobbled it up... Preperation time is longer than 5 minutes thoough..  Slow - low heat... cream cheese already at or above room temp...  Big hit!!  So easy!   Thank you Dawn!

Simple and fantastic.  Loved how I had everything in the fridge or cupboard.  I used this and added fresh garlic, onions, mushrooms, aspearagus.  When poured over pasta, DELICIOUS!!!!  Thanks, a keeper.

Loved this recipe! It was really flavorful and my family loved it. I did not have regular cream cheese though and instead used onion and chive cream cheese, still it turned out great. I also did not use all of the garlic powder that the recipe called for. I thought it was too much. I used about 1 tsp garlic powder. Still this recipe was amazing and I will definitely make this sauce again.
WONDERFUL!!!!!!!!!! It was so quick and easy. I omitted the Parmesan cheese, but it was still wonderful. Thanks for the great recipie.
Can't believe how easy and delicious this is! We love it!!

rich tasting, and easy to make!  added cooked shrimp, broccoli and pasta to serve for supper, it was great.  Made as listed.  next time I will add some seasonings as others did - maybe the dash of nutmeg and some basil.  but as shown it was a great sauce!
Very delicious. Easy to make.

This is really good and incredibly easy recipe.  I swapped out 1/2 cup of 2% milk for heavy cream and it was divine.   I also used fresh garlic (about 1 TBSP) that I added to the melting butter.  Before you start hating me for changing a recipe and rating it, I had to get rid of the heavy cream before it went bad. 

Also - for those that are saying that cream cheese shouldn't be used, cream cheese can be used in most recipes as substitute for heavy cream as long as the recipe doesn't require the cream to be whipped.  I didn't taste cream cheese at all.

One really good tip that I could have used... this makes a ton of sauce.  Easily enough for 2 pounds of pasta (pre cooking weight).  I cooked only a small package of pasta, and had to cook a second box just to have enough pasta for the sauce.

I also threw in some grilled chicken and it was excellent together.  Great recipe and much  easier than traditional alfredo.

I was pleasantly surprised with the cream cheese.  I did use my chicken drippings along with garlic, scallions and fresh herbs (in cheese cloth) and white wine reduction before adding the cream cheese and milk.  The sauce easily allows for lots of herbs and garlic so don't be shy in using them.  Brilliant idea!
Loved it!  LOw carb sauce.  Served it over broccoli and put grilled chicken on top!
I add the juice from the cooked chicken to the cream sauce. Delicious!!!
yes, i added in oregano and basil leaves. yes, i will definitely make it again.

What a great recipe! I even cheated- didn't want to run to the grocery store for real butter & fresh parmesan, so I used margarine and grated parmesan- just added it really slowly. Also added 1/2 & 1/2 milk and heavy cream.
Very yummy sauce.  My husband & I made this for about 18 people.  It was delicious.  We used penne pasta and added italian sausage on the side.
Pretty good.  I followed the recipe exactly and the sauce was still a little lumpy and lacking a little in flavor.
This was so easy and very tasty.  I make it all the time.

I made half a batch. I went by recipe but didn't drag out my measuring cups, hit or miss I did approximately the same other than I had a bit of heavy cream so I added it with the milk (skim) AND used my jar of chopped garlic instead of powder..I like both. Also I  had a bowl of graded parmesan instead of my usual "spaghetti" parm which will work ok as well.
This is AMAZING! I added basil and fresh roasted garlic instead of powdered though. Thanks so much!

This is awesome for being thrown together with ingredients I had on hand.  I used skim goat milk, whipped cream cheese, powdered Kraft Parmesan, and added Italian seasoning (literally what I had on hand).  I followed Reg927s suggestions and it came out great.  Oh, and it makes a lot more than 4 servings- there's a ton of leftover sauce, but that's okay, my husband said he's looking forward to leftovers!
This recipe was wonderful and super quick and easy. Will make again and again! The only change I made was I cooked fresh garlic in the butter instead of garlic powder, then added cream cheese.

This was weird.  The parmesean would not melt even though I cooked it a long time (~30 minutes).  I used cheese that I had grated myself about an hour before using it so I thought the fresh cheese would be good.  The butter also started to separate from the cream cheese and milk.  Whenever it wasn't being stirred, the butter rose to the top.  I've made better alfredo so I won't try this again.

After eating @ an italian restaurant this past wknd, I wanted to duplicate the amazing meal we had. Tortellini in alfredo sauce with prosciutto. I will say, I think my meal was as good if not better than theirs. I tripled the recipe (big family), & added minced garlic, otherwise, made exactly as recipe indicates. It made a huge batch. The only thing I'd do differently is cut down on the butter, especially if I triple the batch. It was plenty rich on it's own. I may add peas or asparagus to it next time with the prosciutto. Add some candles, a glass of wine and some bread and you just created a very romantic getaway to Italy. YES, it's that good!   UPDATE: made this a second time & used diced, store bought, pre-cooked chicken & added broccoli that I had partially steamed. Again, very yummy. This is a nice basic recipe for the sauce. You can snazz it up any way you'd like.

so easy and so good! One batch makes enough for a pound of cooked egg noodles.  I also added just a pinch of nutmeg.  Not cream cheesy at all, just rich and delish.  No more boxed noodles for me!  Thanks

WOW!! I had to throw a quick dinner together and pasta is always the choice.  Since I had no alfredo sauce I looked to the intranet and found this one.  Amazingly good ~ better than my favorite brand and very easy to make.  I don't think I will even bother to purchase it anymore... home made it much better!!
I was amazed  at how easy this recipe was and how fantastic it tastes!  I want to put this on everything I eat!  Really thank you for an easy and quick recipe that will certainly be a keeper.
Fantastic! Added 1 cube of chicken stock. Thanks!
I love cream cheese, but it wasn't like a real Alfredo sauce.  My son loved it so maybe I'll use less cream cheese and more of something else.  We shall see ...
So easy!!!

FABULOUS this sauce was not only easy to make, but it also tastes better than the one you buy in a jar from the grocery store that are supposed to taste restaruant style. This is restaraunt style. Thank you for this recipe.

My son really likes this recipe.  It's the only one we make at our house for alfredo.  It freezes well.  To reheat frozen portions, warm in a skillet with a bit of milk and it works really well. We like it better reheated than the first time around.

Wonderful alfredo sauce!  My husband and I absolutely love this recipe.  It is so quick and easy and never turns out bad.  If we have fresh garlic on hand we swap a clove or two for the garlic powder.  I normally will use 1 cup of half-and-half and 1 cup low-fat milk.  This is delicious time and time again!
Delicious! It’s a keeper! Used everything with the only change being I used 1 c milk and 1 cup heavy cream. Family loved it.
this was so much fun to recreate!

OMG so tasty. I gave it 4 stars because I tweaked the recipe a bit. I first melted only 1/4 stick of butter and threw in some fresh chopped garlic. I then added low fat cream cheese until melted. Added only about 1 1/4 cup of 2% milk then seasoned w/ salt, pepper, & a dash of nutmeg. Oh and I also put in about 1/4 cup of shredded aged parmesan cheese.  Served it with pumpkin ravioli's. My hubby and I ate almost the whole thing ourselves!
This is good and so EASY!  My daughters love alfredo sauce so it's nice to have a recipe that I can use to whip it up real quick as needed.

Really good! I added a little less garlic and it was a little bit too thin. Easy to fix by adding a little more Parmesan cheese. I halved the recipe because I didn't need as much. It was plenty. I definitely recommend this. Be careful with the garlic thought! :-)

Quick & Easy!!! That's a plus with a 3yr old! This was really easy and really good.After reading some of the other reviews I only used a little garlic powder. Poured this over my noodles and broccoli. Delicious! Will make again!

Recipe is just as it states .. quick and easy.  The description is missing one thing, however, delicious.  I was sceptical about using cream cheese, but it's great.  Holds together well also vs. cream and butter which tends to seperate.  I highly recommend this one.  As my husband said .. "this one is a keeper"!  Enjoy  :)

Super simple and delicious recipe! I loved that I had all of these ingredients on hand. I did, however, substitute fresh garlic for the garlic powder and I also added Slap Ya Mama seasoning because I like food on the spicy side. Very tasty! I will be adding this to our regular menu. Thank you for sharing! :)

I made a carbonara on this site last night and the family did not like it....I didn't want to throw it out since ingredients were expensive. So, made the easy alfredo sauce and OMG.....it is delicious on its own but did the miracle of making the left over carbonara into a dish the hubby wanted seconds...Thanks Dawn!
This was soo easy to prepare! My husband, of course was skeptical, and frankly so was I despite the reviews! It was so delicious! We're having it again tonight!

My keeper recipe for Alfredo Sauce! A little nutmeg in the sauce is a must! (I've used this recipe many times, but this latest time I added fresh minced chives.  The first of the season from my herb garden!)

Words cannot express how much I love this recipe. I usually use low or no fat milk and cream cheese and it's still awesome (if a little thin). I always throw in a few crushed garlic cloves in addition to the garlic powder to more closely mimic the sauce at my favorite italian restaurant.

This recipe is absolutely wonderful! I used fat free cream chees, 2% milk, and low fat parmesean. I also added crawfish tails, shrimp, and crab meat (not imitation). I cut back on the milk some as I didn't want it too runny. This recipe is definately a keeper at my house! Thanks for sharing.
Absolutely perfect! I added slightly more parmesan but only because we love it. Thanks-a-million! :-)
This made a really good sauce, and I still can't believe how quick and easy it was! I will absolutely make this again.
Simple & easy!  Everyone enjoyed this dish.  I used low fat cream cheese & 1% milk, also used fresh minced garlic.  I had some left over spinach that I added as well.

Amazing! Let me tell you, I will not order anything with Alfredo at restaurants as I'm afraid of the homemade stuff and it alwayz tasted weird to me. Yes, I preferred jarred sauce. I have made this numerous times (never really knowing if I'm using as much cheese as it calls for) and it is amazing! I have stopped buying jarred! As is this recipe is amazing, and it plays nice with adding anything (cayan, chipotle peppers, mushrooms).

This recipe is awesome!!! It will replace the one I already have in my file. I made two changes. I used fresh garlic and I used half milk and half cream because I'm not worried about the fat content. It does make alot, at least enough for four adults. Not sure how it reheats, I havn't tried to reheat it yet. Yummy, thanks!
When I made this recipe I used cooking cream instead of cream cheese it's not so thick so no lumps formed

This is a great recipe for Alfredo sauce. The only thing different I do is I add another tsp of garlic powder, leave out the pepper, and use less milk. I don't measure the milk I just put enough in to make it thick and creamy. If I have any leftover, which is usually not the case as my family loves this, I do need to add more milk. It becomes pretty solid after it is refrigerated, because I don't use as much milk as the recipe calls for. When my kids' friends come for dinner they always ask, "are you making Alfredo tonight?"

wow this was so easy to make and so delicious! 
i halved the recipe and it made exactly enough sauce for 4.

I really liked this recipe. It doesn't taste exactly like an alfredo sauce made from a roue but it was very fast and still delicious! Instead of using garlic powder I used fresh garlic. I think that makes a big difference. I also added grilled chicken cut into strips and sliced mushrooms and my husband and I couldn't get enough of it!
Great recipe!! I didn't make any changes. I will use this again..
I love it all my family loves it and it hard to satisfy all my kids and husband feeds all 5 of us and have lunch for the next day

This recipe is more expensive to make than buying the jar alfredo sauce.  I doubled the recipe and the parmesan cheese alone costs over $7!  I will stick with the jar sauce and watch for sales and coupons before I would try this again.  For a family of 4 or 5 this recipe is a must to double as one batch only makes a small saucepan worth.
Wow! This is so easy and sooooo good! I've never made alfredo sauce before and was hoping I'd find a recipe like this. This is a keeper! I also made it with skim milk and it was delicious!

My husband and I were very disappointed with this sauce. I followed the recipe and used grated parmesan (kraft parmesan in the plastic round container) which made the sauce very grainy. I will not make this again. If you are looking for a great sauce I usually use the cordon Blu II sauce minus the cordon blu(only white wine, chicken boullion, butter, corn starch, and heavy whipping cream) and it is awesome. I was just looking for something different and I saw all the reveiws for this sauce. Sour, powder like taste was nothing like alfredo sauce should be. I am so confused my the ratings it has received.

I am so glad I found this recipe!  I read a few reviews and here's what I came up with:  I used low-fat butter and cream cheese, added 2 cloves of minced garlic, 1 tsp oregano.  Tip: let the cream cheese sit out awhile so it will melt easier in pan.  I served it with pasta twists and cooked chicken and it was absolutely delicious!  I will be making it again and will add broccoli florets next time.  I'm already looking forward to it.

Fantastic! We made this in two foods classes I teach. Couldn't get enough of it. The cream cheese takes a while to melt; be patient, when you stir in the milk it will eventually turn creamy and delicious. Yumm!!

Quite yummy for being so easy. It wasn't the best I have ever had, but it was the best I have made! I screwed up the order of the ingredients so I am sure that's why mine was a tad bit gritty. It was still good nonetheless. The only problem I had was that it thickened up a great deal. I added some caramelized onions, peas and cooked bacon to mine.

YUM!!!!!!!!!! I love Italian food, and this was absolutely the best alfredo sauce I've had. And it's SO easy to make!!! I added some heavy cream to give it a little more thickness, as well as some frozen peas and chopped ham. YUMMY, I'm telling you!!!

My son isn't a big fan of Alfredo Sauce but loved this version so did my husband. This was quick, easy and tasty. Based on another reviewer, I used reduced fat cream cheese and skim milk, only change I might make next time is a little less milk.

This recipe was great.  I took the advice of some of the other viewers in that I used a little less milk than the original recipe called for and cooked chopped garlic in the melted butter.  I have made traditional Alfredo sauce and I found this recipe to be more forgiving and more tasty than the authentic versions.  Stirring with the wire whisk helps the sauce come out smooth.  Oh, and don't forget the nutmeg!
Thought this was fantastic! Only change I made was to reduce parmesan to 4oz and doubled the black pepper for personal taste.
Made it exactly as stated and it was excellent. The cream cheese keeps it from separating when cool. Definitely an easy, go to recipe.
Followed the recipe exactly.  Powdered garlic is too apparent and parmesean cheese dominates the flavor of the sauce. Will not do again.  I'll stick to the jars of alfredo sauce.
I made this to the letter, and it was superb. Thanks for the only alfredo sauce recipe I'll ever need :)

I experimented with this recipe and came out with my own quick and easy sauce- add 1/4 head of garlic, 1/2 a med white onion some half and half (fry with the butter).  No matter what you do the recipe is great as is or as a base for your own creation.  Everyone loved this sauce with shrimp and penne pasta!

My daughter and I loved the flavor.  The texture wasn't very creamy.  I used skimmed milk and added it after the cheese so I thought either of those factors may have made it that way.  I added steamed broccoli.  If I use regular milk next time and it is creamier, it will be just about perfect.  I added a dash of nutmeg too.

This sauce was awesome! So easy to make and way better than anything from a jar. Mom husband even liked it and he is not a fan of anything with pasta. I finally found an alfredo recipe that is easy and great. I will definitely be making this again.

I'll never buy a jar of this again.  This was easy and wonderful.  I most of the time add fresh mushrooms and sundried tomatoes, and maybe some red pepper flakes.  Just to give it some extra umpf. Still this was a very good base recipe.

OMG, this sauce is amazing. I cooked it for my friends and family and they said it was the best they ever had. Fabulous. I will make this alot I am sure. I used some of the adjustments that were recommended and it was just great. I really recommend this.
This is an exceptional Alfredo sauce.  I added some chopped bacon, chicken, and mushrooms to the sauce and served over Fettuccine.  I used a little less garlic than the recipe called for.

This recipe was so easy.  The only thing I changed was to use fresh garlic that I browned at the beginning with the butter.  This recipe works great with Dried Parmesan cheese too!  My husband and my kids loved it.  It also reheats really well - no separation.
Excellent recipe!  It was very tasty and so easy to prepare.  My husband and I loved it, and he is very picky about pasta sauces.  I'll be making this again soon!  Thanks Dawn!
By far the best alfredo sauce I have ever tasted. I will never buy jarred again. Thanks.

Quick, easy recipe. The only problem I had was using 2 cups of milk, the sauce turned out a little runny, though I'm typing this right after I made it. I'm seeing that as it cools down it's starting to have much more of an Alfredo consistency. I'm curious to see how the sauce will set in the fridge. Sometimes food is best the 2nd day! This recipe is more than enough for a 1 lb bag of spaghetti. Added a few dashes or oregano and it seemed to really add the "Italian" flavor to it. Awesome recipe! Great for those who have limited time on their hands

This sauce is easy and excellent!  I don't know what can be said about it that isn't already said...except maybe that if you like to have extra sauce for your garlic bread (like we do), double the batch!  Or double it anyway...it's that good!  My mom is an alfredo junkie and I thought she was going to throw all table manners out the window and lick her plate clean!  It really is THAT good!
Love this, I add a tbsp. or two of basil pesto at the end ;)

This recipe is the 'Creme De La Creme' of  alfredo sauces!  Awesome with freshly grilled chicken & steamed brocolli as a side dish.  This is now my only alfredo sauce recipe!  Passing it on to my 4 sisters.  Thank you very much!

listened to video, bought cream cheese and shredded parm. cheese 2 days later. Couldn't find recipe when ready to make so I winged it and it actually tasted pretty good! 2 kids, an 88 year old man and my husband all had seconds

Great recipe!  Very easy to make.  I cut it in half without any difficulties.  I didn't have garlic powder, but used a garlic salt grinder instead and it tasted great.  I used it with shrimp and pasta with diced red peppers, portabeo mushrooms and onions.  Yummm.
This recipe was ah-mazing!!!! My whole family loved it!! I loved it too! I will definitely make it again! (When i have the ingredients lol):)

It was very  thick and  had to be  thinned out a lot. 
It was good  but not what my kids were  expecting. I'll stick with  the  traditional  method  next time for  alfredo.

To be honest, just reading the ingredients I was a little unsure of this recipe, but I thought I would give it a try since it seemed so simple.  Im glad I decided to! Im not a fan of alfredo in general, the dh is, but boy am I a fan of this! Its fantastic! You can't even taste the cream cheese! Its SUPER! I did make a few changes.  I sauteed garlic and mushrooms with a bit of olive oil, salt and black pepper. Then I cooked chicken breasts sliced into strips.  I removed the chicken and mushrooms but left the liquid from cooking in the pan.  I made the sauce as the recipe calls for, only I used homogenized milk, added some more black pepper and garlic salt.  I also think the next time I make this, and I will definitely be making it again, I will add roasted red peppers! Mmmm... WONDERFUL!

I've made this recipe several times. The first time I made this recipe with the exact instructions and found it a little bland for my family's taste. I definately found that adding nutmeg was helpful and a bit more pepper. I increased the garlic and one time used fresh garlic for truly enhanced flavor. Overall, this is a fantastic recipe. I can even put all the ingredients in my Vitamix blender and whip it up until contents are hot and creamy; no stove or microwave needed. Truly a time-saving recipe that can be adjusted to personal tastes quite effortlessly. Bravo for the submission.

This is a really great quick and easy recipe. I made a couple changes: First, I use fresh minced garlic - 1-2 cloves according to taste. I don't like the garlic flavor of some of the powders and many of them tend to have salt in them. Saute the garlic in the hot butter for a few minutes before you add the cream cheese.  

Second, I cut the amount of parmesan to only 3-4 oz because I add white cheddar to the sauce. Usually around 3-4 oz, depending on how thick I want the sauce and how much of the white cheddar flavor I want. You have to wait until the milk is good and hot - it's got to be steaming before you add the white cheddar otherwise it doesn't seem to melt well. And make sure you wisk! The reason I use white cheddar is because I think it cuts down on the parmesan taste and adds more texture to the sauce. It's got almost a gritty texture - but not clumpy. It's hard to explain. I had a white cheddar alfredo sauce at a restaurant once which gave me the idea to try it. 

Finally, I do use the ground black pepper, but like other people I also add just a touch of nutmeg. It doesn't hurt to sprinkle a bit of chopped fresh parsley on each plate right before serving, either!

Super yum!!!! I paired it up with leftovers from the "Amazing chicken" recipe, and I must say, I don't think I will be ordering Chicken Alfredo from a restaurant EVER again!!!

So, I just got done enjoying this recipe.  It was quick to make and delicious to eat!  I added a red pepper and some green onions when I melted the butter to add some flavor and color. Delicious!  Fast and easy to make. I added  2 chopped cooked chicken breasts and cooked frozen broccoli just before serving over fettuccine.
First time making homemade Alfredo sause and this recipe really helped thank you

Love this!! This is the only alfredo cheese sauce I make! Don't forget to add a lot of pepper though for taste.

Soooo good! Was concerned because some ratings weren't great, and some people didn't love it, but I'm making it again today and its just so good. I  love it. definitely will make this often!

Awesome...never been able to buy a good alfredo sauce at the store, but this recipe is simple and is as good if not better than restaurant alfredo.
