Very good.  I hadn't heard of freezing tofu for a meatier texture.  I will use that trick with more recipes now.  Thanks!
Great Recipe! I get many compliments. I freeze the tofu before hand as well as bake it for 15 minutes before frying. Make sure to cut the slices thick enough to not burn while baking.

Pressing the tofu seems to be better than freezing.  My boyfriend has never been a fan for vegetarian dishes but boy did he enjoy this one. Now we have Tofu Tuesday's every week and this recipe is always in rotation.

First time making tofu for the family (told the kids it was chicken) and they loved it!! I will be keeping this recipe for future meals. I did add a little extra seasoning to the flour for flavor. I used garlic salt.

My husband and I loved this! We baked the tofu before anything - thanks to the previous reviewer who suggested that. It turned out great. Broiling it gave it a grill-like taste and consistency. Thank you!

This really is a great dish - tempts the most hardcore omnivores to switch to veg!  I added powdered 1/4 teaspoon powdered garlic and 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper to the egg mixture to give it some *kick*!

Just made this for dinner. I bought the tofu today so I didn't have time to freeze it so I listened to the other reviewer and tried baking it for 15 mins first and then fried them. They were pretty yummy alone but even better with the extra bbq dipping sauce. I eat it all and now and stuffed.

I'm not a vegetarian (my daughters are), and I liked this a lot.  My daughters really liked it.  Like some others, I baked the tofu first, then dipped in egg and dredged in flour before frying it.  I did not broil it afterward, and it was still perfect.  One thing... I should have read a little more carefully about heating the olive oil over *medium* heat, because olive oil has a low smoking point and it can overheat easily.  If you want to cook over a hotter fire to really assure a crispy crust, then use vegetable oil, but if you prefer olive oil take serious note of that medium heat!  Very tasty recipe.

I have made this recipe numerous times. My family loves it. It's  one of our favorite ways to prepare tofu.  To save time, try using Trader Joes high protein tofu. It's so firm and dry, you don't need to press it.

This was sooo yummy! Even all my meat-eating friends and boyfriend loved it! They couldn't believe it was tofu. 

Although it was a relatively easy recipe, my only complaint was it was so messy! BBQ sauce and flour were everywhere.

I also couldn't figure out where the flour went in the recipe. FYI- After you dip the tofu slices in the egg mixture, coat them with flour before placing it in the skillet.  

I will be making this one again!

Very good! I followed others suggestions and baked for 20 min. at 375. I didn't freeze it. Broiled them on low for 5 min on each side and they turned out nice and crispy. Whole family liked them, even the kids. Might try again with buffalo wing sauce. Thanks for sharing!

Used this recipe as a base. Sliced, squeezed out excess water and baked the tofu 30 minutes at 350F (too long; maybe only 20 minutes max next time). I dipped my tofu slices in a soy milk/hot sauce mixture then double-dipped in a flour/cornstarch/S&P/Italian seasoning mix. Fried until golden. Completely skipped the BBQ sauce and didn't miss. it. These tasted like chicken nuggets, so even my toddler like them!

AWESOME!!  This was my first time cooking with tofu.  As per previous reviews, I seasoned the tofu with garlic and onion powder as well as salt and pepper and baked for 15 mins at 375 degrees.  I then dredged the tofu in the egg mixture, almond flour, egg mixture, and Panko bread crumbs and fried in olive oil. SO CRISPY!! Did not broil.  Used bbq sauce for dipping. YUM!!

This was my first recipe using tofu, and I have never been a tofu eater.  I followed the recipe fairly closely making sure to brown the chunks nicely in the frying pan.  It turned out better than I had expected.  The texture was that of chikcen.  An excellent alternative to chicken wings.

omg. this was awesome. i had a package of tofu in the freezer already, so i drained and pressed the water out, then sliced into strips. like another reviewer suggested, i baked the strips for about 15 minutes on each side, then followed the recipe for dredging and frying them. i got lazy at the end and just ate the fried strips on a bun with some more barbeque sauce and it was heavennn.

Tasted like BBQ sauce.  Tofu has no taste so not too surprised at lack of flavour.  Tofu was SOGGY after thawing.  Better off pressing overnight to get out any extra water Or at least freeze and thaw on a cookie cooling rack.  Won't be making again.

I haven't ever managed to make tofu not look like scrambled eggs before now! Baking the tofu rectangles at 375 degrees F for 15 minutes before you dip them in the egg mixture most definitely helped the tofu have a crispier texture. Served the barbequed slices in a tortilla with fresh red bell pepper and mixed greens and a little bit of sharp cheddar. Everyone enjoyed even the meat eaters!
I must be missing something here (where does the cup of flour go?) but mine came out mushy. It was a messy/ time consuming process. So you guys that gave it 4+ stars...please lend me a hand!
This was great. I put the slices in a hamburger bun and made a barbeque type sandwich.  Tasted great!
This was very good and easy to make.   I pressed the tofu for about 20 minutes vs. freezing.   They turned out great.   I will definitely make these again.
I am a beginner cook, and this was really easy to make. The tofu really takes on the texture of real meat!
Reminds me a lot of Chicken Wings... very good recipe but kind of time consuming...

These were awesome! I followed the advise to bake them first but I don't know how they would turn out without it--probably would be fine.  I did half without baking the last step.  They were both great!
Very good and easy.  Dredge the tofu first in the eggs, then in the flour/salt/pepper mix.  Don't be afraid to brown this.  The more it gets brown, the more it gets crispier.

Okay, you've made me a beliver in Tofu. I never lied it and this recipe has restored me from the nasty, unhealthy fried chicken i used to eat. I did all the steps in the recipe and used bbq sauce to dip my tofu slices. Everything came out nice and crispy (i did bake my tofu slices first), but overall wish I could give you more than 5 stars. This was sooo delish! Thanks.

Best tofu recipe I've had for years. Crispy, tasty, and delicious.
I used a Carolina style mustard based bbq sauce and it was fantastic!

I followed the advice of many people and baked the tofu strips (at 425F for 20 minutes) before frying them.  After the strips were fried and the sauce was applied I baked them again (again at 425F) rather than putting them under the broiler.  I left them in the oven until the edges of the barbeque sauce blackened slightly.  I am so happy with how they turned out!  I will make these over and over again.  I will also try other sauces such as sweet and sour, peanut, curry, and teriyaki.

WOW!! Great recipe!! I am not vegetarian nor vegan but would like to incorporate some healthier foods into my diet. I've not had much success with tofu in the past but, this recipe has opened a wide range of opportunities for me.  This was delicious,  and using the process of freezing, baking, frying and broiling made the tofu a texture that can be used for so many tofu recipes with total success. I was surprised at the taste...it was awesome!!! I will be using this often!! Thanks for sharing the recipe and thanks to the reader that shared about baking in their review.
Very good!

Wow! I thought I was going to have to bribe my vegan-phobic family to try this. Turns out they ate it so fast (and came back for seconds) I didn't even get a chance to try it! For that reason alone, I am giving this 5 stars!!

Very tasty!!! I actually skipped the first step due to time and just blotted the tofu. I used firm. It all tasted great! My BF, who's vegetarian loved it! Next time I'll use extra firm so that its more substantial.

Not one to like the mushy texture of tofu in a recipe which tries to replicate meat, this recipe definitely made the tofu chewy which we liked.  I froze the tofu whole in the package for a few days.  After thawing, I sliced it rather thin.  One block gave me about a dozen slices.  I baked it 20-25 mins. flipping several times until it seemed most of the moisture was out of it.  I also seemed to have a lot of left over flour mixture and would only use 1/2 cup next time.  A little time consuming but will make again.  Might be better named chewy rather than crispy.
This was my first attempt at cooking tofu and I liked this recipe pretty well!  I took other reviewers' advice and baked the tofu for 15 min. before following the recipe.

This was very good. I made this for memorial day weekend. I have a vegetarian in the family (including myself) who loved them as well. I will definitely make them again. And i would also recommend freezing them the night before. It helps with the texture. I did manage to to burn them a little bit while i was frying them so i never broiled them but they were still amazing. =D

If I could give this 10 stars, I would. I've been a non-tofu enjoying veggi for about 15 years. I'm always hopeful when I find a recipe that could disguise it's "tofu-ness".  This was AMAZING. My husband ate the entire plate, minus the 3 I quickly grabbed before he inhaled them. My 3 year old LOVED them (he managed to get 1). I baked the tofu after I brought it out of the freezer as was suggested. I will make these over and over and over...  THANK YOU!!

This is a fantastic recipe! The tofu has a great texture. I baked before and after frying and added garlic powder and cayenne as suggested. I also cubed my tofu into 1/2 cubes then skewered two per toothpick.  This made frying them and turning them in the oven much easier!

Wasn't sure how it would turn out as I've never breaded tofu, but it was amazing! No complaints, I added a few different spices to give it more flavor and I baked the tofu before breading but I'll definitely be making this again. My only complaint was that it was time consuming to batter and fry everything. I found it was more flavorful the next day when I reheated my leftovers.

My husband and I liked this recipe very much.   I had a cajun b-b-q sauce on hand which was good but I think next time I will use another sauce flavor as the cajun was a bit overpowering for me.  I feel I will be able to give this recipe a 5-star rating after trying it again w/ another sauce.   Also needed to use an extra egg white.  I hadn't heard about freezing the tofu either.   Wonderful trick.  I am tempted to try the recipe without this step just to see how it compares.  I am definitely going to be using this again and again.

I made this for lunch today and give it five stars because even my husband liked it.  Thanks to the previous reviewer for sharing the baking tip.  Instead of freezing the tofu, I baked the tofu at 375 on a lightly oiled baking pan, before doing the recipe.  This saves a lot of time too, no freezing the night before!
super fun to eat, made some crispy potato fries and a garlic green beans.

Omg this stuff was delicious !! I don't see why people disliked it . I pressed the tofu between two plates lines with paper towels to remove water then I baked for about 15-20 min ( freezing and thawing was a little too extra , didn't feel like doing all that..texture came out perfect regardless ) . Because I don't eat eggs I used ground flax seed instead. I added other seasons to the flour mixture such as garlic powder  . I fried then broiled as directed. It was great . Definitely will cook again
This is better if it is sliced thin. I didn't freeze but baked for 15min on a greased cookie sheet like suggested. My husband and I really liked it. I made it with my homemade BBQ sauce.
We loved this! But you do have to bake the tofu first as another reviewer suggested, otherwise your tofu will not be crispy.
Oh.. yum.  Baked the tofu like everyone said, but my gosh, these were yummy.  Definitely a keeper.

I am not experienced in tofu preparation but I really enjoyed making this recipe. I baked the tofu as suggested by other reviewers for about 20 minutes in a convection oven, then proceeded with the recipe using a teriyaki sauce instead of bbq sauce. It came out great. The pieces that were cut thinner had a better texture, so next time I will try to cut the slices thinner. The teriyaki sauce I used was like a thick marinade, not the thin teriyaki sauce in a bottle like soy sauce. Next time I may slice the tofu, then freeze, then bake, just to see what happens to the texture.
not great, not bad... bbq sauce tastes good in general, so it was okay, but i've had better... maybe as a sandwich it would have more depth to the flavor

With a newly vegetarian daughter, I am trying to find meals we can all eat. This is one for sure! My carnivorous son went back for seconds. I baked the tofu for 15 minutes then dipped and fried the pieces and then broiled them again with the extra bbq sauce brushed on.  They came out crunchy and delicious. I will be making this again and often.

I love tofu, and am always on the prowl for new great tofu dishes, but I did not care for this recipe.  The egg coating made a gummy, NOT crispy coating, even though it was cooked so much it was burning (granted, I didn't freeze the tofu in advance, a have tried this before and prefer the natural texture of tofu).  Barely edible, I can't figure out why it has any positive reviews.  If you are looking for a great tofu recipe from allrecipes, try  "Breaded, Fried, Softly Spiced Tofu"--this DOES turn out crispy, and is delicious.

My boyfriend has recently jumped on the vegetarian ban-wagon along side me (7yrs) so I have been trying new recipes and this recipe is actually really good.  I used the trader joe's brand bbq sauce and used 21 season salute along with whole wheat flour and it tasted awesome.  I recommend baking the tofu prior to get the chicken texture.  He told me it really did taste like bbq chicken.  Easy and very pleased with the end result!
I'm so making this again, it was so good.
Daughter and I loved this! I did take Amy's suggestion for baking the sliced tofu before frying (thank you!) in EVOO. The end result turned out pretty cool! Thanks for sharing jillken!

Enjoyable meatless dish. I have only been using tofu for about 6 months so I am having fun experimenting. I tried this 20 other times and always threw it out but this recipe is good and I will eat tofu this way again. You really have to drain tofu well (at least an hour pressed) and then the baking of the tofu is a wonderful idea. I will always use that tip when I work with tofu. Thanks so much for the idea Amy. This is a time consuming but was nice and I will be using this recipe often.
Don't know if I did something wrong here but it seemed to be a lot of work and they didn't turn out that crispy!
Very very good. Make sure to freeze, thaw, refreeze, thaw again to give it a meatier texture...so yumm.

WOW!  This was incredibly good.. a LOT of work, but very tasty! I did not freeze the tofu, but I drained it incredibly well getting out all excess water with paper towels.  I then cut it into 12 thin slices and baked for 15 minutes at 375. The key is to use your favorite BBQ sauce.. I use Sweet Baby Ray's and it's incredible! Instead of broiling, I just baked it for another 5 minutes at 375 after I was done with the frying.  Keep extra BBQ sauce on the side as well for when you're eating to dip it in there too! This is very good.  I served it with dinner rolls and rice.
These were kind of a lot of work to produce something that I didn't feel was that much better than if you were to just marinate in bbq sauce and broil.  They were a hit at my party though!

Absolutely delicious! I am new to cooking and especially new to Tofu, so I was disappointed the few times I made tofu before this recipe and it came out soggy and flavorless. Even my boyfriend, who is not a fan of healthy food, let alone tofu, loved this!

I work in food service in a natural foods store, and the trick to getting tofu firm, not mushy, is baking it first.  We do that for all tofu we use.  You just cut it how you want to, spray a baking sheet with oil, and bake on 375 for about 15 minutes, more depending on how firm and crispy you want it. 
Anyway, I baked it, coated it in the egg and bbq sauce mixture, rolled in flour mix and fried.  It was great.

I seared the nuggets in a pan after baking them. It helped, I think. They tasted okay to me but my family thought otherwise. It was a bit bland and didn't taste 'meaty' as expected. Maybe I did something wrong?
On another note, it was very time consuming and messy. Beware!

We're not vegetarian but my family including my picky 6 yr. old daughter really liked these tofu slices.  I didn't freeze the tofu overnight but did put it in the oven for 15 minutes at 375 to dry it out a bit before slicing. It was really tasty, and not mushy at all.  I will definitely make it again.

This is THE BBQ tofu recipe!!!  I live in memphis and I swear it's better than any other BBQ anything out there.  I did bake for 15 minutes before coating in egg/sauce and flour mix and frying.  The tofu was very crispy at that point.  I cooled pieces on paper towel to soak up some oil and then coated with Corky's BBQ sauce and placed on a well greased pan and put back in the oven for about 5 minutes.  (I'm not sure about broiling) When they came out of the oven I thought they were ruined because they were no longer crispy but I'm telling you the texture is right on! All the consistency of chicken wing meat without big veins hanging out, chunks of cartilege and other assorted nasty things associated with actual meat.  THANK YOU from the bottom of my heart for the first tofu recipe I actually like better than the real thing!!!!

100% Awesome! I baked the tofu first, as another reviewer suggested. After breading & frying I simply tossed the pieces in more BBQ sauce. No need for the broiler since the piping hot tofu made the sauce warm. Delish!
This recipe was a lot of work and just not worth the effort.  My daughter and I really did not enjoy this.  Oh well....
Amazing! Have made this many times. My whole family love it! I used the cubed tofu instead... The pieces come out more crispy.
This tasted like solid barbecue sauce.

I have been looking for an easy barbeque tofu recipe and this is it!  I have been a vegetarian for 5 years now and I have been limited in what I cook.  Since joinind this site I have been trying new recipes @ least twice a week.
This recipe was a total hit!  I ended up baking the tofu for 15 minutes @ 350 degrees, smothered in bbq sauce first, then followed the rest of the recipe.  It was really simple and delicious.

This recipe is ridiculous! Ive always loved bbq sauce, but being a vegetarian has really limited what I can do with it, but this recipe has completely changed that! I loved it so much, after the first time I tried it, I made it three days in a row!

Yum! Use the most delicious BBQ sauce you can find. The flavor was amazing, but the strips lost some crispiness in the oven. Next time I will try baking first, then frying as other reviewers suggested.

I froze, I baked it, I egged and floured it, I fried it, I marinated it, and I broiled it.  And it was...terrible.  The texture was okay and the flavor was, well, icky.  Normally I think of tofu as having little flavor, but I got a strong tofu flavor with every bite.  Those who are giving this positive reviews are either tried and true vegetarians or lacking taste buds.  I rarely give bad reviews (I rarely find a recipe this bad that has so many good reviews), but this was really awful.  This was a whole lot of work for really disappointing results.  This will not be part of my 'meatless meals' rotation.  Blech.

I have tried this recipe multiple times now, and each time I end up doing it slightly differently, bake a little longer or shorter, forget that I put something in the fry pan and almost burn but, but it doesn't matter! Every single time it is DELICIOUS!!!!
It was pretty good, I can't stand squishy tofu!

I made these for my daughter, "the veggie head" and she loved them. I baked them at 350 for 15 minutes after slicing into thick slices beforehand. The rest of the recipe was followed as written except we did not broil the tofu. We cooked them in the oven at 350 for 20 minutes after marinating. I tried one and it was pretty good! My daughter said she loved them and described them as "crunchy, but not crunchy". Will make again. :)

For taste this gets 5 stars.  My kids would have given it more stars if they could.  Everyone loved it!  But I doubt I will make this again, as it was a ton of work to make and clean up after preparing them.

Wanted to love it but was not a fan :(  i really think tofu needs to be marinated before cooking to give it some flavor.  this was just bbq cover tofu to me.  texture after freezing, frying and broiling was nice but next time I will maybe marinate the strips in bbq then freeze and follow recipe.
My family really liked this recipe. Even my 12 year old thought they were good.  I was a little skeptical at first but delicious!

I had never tried tofu before, but this sounded interesting.  My husband & I really liked it!  The only thing I noticed was I needed 2 egg whites and could have probably used only half the flour, the salt and pepper were lost in the extra.

This was really good! I will not make it on the stove top again though - I had to babysit the tofu slices as I was scared they would burn - but i wanted to keep them in the pan long enough for them to get crispy. - Next time I will put them in the oven and then broil them.
"Crispy" is not a term usually associated with tofu, but it is possible with this recipe. I used "Dinosaur Roasted Garlic Honey BBQ Sauce". Delicious, and thanks for sharing.
Excellent!! I don't eat eggs... so to replace the eggs I just used 1/4 cup of soy milk. It was great!!! My family was skeptical about tofu but they loved this dish!

Delicious recipe. I didn't follow exactly to a T, but it still came out great. I didn't freeze it because that's too much time. I did bake it for 15 minutes with bbq sauce on it. I used a whole egg for dipping and a little cornmeal. At first I didn't like the french toast appearance but then I tried it and the egg coating kind of feels like skin! My toddlers loved it and my husband will be pleased when he gets home. I also love the rich color I was able to achieve with this recipe.
A good recipe, but I think a more creative take on the flavors would reap better results.
Tasted great, added a little brown sugar to bbq sauce
This is a great recipe, but I had a few troubles. Mine still didn't feel like they had much texture to them. I'm going to experiment with much thinner slices and maybe trying some crunchier toppings.

I actually just made this an hour or two ago and it was FAB!I screwed up and got the extra firm organic sprouted tofu twin pack of 8 ounce tofu so I couldn't make slices so I made strips! I did like the other reviewers said and placed a block in between two paper towels and weighed it down with a glass pot. Then, I left to go back to Trader Joe's to get some yummy all natural barbecue sauce. When I came back  the towels were literally drenched! I don't know how all that water hides in there. I cut my strips and put some foiled on a cookie sheet and baked for 15 mins. Took them out dipped in the egg mixture and the flour and placed in the pan. Medium low is best. Let them brown, added barbecue sauce on them after they drained on paper towels and placed them back in the for five and only five minutes because at this point I was dying to try them! I'm certainly glad I did. Next time I will get the extra firm block to try these on a sandwich. I paired my strips with baby spinach and a dollop of roasted garlic hummus.

This was fantastic! I skipped the freezing step and just drained and pressed firm, traditional tofu. I also omitted the egg, kind of defeats the purpose of an otherwise plant-based dish. You could just use BBQ sauce instead. I used an egg replacer (Ener-G) and BBQ sauce. LOVED this dish!!

The ingredients list flour/salt/pepper but the instructions never tell what to do with them, they are crucial to the crispiness.  So after rolling in the egg white mixture roll in flour/salt/pepper mixture, then fry, will be crispy and absolutely delicious!  My husband loved this and I didn't even do the last step adding more BBQ sauce, didn't need it!
6 minutes broiling is definitely too long. I'd do 4 minutes. Besides that, I'd imagine it's very good.
This was amazing- I served it with soba noodles and topped with sesame seeds for an asian twist.
I've never been a fan of bbq.........but this ROCKS!!!

Good appetizer/snack type deal. The recipe is not well written and therefore confusing to the novice like myself. I did figure it out but it was a little frustrating as that was my first deep fry experience.
They turned out delicious! My non-vegetarian family loved them too! I also recommend baking the tofu for 15 minutes to make the consistency even better!
Very good but a bit time consuming. I possibly might make this again.
It's alright, tastiest like McDonald's chicken nuggets.
This was amazing! Took a little longet than I thought it would to do the prep work, but I think I cut the strips too thin, so I had more to do.  I will ba making this again!
meh. i made as directed and wouldn't make it again.
Yumm!

This has become a recurring favourite at our house. We gave up meat as a family and every now and again we miss some of our old comfort foods like BBQ wings or ribs. This is a great meal when we want something quick and familiar. The secret is finding a good quality Tofu. Firm but still gives easily to the touch and not lumpy and grainy in texture.

I'll just say this; if you are one of the millions of Americans with a REAL bbq outside, marinade in some BBQ sauce and toss them on the grill. This recipe is a lot of work, for a not so great result (in my opinion).

These were so good! I unfortunately only had cubed tofu but was determined to make these. I baked the cubes for about 20 mins based on other reviews & added honey to the BBQ. They were a great texture, but I didn't see a need for the BBQ sauce in the egg mixture. After frying them, I tried one & it had no flavor. So I threw them all into the remaining BBQ & honey mixture & they came out great! They became a bit hard as they cooled, but I'm blaming that on the cubes. I plan to make this again this week with regular tofu! Thank you :)
Very good.  I thought it was much better dipped in bbq sauce after broiled, without it, it's just more ok than good...
To quote my boyfriend "omg these are soooooooooo good! you FINALLY made tofu that I like!"
Mmmm so good, almost like ribs! Really good for vegetarians, delicious.

waaaay too much work for how it turned out.  followed recipe exactly.  3 Tbsp oil - used way more or else they were going to burn/didn't state how big to slice them so i had to guess.  there's gotta be a better way to do this!  boring bbq.

I didn't freeze it like the recipie says. I pressed the moisture out of my tofu strips and froze for 1 hour. Then, to be healthier, I baked them (at 375, like the other reviewer suggested). I baked them, flipped them, then coated with extra bbq sauce and stuck them back in the oven. They tasted good like that, but better after one day of being refrigerated. Next time I'll try freezing the tofu.  I used honey mustard for some of them, and they were good too!

These were delcious! I did what other reviewers suggested -- froze the tofu overnight, then baked it before starting the recipe. It was much easier to deal with that way, and came out really crispy. Yum -- tasted like buffalo wings! Thanks for a great recipe.
Loved it!  It is nice to find a fresh option for tofu.  I used a spicey BBQ sauce.
THIS IS ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC!! I followed the suggestion of baking at 375 for 15 mins from an earlier post before the egg mixture.  I could eat a bowlful of this, and nothing else!
Very Delicious.

This is my first attempt at making tofu and eating it. It was great...on the outside. But for some reason the inside was really bland. Does anyone know what I can do to make the inside just as awesome as the outside? Maybe a marinade? Any ideas would be awesome. Thanks. Also my boyfriend and I really enjoyed this and are happy that our first tofu experience was pretty tasty.
This was delicious!  I baked the tofu first and I added some spicy miso to the BBQ to make it spicy! Thanks for the great recipe!
This was a very nice way to have tofu, as other reviewers have already said be sure to broil all sides. Crispy = Yummy!

I did not like this recipe at all. Freezing tofu overnight made it very tough and tasteless. I will never mix egg white with tofu again because they just do not go well together. Barbeque sauce totally overpowered everything. I like tofu but this one i could not eat at all.
Wouldnt make it again. Sort of boring.

I froze the tofu overnight, thawed, baked for 15 minutes and then proceeded to follow the rest of the directions. This was my first time cooking tofu so I know I did some things wrong, but in the end it turned out quite well and made for a delicious dinner & lunch the next day!

I really liked this recipe!  I used teriyaki sauce instead of BBQ and it was also very good.  I didn't freeze the tofu beforehand, but I don't need the "meaty" texture.  It was very fast and easy to make with little clean-up required.

Turned out okay but when I put it in the broiler the tofu ended up burning. My boyfriend normally doesn't like tofu because of the texture and he thought that freezing it really helped. Will make again.

Wow, what a great recipe!  The freezing and pre-baking techniques are sheer genius and help push me one step closer to meat free living.  This method of cooking tofu also allows for variance, I may try satay or curry, or experiment with various other bbq sauces for change.  Thanks.

This turned out beautifully! I don't like BBQ sauce/flavor, so I mixed sriracha sauce and another hot sauce into the egg white instead. I didn't do the second coating/marinade because I was worried they'd turn out too mushy. I broiled the toasty suckers dry, flipped once, and served with more hot sauce and ranch for dipping. They were chewy and dense - much more like real chicken I think the freezing did the trick - although, I just friar them quickly on a cookie sheet for an hour because I didn't have time.  And very crunchy (I also added a tablespoon of corn starch to the flour mixture.).
These are delicious. I'm hooked on them.

Disappointing. Like others, I baked the tofu for 15 minutes first. The breading didn't get crispy at all, and we had to slather it in BBQ sauce to make it palatable. This was quite a lot of work for sub-par results. Thanks anyway.

Wow! This was SO good. I cooked it in the oven before, like suggested, and it worked great. It takes a while to prepare - a lot of steps, but definitely worth it! I think even meat eaters would like it.

The only reason I'm giving this 4 stars is because of the mess my kitchen became after I finished making this. I did bake the tofu for 15 minutes at 375 as another commenter suggested. The flavor was good but next time I will add some spice to give it a kick. Went great with rice noodles and sweet and sour sauce to dip!

Yum!  I cut the tofu into about 1 inch by however long the tofu is rectangles and then froze them.  When it was time to cook, I had to sqeeze out more water but then I baked them.  I spray them with PAM type spray first and that seems to help get them crispy on the outside.  Then after that, I fried them in the oil.  Very good texture, just next time I will try a different sause as my kids didn't like the BBQ flavor.

I just used regular sliced bread out of convenience.  I took it to a potluck and it was the first dish to be finished off.  If I have leftover spread I'll use it on sandwiches or crackers.  It's easier to spread when soften or room temp.

easy to store, easy to make and easy to carry. Taste great and light for a ladies luncheon. Will keep and make again and again. I did make them on white bread with the crust removed cut in half for more of a finger sandwich and used ranch instead of italian dressing but next time I will make then as posted. Thanks, Rebecca
I didn't have dressing or seasoning, so I used salt and pepper with white bread and it was great, and I'm not a fan of any of these ingredients.
The only thing I can say about this recipe is that I am sorry that I didn't make a triple batch. These went fast! A keeper. Thank you.
These were awesome! They were gobbled up so fast I didn't get any ( good thing I taste tested a few prior to the party ) they are so simple to make and were a big hit!

This recipe is awesome! I didn't have the bread on hand, but I did put them on some triscuits, spread the dip on and topped with a cucumber and served them as appetizers and they went quick! Everyone asked me for the recipe! I will definitely use this again and again! Thank You!

These were really good and I did add dill to the  mixture as well as sprinkled it on top - the only thing I didn't like was that as they sat out on the table (on a hot summer day - but was inside) the mixture melted and when you took a bite it often fell off in a gloop on your plate.  Next time I will make and then stick in the fridge until the very last minute.

I have been asked to make these over and over. I made them for many partys! I always make them the night before and store it in an air tight container, it softens the rye cocktail bread. What makes this is the spread... and it doesn't just taste good with cucumbers, but all sorts of sandwiches.  I added a little bit more dill before I refrigerated it, and it was amazing.
I have been making this for lunch quite often. My kids can't get enough of it. I use fat free cream cheese without any difference in the flavor/texture. Thanks for the recipe!
Not what I had expected...
Once you start you just can't stop eating them!
Holy cow these are amazing my friends literally ate nearly all of them before I could even finish making them!!!!!

I made this for my Mother's Day brunch, and was unsure how it would be received by the guys in the family. I should have doubled the recipe because it was a HIT!! The sandwiches were the FIRST to finish!! My mom said they reminded her of the ones she ate in England! Fantastic recipe!!

I have yet to see anyone who doesn't love this appetizer.  I spread the mixture onto cocktail rye, top with a slice of cucumber, and sprinkle with dill. I have this exact same recipe and to anyone who said it didn't taste good -then you made it wrong.  I use the refrigerated bread dough (in the can), I cut each bread slice very thin, and leave the crusts on. There are never any leftovers.  I might try a french baguette next time.
Wow! This is amazing and soooooo simple! Did not refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight. Still was amazing!

I made these for a baby shower I hosted and they were a big hit! I would say our vegetarian crowd and our meat eating crowd liked these sandwiches equally. Delicious. I'll be making these many more times.
I love this recipe, easy to make and it's gone before in a wink!
Great and easy recipe. I have used it twice at brunches I have catered for friends. I used pumpernickle coctail bread both times and it was perfect.
I did not like this recipe.  I should have known better because I generally do not like recipes that require packaged ingredients (like the salad dressing mix).  It tasted overpowering.
Love this I find it tastes best on the French baguettes and if they are day old LOVE IT and Easy too! Have most the ingredients on hand.

These are a little time consuming to make them all pretty, but well worth the effort. They are delicious, and very nice to look at. Wonderful for hot summer days as a light appetizer, or in the winter to remind you that it will be warm again.
I used a packet of Hidden Valley Ranch Italian seasoning and it was way too salty to eat. I ended up dumping the whole thing.

Making this for the second time. Everyone loves it- even people who don't like the ingredients by themselves. Great for parties, takes next to no time to make, and everyone thinks I am a culinary genius!

These were great! I doubled the recipe but only used half of the second packet of itialn seasoning.(it didnt need 2 full packets)I also chopped up 1 cucumber and mixed it in with the mix instead of putting a slice on top. Everyone loved it!

1/2 cup of mayo was too much.  Someone suggested using vanilla yogurt.  I will try that next time instead of the mayo.  Or maybe try using Miracle Whip.  Also the package of Italian dressing was way too strong.  Definitely need to use half a packet (.4 ounce) instead of a full packet.  .7 ounce was too strong, and I was already using a mild Italian.
I made this for a party and several people asked for the recipe...and only one sandwich was left at the end of the party.

I discovered this recipe many years ago and in that time have eaten unladylike quantites of this delightful little bite.  I usually cut the bread with a cookie cutter to give it a little more eye appeal, but that's just me.  Also lovely with a little shrimp perched on top, anchored in a bit of spread.
I found this too salty and maybe too much mayo. I don't know... something seemed off.

These were a big hit with the bridesmades at my friend's wedding.  Once we finished with them, the boys took them over as well!  The crisp, watery cucumber really balances out the creaminess of the cheese and the saltiness of the dressing mix.
Used ranch packet instead of Italian seasoning.  Will add sour cream next time. Yields enough for 4 cucumbers and 2 loaves of pumpernickel.
I followed the recipe as written, except that I used a mini sliced loaf of rye bread. Everything else was perfect! They are so pretty and elegant looking on a plate.
Delicious!!!! I used plain toasted bagel chips instead of bread.  I also bought fresh dill (less expensive). My coworkers gobbled everything down to the last drop.  I will definitely make this again.

WOW! This is an awesome recipe. My son (9) wants me to keep a constant supply on hand. I will also be making these for my sisters baby shower. I am going to try the Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix next time.

AWESOME!    My whole family enjoyed this.  I will say that we took crusts off of regular white/wheat bread and flattened them with a rolling pin and cut them into fourths.  This made a thinner bread layer and more petite bite sized sandwiches.  I can see using fancy heart or flower cookie cutters to make these for a garden party or a tea party.  Even my cucumber hating daughter and husband was pleasantly surprised by liking this sandwich.  A keeper recipe for sure!

Tastes like summer!  I shredded my cucumbers and squeezed them dry.  I mixed them with light cream cheese, 1/4 cup of light mayo, Italian dressing mix, fresh dill, and the juice and zest of 1/2 of a lemon.  It makes a great spread for a whole grain baguette.  Thanks for the idea!
I made these for the first time about 5-6 years ago and was blown away at how much I liked them. Easy for a non-cook to do and simple ingredients. Awesome!

Made as written.... I used a french baguette vs. french bread with one cucumber slice on each piece.  Not only did I think they were delicious, but several people I made them for RAVED about them and asked for the recipe.  Excellent recipe, thanks!
I used this recipe for a Christmas party and it was a great hit.  I was asked to make it again this year.
Absolutely delicious. I used sour cream instead of mayo but I'm sure both would be just as good. Do not forget the dill week on top.. makes all the difference! YUMMM! thanks kimbee!
I made these for moms at my 5 year olds birthday party.  What a HIT!!!  Even the kids loved them.  Thank you so much

My daughter brings these to parties but she uses the small square cocktail-size pumpernickel bread. I've never seen a tray of anything disappear as these do.  They are really good and I don't generally like cucumbers.
These were wonderful!  I have a two suggestions, though.  Get the smallest cucumbers you can; less seeds that way.  Also, for a fun appetizer, serve on square wheat crackers.  They are beautiful!
add own spices instead of dressing packet cuz it is too salty.

I've tried a few recipes and this is both the best and easiest. The italian dressing pack provides a great flavor I haven't been able to capture without. I initially chilled the mixture for only an hour and it was still pretty good. I used up the rest a full day later and I can say that it only improved a little bit with the longer chilling time. When I tried a bit without any cooling it wasn't nearly as good though. So if you want them today, you can get away with just and hour in the fridge.

Some people said the italian dressing mix is too much. I added a 0.6 oz packet (not 0.7 oz as the recipe says) and it provided a strong flavor. I love it, but if you are sensitive to powerful flavors I could easily see it being too much. Overall, this is going to be my go to recipe for cucumber sandwiches.

These are addictive.  I made them for my daughter's garden-themed birthday party and used flower cookie cutters to cut the (lightly toasted)bread into shapes, spread the cream cheese mixture on, and placed flower-shaped cucumber slices on top.  They were sooooo good!!
I grew up on my grandmothers cucumber sandwiches with just mayo, but I will never do that again after making this spread! A little salt and pepper and I'm set! Love it!

This recipe was really tasty and refreshing for summer.  I didn't quite use the entire packet of italian dressing and needed another cucumber in order to use most of the dip mixture.  Very good!  Will definitely use this recipe again.
These were great, but I made way too many!  We ate the rest the next evening at our "after-party".  Very simple to make with a great taste.
I did not care for these, will not be making again.

*** My three-year-old just walked into the room and stole my sandwich! He took one bite and said, "Mmmm! Nummy!" and walked away with the rest! On man is this good! I didn't add the dill (didn't have any) and I used the bread I had on hand, but I wouldn't change the four main ingredients in any way. I was also too hungry to let it mix for six hours so I can't wait to try it again tomorrow after it's had time to set. Yum!
Ditto, Ditto, Ditto! These are great. A nice, fresh treat.
I did not chill the cream cheese mixture as the recipe says - it was still really good!
I've made these several times and everyone devours them immediately!  Quick and easy recipe!

This recipe was very good but a little bland.  I will try adding some celery salt, lawry's salt, or just plain salt along with the dill on top of the cucumbers next time.  Also I might try marinating the cucumbers in vinegar overnight too but otherwise I got a lot of compliments and passed out the recipe to many friends.  Thanks Heather

I LOVED THIS. I used the ranch dressing packet and mayo in mine. But like everyone says, the dill is what makes this. I used some cool fancy crackers for mine and served as hourdourves. I will keep this ready to serve at all times during the summer.
I had a high tea for a bridial shower.  I served several tea sandwiches, but this was the big hit.  I later served them on a summer night with chilled soup.  A definite hit with my family.
Made these for an office party and everyone gobbled them up.  If you can use fresh dill over dried it makes a huge difference!

I make these substituting 1/2 cup of Vanilla yogurt for the Mayonnaise (more carbs but significantly less fat). SO Good!
Delicious and easy! Perfect for a hot summery day!
Superb! I used whipped cream cheese because that is what I had on hand and cut the mayo in half. Awesome!

So yummy!! I made these to test them out before making them for a bridal shower and they are so good I can't stop eating them!  I did my own version of America's Test Kitchen and had my boyfriend try out each one and tell me his favorite.  I served it on a sliced french baguette. Very light and refreshing canape & very easy to make. I skipped the bread for my carb-conscious friends at a recent party. I think they're even better this way.

I made these when a friend was coming over, however I did make some changes instead of the Italian mix I used fresh Tyme, oregano,& basil combined about 1 to 2 tsp and 2 tsp of fresh dill. I added lemon juice to the cream cheese mixtute and it was delicious

We recently had a tea party with the young women and their mothers in church.  I tried this recipe out there and it was a huge hit.  Very yummy, very easy, and I would recommend it for anything from baby showers to wedding appatizers.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

Really good recipe, I've made this for two different parties now, and it's been a hit both times. It's also extremely easy to make, and looks really nice too, which is a plus. I'd definitely recommend it.
Absolutely addicting! Instead of the french bread we used regular white bread, removed the crust and then cut into triangles. All of the guests could NOT stop eating them.
great- with out italian dressing mix,adding a little garlic powder

always make extra. these will get eaten in a hurry
Turned out pretty great, though there was a ton leftover. Was a little strong for some people to eat.

Then I added thin sliced cucumbers, fresh dill and black pepper on top. Yum!

Turned out great.  I added 1 teas of dill and decreased the amount of the italian dressing just a smidge.    One thing that made these even better:  Get the "take and bake" unbaked French loaves from the grocery store and bake them up when you are ready to prepare the sandwiches. REALLY tasty!

Great!  I cut some cuke slices in half to make them fit better.  Also, cut bread into thinner slices (1/2").  Took them to work and everyone had a fit over them.  Even someone who didn't like cucumbers.  Should have made twice as many!
Fabulous!  Didn't change a thing and everyone loved it:) Thanks for sharing.
Awesome and I forgot to add the dill weed so it'll be even better next time!
I made these for a baby shower and they were a hit.  I really enjoyed them.  I'll be making them again this weekend.  I used white bread because that's all I had, but they were still awesome.

This is so simple but SO good. I made this on the fly when we had some company so it wasn't able to sit but it was still awesome! Of course the next day it was even better! Definitely a keeper.  I made a tray of these for a bridal shower.  They disappeared & people were asking who made them.  Lots of flavor.  Perfect recipe as is.

I made this recipe for a tea party with no modifications and everyone loved it.  Very easy and tasty.  My teenage son ate all of the leftovers!

These little sandwiches were perfect!  I was looking for a fun way to use summer cucs for a party I had, and this was just perfect.  I used baguettes and one cuc slice/bread slice was a nice ratio.  The dill is the icing on the cake.
Easy and good if you need something different and quick. Honestly though, it's a not that great to me. Probably wont make it again.

Very good. I reduced this recipe and followed it exactly except used fresh dill. I used Good Seasons Italian Dressing mix and did not find it too salty. Thanks!

Delicious! I make something similar using slices of tomatoes in addition to the cukes, and use celery salt for seasoning. This is based on a sandwich I had in India, where they don't have cream cheese so they use yogurt.

A friend made this for my bridal shower, with one small change of using greek cream cheese, and boy were they delicious!! Everyone raved about how they were so delicious! Oh, these are great! What a fantastic spread. I found fresh cream cheese (as in no preservatives) and it tasted extraordinary. So cheap! So fast! I'm in love.

Yum! I used pita bread cut into wedges and lemon pepper seasoning instead of the dill.  I  made it in the morning so it sat in the fridge for about six hours. I recommend serving them chilled. It was the first appetizer to go at Thanksgivng.

I used this spread for cucumber sandwiches for my 4 year old's birthday tea party, and they were a big hit!! Nice and refreshing

Made for a picnic on a hot day.  Those who like cucumbers loved it.  Followed the recipe exactly except used low fat cream cheese and mayo on a loaf of baquette.  Light and just perfect.

This is my new favorite recipe for its simplicity in ingredients, ease in putting together, its healthy, low-calorie benefits and the fact that it is so delectable it's practically addictive! ALWAYS a hit!!! I've served these for years and people always rave about them (and they are so easy!)
I used Kroger's Take and Bake multiigrain bagette and ranch dressing packet. Rave reviews!
I love these! I have made them several times for baby and wedding showers and everyone has always loved them. So easy to make and so good!

Oh my gosh, these are so good. I made them for a carry-in at work and they're still talking about how good they were! I would even make these just for myself to snack on, they're so good!

Myself and a friend made these for a bridal shower.  We put together the cream cheese mixture the night before, and then assembled the sandwiches the morning of. I served these sandwiches at a Jewelery party that I hosted. They were delicious, everyone raved about them. Thanks to whoeversuggested them to me on the web site they are superb! Thanks for a great recipe and idea
Very good recipe, I added the dill into the cream cheese mixture, and served on pepperidge farmsn thin slice bread.
5+++  Easy and addicting! I could not stop eating this! I served it on those mini pumpernickel bread. I did use the dry Italian salad dressing mix and would not change a thing.

awesome!!!!!! i love this recipe!

WONDERFUL!

These are so yummy and so easy to prepare.  I hosted a Longaberger show this afternoon.  Everyone loved them and I had a few requests for the recipe.  I followed the directions exactly.  This one will go in the recipe file.

Make early and refrigerate overnight! Only added 1/4 c sour cream to written recipe. Great on white bread squares and cocktail rye squares found in the deli section of your grocery store. Tried it with the package of dry Italian salad dressing mix and with a package of dry Hidden Valley ranch dressing. Either is great! It makes an awesome spread for a cucumber, tomato, and basil sandwich too!

These were so good! I made a batch, and you are right, it really keeps in the fridge. I thought there is no way my husband and I are going to finish the entire batch, but how wrong I was! My husband ate it every single night until it was gone. I am making again this Sunday for a BBQ we are having. I thought my husband would be sick of it by now, but he actually requested it. Oh, and it was super EASY! Thanks so much!
This recipe is great. I made these for a bridal shower and everyone was asking for the recipe. A Big Hit!!

I'm not quite sure what to rate this because I made many changes to the recipe, but I was very happy with the turn out.  Rather than using a salad dressing mix, I bought plain cream cheese and mixed it with oregano, cayenne pepper, garlic powder, pepper, and a bit of salt. The day of our party, I spread the cheese on plain white bread and added a few thin cucumber slices. I cut them into quarters and stuck a toothpick in each one. Great recipe for an appetizer or finger food.  Thanks!

I loved these cucumber sandwiches but made a few changes, I added the dill weed to the cream cheese and used regular bread and once I put the cream cheese filling added the cucumber then I placed a sprig of basil on top then sandwiched them. These were so simple to make and absolutely delicious!  I did take the advice of some other reviews and cut down on the amount of Italian seasoning.  Glad I did that...that stuff is potent! These were just ok.  I made them for an afternoon shower and I had a bunch left.  I did add a little seasoning salt to the top of them to spice it up and they were still just ok.

Yummy! I made these for a school function and everyone liked them. I was even asked for the recipe a couple of times. I made them exactly as they were  posted and they turned out perfect. Definately a keeper, thanks!

This is one of my top 2 recipes that I love.  I let it refrigerate overnight and it is perfect, everybody loves them.  Sometimes I do sprinkle lemon pepper seasoning on top but it is just as good without it too.  Thank you for the recipe.

This recipe was great.  My family loved it, even my 3 year old son.
