So, I used raspberry (pancake) syrup, I used half white vinegar and half balsamic and the olive oil. I added a big pinch of crushed oregano, a teaspoon of German mustard and finally, about a teaspoon and a half of honey. It was  very delicious.

i found this salad dressing years ago on the back of a crouton box and fell madly in love.
yummy!!!
Very very good, but a bit salty

tasty,fast...added garlic powder and some cumin just added milk to get the texture I like. Will make again.

I made about half this recipe and put in sour cream instead of mayo...then realized I should have put in mayo. So I added the mayo and a little more milk. I also added some salt and pepper. Plus the opaque color covered up some of the really random ingredients in my "whatever's leftover in the fridge" salad - which included lettuce, tomato, corn, kidney beans, avocado, scallion, cheddar cheese and croutons. No complaints - even from the onion haters!

I was out of ranch and any creamy style dressing... tried this instead. We loved it! My husband just kept raving about how great it was! We've had it for a week and it's still amazing! My borther loved it as well! Will definitely make again!

A bit too salty with Parmesan, mayonnaise and 2 ts of salt, had to doctor it far from original to get a  smooth blended flavor...  By the way, you had no time to thaw the yucky bottle salad dressing and invented a recipe that takes overnight to get ready...  absolutely puzzling!!!

I don't usually keep bottled salad dressing on hand, so I'm always glad to find a dressing that I can adjust to the amount I need. Didn't really measure as I was making this, but probably used more lemon juice and only added a very small amount of milk.  The other changes I made were to add some white sugar and freshly ground black pepper.

I thought this was delicious. Right after I made it,it tasted just like creamy italian. After refrigerating for 12 hours it had a wonderfully unusual flavor...the lemon flavor came out alot more. Very good. I didn't add the milk (hence the 4 stars instead of 5) and it was still good.
Great recipe,I may never go back to store bought dressing again.

Ease of recipe = FIVE stars!  Taste of recipe = FOUR stars!  I wish I could give this recipe a four and a half stars! Talk about life saver! Husband and I were making salads for dinner, only to find out we didn't have any dressing! DOH! This was easy, delicious, and satisfying! The lemon was great at cutting the richness that the mayo and parm added. Followed recipe to the letter EXCEPT used already grated parm from Costco. DELISH!
Such a great guide recipe!  Used mostlyplain yogurt instead of some of the mayo and dubliner cheese instead of parm, and fresh garlic.  Yum!! Can't wait for dinner!!
This would be good for cole slaw

This is a great starter recipe  to give you the feel for a basic salad dressing. You can build on it if you have an eye for sauces. I was out of salad dressing and had never made my own, but I'm a fairly competent saucier at home, so I modified the recipe thus (measurements are approximate): 2 tbsp mayo, 2 tsp lemon juice, 2 tsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp shredded cheddar/jack cheese, dollop of ketchup, 1 oz half-and-half,  bit of diced onion, 1 clove garlic finely chopped, some Jane's Mixed-Up Salt to taste, and a sprinkle of black pepper. These were all things I had on hand. I stirred the whole thing over low heat until the cheese melted, then set it in the fridge for 2 hours to let the flavors meld. In the end it felt like it could use a slight kick so I added the tiniest sprinkle of Creole seasoning. End result was FANTASTIC.
Yummy - alittle less milk is neccessary though to make it like normal dressing.  Substitutes: 3Tbl lemon juice and also 3 cloves of garlic.
The garlic salt was a little overpowering so I would decrease it next time.
Good, easy, quick!

I was so skeptical when I read this, but had all the ingredients on hand so gave it a try. Fantastic! It is now my go-to recipe for salad dressing. I usually add whatever fresh herbs I have on hand (dill, parsley, cilantro, etc). Love this recipe.

This was pretty fast and easy.  But the best thing about this recipe was the flavour.  Amazing!  I used lemon juice in a bottle and garlic from a can, but it still turned out wonderful.  I can only imagine what the real thing would taste like.
Too salty! Had to throw first batch out. Parm cheese is salty enough...do not add salt products. Add garlic powder or a clove of fresh instead of garlic salt.

I've been looking for a simple salad dressing and this is it. This may not be the most helpful review as I didn't follow the recipe to the letter, but rather, made a small portion for a single serving. Just looking and finding that I had everything on hand was great, and this is a great base to experiment with adding or substituting other ingredients.

this is amazing. it tastes like the dressing they use to make prawn coctail at restaurants. i only refrigerated this for 3 hours (just in time for lunch) and made it exactly as stated. may use a little less lemon juice next time, but again, this was fab. thanks loads for sharing! now i need never buy italian/salad dressing again!
I cut the recipe way down and guesstimated amounts. I also took the unforgivable step of using the "green bottle" Parmesan (not enough of the real stuff), and this was still awesome. Thank you.

This is a great salad dressing.  It's not necessary to chill it before, though it is much better after it is chilled.  I add 1/2 cup sour cream and cut the milk down some because I like my dressing thicker.  I also add some black pepper and cilantro.  It's fantastic and very easy.
Love this dressing...we make it over and over.  Watch the garlic salt as the recipe seems to call for alot.  We use garlic powder and shake in a bit of salt to taste.

Great Recipe! Simple, quick, and made from ingredients you usually have in your fridge. I followed the instructions and ingredients exactly, and it turned out just fine for my taste.  Maybe next time, I will try adding 1 teaspoon of anchovy paste, I think this might give the taste a little kick.

Took this to a friend's BBQ with a fresh green salad mix and it got rave reviews.  They even kept the leftovers.  The only change was to use a pressed garlic clove instead of the garlic salt, and I added just a little freshly ground pepper.  The flavor blend deepened wonderfully even after sitting only 2 hours.  Delicious keeper!
Absolutely delicious!  On cobb salad you can't beat this dressing.

I was literally out of salad dressing, and in a pinch, found this recipe.  Did not refrigerate for the 8 hours, and used immediately.  Initially, I did not care for it and thought would not make again.  However, the next day, this dressing tasted much better.

I actually think this is one of the best salad dressings I have had in a long time and we ate it right away I did not let it set.  I also added parsley and pepper and I put a lot less lemon in.  I also added a dollop of sour cream.  Anyway it was yummy!  I will try this again and set it overnight not that this needs any improving at all!

I made this dressing this morning for my hubby and after lunch he called me saying his office mates asked him to make it again. my hubby likes it very much. I made changes to the original given ingredients - I doubled the volume of parmesan and milk, I dont have garlic salt to what I used 1 glove of fresh garlic and mashed it then I added pinch of salt and pepper to taste. then I added sliced boiled on and left over pork chops sliced it and  make it as topping then im not satisfied yet I slice few leaves of green onion and it came out fantastic!!! I will make this again. thanks for posting. I attached the photo too for you to see :)
Hands down best dressing ever! I could use this on everything. It is so fresh. I made it as recipe dictated with the exception of the parmesan. I didn't have fresh, but still delicious.

Very easy and delicious.  I am not one to care about the health aspect as much as the taste aspect.  I added 1 Tbs.  sugar to sweeten this and it was amazing.  i even caught my Mom picking at the salad before dinner. :)

This recipes was delicious and soooo easy.  Everyone has these ingredients on hand!  My fiance helped himself to 2 helpings of salad the other night, which NEVER happens, just because he wanted more dressing.  It tastes like a creamy parmesan caesar - yum!
good stuff! Easy too. Thank you
WONDERFUL!!!  Be sure to use FRESH parmesan.  I mixed a little horseradish mayonnaise in with the plain, which gave a a bit more zip. Great over a simple lettuce and tomato salad!!
I followed this recipe exactly EXCEPT I used garlic POWDER instead of garlic salt.  It's a very good creamy dressing, comparable to what I've had as "Ceasar Dressing" in restaurants.  I'm keeping it!

Very good dressing, I used garlic powder instead of garlic salt and after reading the reviews I am glad I did, I figured it would be to salty. I added 1 teaspoon of salt.  I also used fat free milk because that is what we drink and what I had on hand. I let it sit all night and had it on my salad the next day, it was very good. This turned out great! i took others' advice and added a clove of garlic, minced finely along with some ground black pepper and a few dried parsley flakes. it kinda reminded  me of the base for the ranch dressing i use i make of outback steakhouse's recipe on topsecretrecipes.com. also didn't have parm. used pecorino. didn't really remind me of caesar as someone else suggested; was very creamy & mild. def a keeper!

Delicious and simple! I subbed lemon juice from a bottle for the juiced lemons (all about what you have on hand, right?) and did half garlic salt, half garlic powder to avoid the over saltiness people were warning of. This was pretty good!!  Thanks for sharing.  I did not have garlic salt so I used garlic power and added salt. Will use again.
My God, this is good.  I was forlorn -- no salad dressing, no sour cream, no buttermilk.  But I did have mayo and lemons!  And fresh dill, which I added, and it tasted super delicious!  Thanks.

When made as is, I think the flavor is a bit strong and is overall too thick, it was hard to stir into my salad. Still, I feel it was a good start, and with a few modifications could be a great creamy Caesar dressing.

This was the first homemade salad dressing I have made. It turned out very good. I used garlic powder instead of garlic salt and I didn't have freshly grated cheese, so I used  the dry parmesan I had on hand. I added some ground pepper and it was good to go. thanks

I've been using this recipe for a couple years now, and it's my family's favorite salad dressing.  I use key limes instead of lemon, and garlic instead of garlic salt. I've never been a salad fan, except for the occasional Ceasar salad.  But I've never been able to find a dressing that I liked enough to use at home.  Ceasar salads was something that I usually ate when I went out to eat.  But lately I've been eating nothing but salads with THIS dressing for about 3 days straight, every week!  I crave this dressing every week, and all these salads make me more, uhh, well, umm, you  know,..."regular". HA!  Thanks for sharing...

I was so impressed by this dressing.  Fast, easy and I had all the ingredients on hand.  Tasty and quick.  I make it frequently.  Thanks!

This is a lot like a simplified caesar salad dressing.  My husband liked it a lot, he even went back for seconds.  thanks!
great easy we stopped buying store bought.
WOW! I made this one night when I was 'out of salad dressing'.  Saw the title and knew it was for me :-)  I also added a Tb of whole grain mustard and some fresh ground pepper.  Wonderful!
lets just say that i will never buy salad dressing again.  This was awesome!
Yay! This is the best! Also good with a little lemon pepper and red wine vinegar added if you want to cut down on the mayo
Absolutely FANTASTIC !!!!  Didn't have any lemons but had limes instead...was GREAT !!!!!!

Great recipe to use when you don't have time to run to the store to buy more dressing!!  I didn't follow the measurements exactly, and used a lot less milk. This is a good base recipe to change amounts to suit your own tastes.
Very tasty!!  Kinda tastes like a casear dressing!

I love home made salad dressings; they are quick, easy and taste so good!  So much better than store bought preservative-tasting dressings!  This was really flavorful. This was very easy to make and yummy.  I added some parsley and a little extra lemon juice and sugar.  Absolutely make sure you let this set up for a couple of hours or it will be very runny.

I really can't understand negative reviews on this recipe unless the directions were not followed. I found this to be an excellent recipe, and served it to two persons who are both excellent cooks. They loved it. This is the kind of recipe I come to allrecipes.com to find.

Excellent Recipe - Used 1 tsp. Salt 1 tsp. Garlic Powder and added some dried chives and parsley.  This is the first salad dressing i've made that was actually pourable - my husband who is an oil and vinegar man tried it and now he uses it all the time.  Definitely a keeper and hit!! Thanks :-)
Very good. We added a few dashes of salt, pepper and red wine vinegar.

This was fairly tart made as written. I would recommend juicing half the amount of lemon and adding it to taste. As the size of a lemon can vary widely, the recipe might have been better served written with a volume amount rather than the vague "1.5 lemons". I also did not need to add any milk as it was quite runny to begin with. I suspected it would be quite salty with the garlic salt called for, so I went with a sodium free garlic herb seasoning blend instead which turned out to be a good call.

Fantastic! It tastes like a cross between caesar and ranch dressing. Like other comments, reduce the milk by half for a creamier dressing. Add some cilantro, pepper, and a splash of chile powder for an extra kick!

I have been making this dressings for a long time, in facts my kids like it better than any bottled stuff.  My version is:  1cup mayo, 1 freshly squeed lemon, salt and pepper to taste, 1 clove of pressed fresh garlic.  Mix well, chill while you prepare the rest of your meal.  Toss and serve.

I've been making this for years with the addition of about 2 Tbls of olive oil.  It is known as creamy ceasar dressing.  Anchovies are optional. Add your romaine and croutons and bingo, ceasar salad!   Yes, everyone loves this!

Unlike other reviewers I found this dressing to have little taste. I added garlic powder instead of garlic salt. To make it taste better I added the prepackaged fresh bacon bits and more mayo. It became a thicker consistency and started to taste like something. Probably wouldn't make again though.
This is a great recipe, light and fresh!

Used miracle whip w olive oil. Made exactly as directed & it was pretty bland. Per reviewer suggestion I added blk pepper & parsley & it made a big difference. 4 stars with the changes. Thx 4 the recipe

LOVE this dressing made from scratch and home-made is always better than store-bought anyway.  You can easily modify this to your taste or available ingredients by substituting lime for lemon juice (as someone suggested), Romano for Parm cheese, Miracle Whip for mayo, etc.  I would add a few grinds of black pepper and maybe some fresh or dried herbs to vary it.
I don't like things too salty so I changed the garlic salt to 1 tsp and added a little garlic powder. It was great.  My wife had me separate some for her and add dill weed. Her's was great too.
Didn't like it.
This was fantastic!  Reminds me of the Creamy Parmesan dressing at one of our favorite restaurants!  Added garlic powder & fresh ground pepper...terrific!
Loved it! Didn't have lemon juice so just squeezed lemon concentrate to taste, worked great. Don't make if you don't like garlic though.

I used 1 whole lemon, 1/4 cup grated Parmesan, 1 tsp garlic salt, 1/4 cup light mayonnaise and 1/2 cup lowfat buttermilk. I also added a dash of pepper. I put it in a blender to combine the ingredients. This is basically for 8 servings @ 2 tablespoons per serving. 67 calories, 4 carbs, 5 grams fat, 3 protein per serving. Excellent combination of flavors. I like the "tang" that the lemon juice provides.

I loved this! I will never buy caesar dressing again. I just used the ingredients without really measuring and made an individual salad. I squeezed 1/2 lemon and used the zest, and used a splash of milk. I'll be making up a big batch and storing it. Great with romaine!

I found this after I searched the fridge in vain trying to find our ranch dressing and then realized all the stores in our town were closed. (My husband wanted a salad at 10:00.) Anyway, I made this really quick (and I mean quick). I kind of tweaked the ingredients. I didn't use lemons or Parmesan. Instead, I made it with Miracle Whip, garlic powder, and milk. My husband loved it! He even said it was better than ranch! Word of advice though, this dressing is potent. A little covers a lot! Thanks for the recipe! I will definitely make again.

Wow this is really yummy! I used low fat buttermilk instead of milk, fresh garlic and low fat mayo because of a restricted diet I am on. Yummo!  I think next time I will only add 1/4 c. parm. cheese to cut back the fat a bit more. De-lish!
So easy -- delicious! Thanks!

I thought this recipe was great - we didn't have fresh parmesan so I had to use pregrated and mix it with the dressing in a blender - next time I'll use freshly grated, I'm sure it will be even better.
very good. I used minced garlic (that comes in the little jars) instead of the garlic salt and I used lemon juice instead of fresh lemon. But worked great in a pinch. Will use again!
Great sald dressing.  The flavor was very refreshing and it tasted very natural.  This will be a regular dressing for me.
This very versatile and delicious recipe has inspired me! I'm saving lots of money making my own =0) Thank you for posting!
Now keep a jar in the fridge. I sometimes add sugar or pineapple juice to get the sweet freaks to eat salad. Good good stuff.
Loved it! Better than store-bought, I am going to make this all the time!
easy recipe to play with - use lots of garlic, and add whatever spices you have on hand - chives are great, dill, etx
I halfed the recipe.  I thought it was really good. :)

Just made this tonight and enjoyed it very much. I did make a few adjustments to suit my own tastes. I used the juice of just one lemon instead of one and a half. I used two teaspoons of minced garlic and one teaspoon of garlic powder. I added a few pinches of fresh ground pepper and a few dashes of cayenne pepper for a hint of heat. I didn't have the time to let it sit, but it was still very tasty. I stored the leftover and will use with another salad tomorrow.

This was really very easy to make and you can adjust the measurements and ingredients according to taste. I served this as a dip for buffalo wings. Gone in seconds! Will definitely be making again and again. Thanks for sharing.

I made this recipe the other day and it was great.  Reason: I didn't have garlic salt.  I used powdered garlic and then salted to taste.  I just made this recipe WITH garlic salt and it was way too salty and I had to through it out.  What a waste.  I had to give this one star if made per the recipe.

This is an easy recipe when looking for a creamy, yummy dressing!  I made a batch, ate it right away, and then stored it in the fridge overnight.  Today I added it to salad during lunch and the flavor was even richer.  This recipes gets 5 stars for being simple and delicious.
Great dressing!

Didn't have fresh lemons but used reconstituted lemon juice, used adobo instead of garlic salt, threw in some fresh chopped chives, used fresh cracked  black peppercorns worked great for my low carb diet. Is is delish!!
genius!!!!!!!! put it on everything!!!and everyone!!!

Excellent base for a creamy dressing.  You can add any kind of herbs/spice to this and make it your own.  I loved it.  I rarely buy dressing as it is, and I probably never will now that I have a recipe to work with.

I made this not 5 minutes ago and it's amazing!  Used low fat mayo, 1% milk, half the amount of garlic powder instead of garlic salt, then added salt and pepper to taste.  The finishing touch was about a teaspoon of Worcestershire sauce.  I agree with other reviewers who said it tastes similar to caesar dressing, which is my favorite.  We're having friends over for dinner tomorrow and I hope they like the dressing, too!

Yum!  Tasted a lot like a modified Ceasar dressing.  I did change from garlic salt to fresh garlic and added pepper, a bit of suger, parsley flakes, and worsteshire as other suggested.  Definately a go-to recipe!

Yum!  Just made it but made a few alterations.  Cut back on 1/2 cup of milk, 1/4 cup lemon juice and 1/4 cup vinegar, 1/2 cup feta, fresh chopped parsley, salt and pepper to taste.  Poured it right on Romain hearts with crumbled bacon and sliced hard boiled egg.  It was delicious!  I'm sure this could be tinkered to be a little less high cal...but a nice indulgence for the summer.
yummy

I found it wonderfull.  I only made halph b/c I read all reviews, but halph was all I needed cooking for two.  I added halph lemon and halph lime juice, I also added halph mayo and halph miracle whip.  I did add one tsp of garlic salt, and one garlic clove.  Dash of pepper.  It was not too salty.  I will definatly make it again.
Sorry - didnt like this. I had to doctor this up big time to even be able to use this, which turned into a bluecheese dressing.

For this recipe I used fresh garlic and parmesan from the spaghetti shaker. I just split everything in half for a smaller serving. On accident I forgot to add the milk, but it still turned out great and everyone loved it! I'll probably use this from now on because all the ingredients are simple and already in the fridge.

I made this recipe exactly as written, with only one small change. I didn't have enough Parmesan, so used a mix of Parm and Pecarino Ramano cheeses. I have to agree with some of the previous reviewers that garlic salt makes the dressing a bit too salty (and I am a big salt lover). Next time I wouuld use garlic powder instead of garlic salt. Otherwise, a very easy and tasty dressing.
This was very good and super easy.  I used light mayo and skim milk.  I didn't have enough parmesan cheese but it was still very good- the kids loved it and asked for more salad!

I enjoyed this as an alternative to th ones in the frig.  I loved it and the simplicity.  I scaled it down to four servings and only used a capful of lemon juice after reading other suggestions.  I will make it again.  I also only let it sit about an hour.  There was some left so I will try it for lunch again today.

This salad dressing is good and easy! I put it on my parent's 43rd wedding anniversary salad, served with grilled shrimp, & artichoke pie. Because of this awesome meal, they will probably be married another 43 years... so you know, that's all I'm saying...

WOW! thank you so much for posting this recipe! late this evening i realized i had run out of the "usual" ingredients which are used for many of my salad dressings (even the "staples" like balsamic and olive o.) and really wanted a salad! put in a search on allrecipes and found yours. how wonderful this is! i used garlic powder (don't buy garlic salt) and replaced the milk with buttermilk.  great stuff and will also use it on a wrap for lunch. dinah
Made this for company twice.  Raves everytime.  Served it over a simple sald of lettuce, cucumber slices, red onion, and grape tomatoes.  Now, when I have company, everyone expects it.

As suggested in the instructions, I substituted low-fat ingredients, including low-fat Parmesan cheese (not freshly grated though), 1% milk, and no-fat mayo.  In all fairness, let me be clear that my "2" rating is for the "low-fat" version.  The real McCoy may be wonderful, but the low-fat version is average, at best.  One reviewer said this tasted a bit like Caesar dressing.  I would agree with that.  I'm not an especially good fan of Caesar dressing either.  This recipe isn't horrible--just not one I would likely prepare again--unless I run out of other dressing, of course.

FANTASTIC!!!! Easy, quick, ingredients usually found anywhere at home - works perfectly to every kind of salad! --- Though, instead of garlic salt (I don't really love garlic) I used "herbs salt" ---- tried it with blue cheese and worked too! *****5 stars to the original*****

One of the best homemade salad dressings ever!  Tastes like a very mild Caesar and consists of ingredients that are readily on hand.  Will make this even if there is store-bought dressing in the fridge.

this is a great, imperceptible salad dressing, especially for salads that don’t need much spicing up, but i would suggest using buttermilk instead of normal milk and adding some pepper. i would also replace the garlic salt with just normal garlic, or just use less garlic salt because of the dominant salty taste the garlic salt has. Instead of using water to make the dressing thinner, I would suggest just adding olive oil or more buttermilk to prevent the dressing having a bland taste. I also think putting the dressing in the fridge for 8 hours is not obligatory, though it probably tastes better if you do so. Tarragon would also go great with this salad dressing.
try adding a little cracked pepper. Complements the flavor of the parmesan nicely.
This took 5 minutes and tasted fantastic.  I didn't make any changes and we all loved it!  I really enjoy simple recipes like this that can be made from scratch!
Very easy and good, but kind of boring. Probably won't make again.

This is wonderful!! I did make a few changes as I usually do no offense!I finely chopped about 1/4 cup onion added about a 1/2 cup sour cream to cut the mayo taste an to we prefer our dressing a bit thicker. also added about 1/4 tsp of Italian seasoning. This dressing is Delicious as written you can really make it your own! Its a great base recipe!!
This dressing is great!!!
I also sometimes use instead of the milk some red wine or balsamic vinegar.  Crush up a little dried oregano as well...great variations.  Good and tangy!
We loved it. I didn't have lemons so I used apple cidar vinegar. Also used half & half instead of milk. I will make this again.

this recipe as is excellent. I decided to add garlic powder, dried chives and dry parsley along with a generous amount of Sriracha sauce. Absolutely delicious I will be using this on my pasta salad as well. thanks for the fabulous recipe :-)

This is the perfect salad dressing, I used it for basic salads and for ceasar's salad and my son told me that it was the best ceasar's salad he ate. To cut out calories I used low fat mayonaise, skimmed milk and didn't use parmesan cheese as I didn't have any on hand, but still it was great. Thanks for a delicious and easy recipe.
I thought it was very good for a last minute dressing. I added pecans for a little extra crunch and a hint of sweetness.
I WAS REALLY LOOKING FOWARD TO THIS BECAUSE OF ALL THE GOOD REVIEWS..I ONLY ATE A FEW BITES OF MY SALAD...I WILL NEVER MAKE THIS AGAIN..WOULD MUCH RATHER HAVE BOTTLED DRESSING.

Great simple dressing, goes well with Ceasar's salad with slices of grilled chicken. Thumbs Up !

I thought this was very good and my husband thought it was delicious. I used half&half instead of milk and just a squirt of light mayonnaise. I think it would be better with milk (or half&half) and sour cream. Thanks for a quick and easy dressing recipe!

This was just ok in a pinch.  I thought it was too sour (too much lemon juice) and waaaay too salty.  Oh and it was also too thin and watery.  I probably won't make it again.  My daughter and I thought it tasted a lot like Caesar dressing and that wasn't the taste I was going for.  I was hoping it would be more like a creamy garlic dressing.

This is a great simple mayonnaise dressing for those times when you are out of dressing.  Overall it was a perfect base for what I needed last night.  I recommend adding the garlic & salt separately.  I also added vinegar, coarse black pepper, onion powder & cumin. I kept tasting my dressing until I got it right.
Great salad dressing. Also good with Romano cheese instead of Parmesan.

Great! I wasn't expecting it to be any good, but have been craving a creamy dressing. Used fresh garlic instead of powder, and used 1/2 & 1/2 instead of milk, with a dash of olive oil and pepper for extra flavor. A little thin but very tasty, like a super super simple Ceaser dressing! I love that there are so many options for adjustment and experimentation. Have plans to try adding anchovies to make it more Ceaser-y, or maybe olives and feta for a greek style, and there are so many possibilities. This was ok but nothing spactacular. If you decide to make do not add garlic salt use real garlic or garlic powder instead. This was very salty. Maybe a little lemon would also be a good touch.
I made this very simple delicious recipe for my daughters wedding reception.  Many people wanted the recipe.  Very wonderful!
A tasty yet great salad dressing! When I first saw this dressing I thought wow this looks good! I tried it and I was right this was great! Everyone should try this delicious recipe.
easy to substitute!!! tastes great (:

Great in a pinch!  I'm on a diet and used low fat ingredients, and it was still delicious... even my non-dieting boyfriend loved it.  I added a little pepper, and halved the mayo, using sour cream for the other half since I was low on mayo.  I don't know how it tastes using only mayo, but the way I did it was tasty!!!
Delicious! We really enjoyed this, and I didn't even have to buy anything. Next time I won't add the full amount of milk so it will be a little thicker.

What a wonderful last minute dressing!  I had dinner all ready to go, my salad made, and I looked in the fridge and found no dressing I could eat on my new low-carb diet, lol.  I made this in about 1 min. and it was perfect.  Thank you!  I think I will begin using this recipe a lot more instead of buying pre-made dressing.
Tastes okay. Not the best tasting salad dressing I've ever had, yet not the worst.
All the ingredients of something tasty, but I think the flavor depends a lot on the type or brand of mayonnaise you use.
Kristil, I was sure glad to find this recipe. I also cook for a fraternity.  This summer I am cooking for a camp.  I would sure like to talk to you!  Thanks for the recipe. Joan
Very good!  I still prefer the ones with ground oatmeal in them...

I made a half batch of this delicious cookie to take part of them on a “girl’s weekend” trip and to leave some home for my family.  Everyone loved the simple taste of this recipe.  I used white chocolate chips rather than semi-sweet chips because I simply like the taste of white better.  The cookie held up nicely and baked up crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside.  I used the small cookie scoop and 12 minutes worked perfect.  I got 64 cookies from a half batch.  They were a hit, and I will be using this recipe again.
Delicious, and simple.  A great recipe for when you need a lot of chocolate chip cookies quickly.  I usually add 1 Tablespoon of vanilla.

I've been looking for a new chocolate chip cookie recipe.  My boyfriend is in a frat and most my baked goods end up going to him and his brothers, so I decided to give this recipe simply because the name was too perfect for this situation.  This is now my go to chocolate chip recipe.  The texter is light and fluffy without being crumbly or too chewy.  LOVE!
Everybody raved about the taste of this cookie, but looks-wise, it was too flat for my taste.  Tasted great, though!  Thanks, Kristil!
Made these for a Football Team dinner. Best cookies ever!!!!  I used both white and milk chocolate chips and they were a huge hit. This recipe is a big keeper.

I can't tell you if the cookies were any good but the dough was FABULOUS!  (just kidding - the cookies - the few that we did cook - were great too)... this is not an ordinary chocolate chip cookie recipe.
This recipe is awesome.  My children loved them.  I use a 1 1/2 inch ice cream scoop and it made 8 dozen cookies.  I baked them for 14 minutes and they were perfect!
The best chocolate chip cookie recipe by far. My boyfriend absolutely loves them, the only ones he'll eat now. Thanks.
These are delicious, easy to make, and addicting! I made them with whole wheat flour and only baked for 12 minutes and they turned out wonderful!
Excellent recipe.  I made these one night with my kids and all the stirring and handling of little hands did not hurt this recipe at all.  Very easy and very good.
Quick and easy, can't beat a deal like that!!
I did not care for this recipe.
I thought this was okay, I used light vanilla yogurt but  next time I do not think I will  put in the peanut butter it takes the pumpkin taste away

I am drinking this right now.  The smoothest smoothie I've ever had.  I did not have Greek yogurt so I used plain vanilla and had to substitute the pumpkin pie spice with a bit of allspice.  I will make this again and again! Especially during pumpkin season! My 2 year old is currently stealing sips from my straw now! Toddler and mama approved!
Too sweet and too rich. I do like like the idea of using zucchini thou. Will try it again with less sugar and less chocolate.

Love, love, love this! I didn't have any cocoa powder, so I used 3 bite size pieces of Dove chocolate, 1/4 agave nectar instead of sugar, and used vanilla flavored coconut milk instead of half and half. I also used 1 T of peanut butter since I had no peanuts. These flavors together are great!

My son, who is very picky about food, asked for seconds!  I was thrilled that he was getting some zucchini and the added benefits from the banana + peanut butter (instead of nuts) + milk made me feel good that he was getting something good to drink.  Only change I will make next time is not to add all the sugar or sub some honey in it's place.  My sister made this for her boys after I told her of this zuchinni smoothie recipe and, voila! they drank it down too!  Thanks for the recipe, glad I didn't knock it before I tried it!

Great recipe I did omit the sugar and used 2 T of honey instead.  Also used 2 T of peanut butter and 2 percent milk added 1/2 c more than recipe only because I like mine a little thinner!  Thanks for the great recipe:)

What a treat!  I substituted 2 T honey for the sugar and used 1% milk.  Just used zucchini out of the fridge (not frozen - didn't want to wait).  This was thick and delicious!! Thanks so much for the recipe 5THSISTER!!

OMG!!!!!!!!!!!!!This was an awsome shake!!due to my kids diet needs I used 1/2 skim milk and 1/2 yougert in place of half and half. I also used 2 table spoons honey instead of sugar. what a great way to bring in veggies into a treat! Ill make this often!!
this got mixed reviews in my household, but I liked it! I wanted something chocolatey and this hit the spot! I might try it next time with less peanuts...

Mmmmm. I am enjoying this right now. I used unsweetened chocolate almond milk and chocolate sugar free torani instead of the half and half, sugar and cocoa. Really good. Really yummy and super easy.... and my kids LOVED it.  I used peanut butter and hot fudge sauce though, but omitted the sugar.  I also thinned it a bit with milk. Definitely a regular.
Just made these for snack for my 3 kiddos. Of course I failed to mention that there was zucchini in it.  BIG HIT!  Thanks for the great recipe!

This is so good it's crazy.  I used peanut butter instead of peanuts and skim milk instead of half and half.  Everyone in my family loved it and nobody could believe the secret ingredient was zucchini- you can't taste it at all!  I didn't peel mine because the skin is where most of the nutrients are, but doing so would result in a smoother texture, if that's what you're after.  Thanks for the great recipe, 5thsister!

we were happily surprised. light and refreshing. not your same old, same old shake. we did use milk instead of half and half and decreased the sugar  to 3 Tablespoons and used peanut butter instead of peanuts but it still turned out wonderful

Okay, I'll have to admit that I was skeptical, and that I decided to try this just to pull one over on my kids.  But, I have to admit, this was REALLY good.  It tastes like a banana split milkshake, but it gave me a chance to increase the veggie servings that they eat.  I'll definitely do this again since I can't seem to keep ice cream in the house!
Delicious healthy treat! instead of half and half i used some yogurt and soy milk and put in a little less sugar. it was still sweet and creamy.
I didn't care for this.  I love chocolate, but not in this smoothie.  Weird tasting combo for me, however my 6 year old loved it.  I prefer the other zucchini smoothie recipe on allrecipes.

I thought this was very tasty!  Like others, I used peanut butter instead of peanuts, milk instead of half & half, and honey instead of sugar (it only needed 1/3 cup, maybe even less).  Very creamy and delicious with NO zucchini taste.  2 out of 3 kids liked it, but the one who didn't just isn't a sweets person.  I'll make this again.

This is great! This is better than a chocolate milkshake. Didn't have any peanuts so used about 2 tablespoons peanut butter. Used whole milk in place of half & half. I have made this 2 times now. Both times I subbed the peanuts for walnuts and the half and half for almond milk. I like that it incorporates a vegetable. I found this a tad on the sweet side, but I love the zucchini chocolate banana combo. Next time I'll just add a little less sugar. I confess, I used a blob of peanut butter in stead of nuts! I had high hopes for this as a way to get veggies past my son's lips... he didn't like it. But now that I think about it, I think it was because its really cold... he's not much of an ice cream boy. Interesting, decent milkshake.  Does not keep, so serve immediately.
I made this, too, but used FF evaporated milk instead of half and half. I also used PB and a little honey instead of sugar. It was truly delicious and so happy it has such a nutritional punch!

I made this for my boys back when 5thsister posted it on "the exchange". They loved it, had no idea there was any zucchini in it at all. I used Peanut Butter and Co's Bees Knees peanut butter and FF half-n-half. I'll make this again often.
Love this recipe! Replaced sugar with agave syrup, used cashews for peanuts, and used 1 cup of soymilk instead of half and half. Turned out awesome and super healthy!

Awesome - I modified the recipe - to just the zucchini, banana, a splash of soy milk and a scoop of chocolate protein powder. Yummy!  Definitely peel your zucchini for this recipe! And use it still partly frozen.

I made a few changes though... My zucchini was freshly grated and unfrozen, instead of peanuts used peanut butter (I guesstimate about two-ish giant heaping tablespoons- probably too much since the hubby-to-be said the peanut butter flavour was too strong), two-three heaping teaspoons of sugar instead of the half cup and 2% milk instead of half & half. It came out very creamy and peanut-y this way, without being overly sweet. I left the skin on the zucchini when grating it as that's where most of the nutrients are and the tiny green flecks look nice in the milkshake. It was good, but did end up upsetting my stomach. This is one of those things that you like or don't, there's no in-between!

I prefer the texture best when the zucchini and banana are NOT frozen. Instead, I'll add them fresh from the garden with several ice cubes to create a more smoothie like texture. As is this will result in a thick malt like texture. Loved the flavor!!!

This is the first time I am reviewing a recipe because I wanted to wait until I encountered something truly fabulous!  This recipe was fantastic!  Simply knowing that zucchini can be frozen in shredded form is life-changing for me.  I have about eight zucchinis to use right now and at least four of them are going to go in the freezer as shredded form to be added to smoothies. Also, we used 2% milk and it tasted fantastic so don't be afraid to tweak.

Thanks for a great and creative recipe!

A wonderful smoothie. I grated my zucchini and then frozen it in ice cube trays which made it so easy to add to the smoothie. I also lightened this up by using 1% milk in place of the half and half and 2 tablespoons of confectioner's sugar in place of the granulated. This is fabulous!  I used fat-free half and half and natural peanut butter instead of the peanuts, and probably reduced the sugar by about half, but I didn't quite measure it out. delicious

THIS was AMAZING! ALL my BFFS loved THE mixture THEY thought IT was SOOO good!

I'm 5thsister's daughter, and both my younger brother and I love this recipe! We were a bit hesitant to try it at first (but in this house, you have to at least try), but quickly finished it and made her promise to make it again.
Delicious. Divine.  Great way to use the summer bounty of zucchini.  It processes faster if you chop up the frozen lump of zucchini and pre-chopped the bananas before freezing.

MMMMMMM, SO GOOD! I was looking for something 'milkshake-y' for dessert tonight for me and the little guy, and since zucchini are rampant right now, I thought I'd give this a try. YUM, YUM, YUM! Excellent! I love the idea of adding zucchini to this smoothie. I made some changes for a healthier version: I omitted the sugar, used protein powder chocolate flavor instead of cocoa, soy milk instead of hanf an half and peanut butter. I will definitely make it again. Thanks!
Thank you for a WONDERFUL idea to add grated frozen zucchini to a milkshake!  My super picky 13-year old had no idea he was drinking a zucchini milkshake.
I was pleasantly surprised!  Very good!  It ends up pretty thick so I added a little more half and half. Perhaps regular milk would make it a little less thick.

After reading reviews I was positive this would be good--we LOVE Zucchini Brownies, so we gave it a go!  WOW!  We loved the taste and texture.  Thanks for sharing this wonderful treat.  Next time, we plan on making a quadruple batch to put in an ice cream bucket in the freezer.

This was great!  I didn't have peanuts so omitted them, and only used 3 tablespoons of sugar.  I also added some milk to make it a bit easier to pour.  My family really liked it and found it rather creative - thanks!

I'm giving this a 3 as of right now because I haven't tasted it yet, but this did not fit a 9 inch pie pan. Once I realized it, it was too little too late. It still looks amazing, and I can't wait to dig in!

This is a wonderfully amazing pie!  A happy medium between pecan pie and pumpkin pie. Did not make the spiced whipping cream, but did use a little cool whip.  Everyone in my family that tried it loved it.  Especially great warm.
good stuff try it if ya like pecons k
My favorite dessert to make!  If you luuuuuuuv pecans like I do, add a little more than the recipe suggests. Heavenly!!!
I followed your recipe exact and the avocado didn't brown up and really felt this recipe needs some work.
I didn't use the taco sauce, which was a mistake. The idea of these tacos sounds great, but they were pretty bland.

OH YUM! First I have to say that I am absolute fan of the avocado being cook this way. It was soooo good that I could've just eaten it like that w/ a dipping sauce, lol. Ok, back to the taco...this was a last minute decision for lunch today to use up some avocados, so I had to go with what I had on hand. I didn't have any corn tortillas, and personally they are not my fave, so I used a WW flour tortilla. Also, I had no cabbage, so I just used lettuce and chopped up a regular tomato. I served it w/ a side of sour cream and taco sauce, which I think is a must! I will def be making these over and over~YUM! Thanks for sharing. :)

The idea is amazing, but mine just didn't hold. I am new to cooking so I may have messed this up, but the coating was just bland and clumpy and didn't brown. However, I changed the toppings and used fresh cilantro, limes, tomatoes, onions, pineapple, lettuce and a bit of tzatziki, sour cream, and salsa topped with cheese. After all of that I put it in my sandwich press and had a crispy unique flavored taco!
Loved the baked avocado idea, but as a whole, these didn't make the favorites list.

I made this today with lite coconut milk and almond butter. My banana was very ripe yet we (my husband and I) felt that the bitterness of the unsweetened chocolate was too strong and we had to add more agave to sweeten it up. We hardly ever add any kind of sweeteners to smoothies and shakes because we like to get all the sweetness from the fruit(s) we use. Because of the unsweetened chocolate, we had to up the sweetener quite a bit. Otherwise, it was good.
this is absolutely wonderful!  I forgot the peanut butter, but still great!  Will definitely help me give up ice cream.

I wanted more than a banana for breakfast and I knew I had coconut milk so entered them into the "ingredients" option. This recipe came up. I'm lactose and gluten intolerant so it was perfect. I used almond butter and honey., adding an egg white for extra protein.simple &  great recipe! Thanks!!
I made this with Almond Milk, no banana, Chaco Nips, Agave Syrup, and P. Butter, I use Smart Balance PB, as it is gluten free and Ice.  Delicious!
I followed the recipe to the letter, and it was so yummy. I will definitely be making this, again!

I used one packet Truvia instead of the agave syrup only because I don't have that on hand. I also used a frozen banana instead of using ice in this "shake". Dude. This was SO good. I definitely wanted more peanut butter flavor, I'll double it next time. And there will be a next time.

I made this (while it was blizzarding outside...?) and loved it!  
I made a few modifications however: I used almond milk (unsweetened), and put 1 Tbsp. cocoa powder in + 1 Tbsp. hot chocolate mix.  I loved the texture and flavour.  A great drink for a hot day... or a cold one, in my case.  :- )
We added some egg white (I sneak protein in for my picky eaters), but aside from that small alteration, as is - this was an awesome treat for the afternoon.
I wouldn't call this a milkshake, but it was a nice, healthy substitute.  I also added a little more agave, which made it taste less bland to me.
I made this recipe and think it's good. I think it helps to use 1 1/2 FROZEN bananas , double the peanut butter and at least 3 ice cubes. Makes a lovely thick shake.  Delicious!

This kind of reminded me of a peanut butter chocolate icy. I followed the recipe, the best I could, but made a couple of changes. I used a frozen banana, because it was what I had. I try to watch cholesterol, so I did 2 Tblsp. of coconut cream and the rest in sweetended vanilla soy milk. For a thicker drink, use a frozen banana and not so much liquid. I have made similar drinks in the past, kind of like this, that are chocolate and dairy free. The added protein and fiber is always good thing.
I love this so much! I want it all for myself!
Wow! Delicious. I made this to serve as a topping for enchiladas. It's going to be perfect

Absolutely delicious blend of all flavors I love! I dipped every vegetable I had in house and when I ran out of veggies I couldn't help but eat a couple spoonfuls on its own. This is a very good dressing that uses healthy fats.  I tasted the dressing before adding the cumin, and loved it, but did not care for the cumin after adding it.  I think it's a 4 1/2 with the cumin, and a 5 star without the cumin.  But that is just my preference;try it both ways and decide for yourself.  Thank you for sharing!

Otherwise, I followed the recipe as shown.  Very tasty.  I will definitely make this again.

This was a fantastic salad dressing.  When I went to get my avocado, it had gone bad, so I substituted mayonnaise.  We all loved it.  I can just imagine how much better it would be with the avocado.  Thanks, jesnmeg.

Wow!  This is an amazing dressing/dip!  The flavors are super together.  I made a double batch because my jalapeno was large and I am glad I did.  Will definitely make this over and over.  Thanks for the great recipe!
Delicious! The kids and I have been dipping everything in it, lol...Keeper! Thanks for sharing. :)
Great as a salad dressing, a dip, or a sandwich spread!  I thinned mine a bit with Grapeseed oil, but otherwise stayed with the recipe.
Fattening & delicious!  It hardened just like the store bought stuff.  My kids loved it!

This is much better than the ice-cream shop's shell sauce!  It is a favorite of my son's (and mine!) and he'll eat any ice cream with this sauce on it.

OMG - LOVE IT! I always loved magic shell but it's full of hydrogenated fats.  Obviously this is not a health food but I feel more comfortable with using plain, wholesome butter - and besides, it's to die for.  Thank you so much for the recipe!

Quick and easy, using simple ingredients you probably already have at home. Works just as well as Hershey's/Smuckers Shells, but it's significantly healthier relative to the chocolate sauce group (hashtag team butter). So easy - so good! I added a capful of peppermint extract to make it a chocolate peppermint sauce. Poured it over a banana sliced vertically and some ice cream for a wonderful peppermint chocolate banana split!

Perfect for ice cream sundaes!

A local ice cream stand used to serve chocolate dipped ice cream with a topping that hardened but was softer and more flavorful than what most places use. I wish I'd thought to make this sooner--cheaper and more convenient than going out. Now that I can make this any time I want it, my figure may never be the same again...

So easy and fast to make with stuff you already have in the pantry!  I was looking for a quick chocolate sauce to go with our vanilla icecream for our dessert tonight and didnt want to run to the store.  This was the only recipe on the site that I had the ingrediants for! It was a bit thick as others have said, but it all just depends on what you want to use it for.  I did thin ours out just a bit with a tablespoon or so of milk.  It's a keeper!
This was awesome!!  I wasn't expecting much, but it is really good!!  Never again will I buy the Magic Shell!!
Easy, quick, tastes great.

I think I might try using 1/3c milk and 1/3 semi sweet next time. The consistency is more like a ganache than like the crackle shell. It does not get quite as hard, but overall this recipe tastes very good over ice cream and I could see it having many other applications to come in my kitchen.
just what the children were looking for

Excellent recipe, thank you for sharing!  I added a bit of milk to thin out the sauce.  It was delicious with ice cream.  I have also drizzled the shell sauce over home made coffee cheesecake and it was delicious.  Yummy!
Although it is a bit thick, the flavor is fabulous!  Much better than the storebought kind.  I might try thinning it with a bit of milk next time.

Super easy! I added a tablespoon or two of light brown sugar just to sweeten a bit more. I then heavily drizzle it over some biscotti I made out of a couple of day old pound cakes I had left over. It was a hit with the family.
Quick and easy!  Loved it.
So good! Perfect for my cake pops. I added a little corn syrup for shine ;)
This is absolutely divine and it couldn't be any easier!  Thank you for sharing this recipe!

Yummm....frozen, chocolate covered bananas!!!  I'm off to the kitchen now....

Worked like a charm - use this recipe all the time
I made this to go on my flourless chocolate cake (from this site) and ice cream and strawberries. It is very good, and sooo easy. Way better than the bottle stuff.
I drizzled this over a frozen " Chocolate Eclair Cake" from this website. Really good!
Why buy it at the grocery store when it's this easy to make from ingredients that I always have on hand?

This was really good,  I used a blend of semi-sweet, dark, and white chocolate chips since thats what I had on hand.  Only problem is it was a little thicker then I would have liked and I ate way too much.
Very good sauce. I added a tablespoon of brewed coffee to help thin. I like it with the sauce with the coffee in it better!
It's a very easy recipe and works well when you need chocolate sauce in a snap without lots of ingredients. Overall, it tastes okay.

I took it out and stirred in the milk added the  sea salt, it was perfect!! I used it to make chocolate covered ice cream cones where I used the sauce to coat the ice cream portion of the cone. *Priceless Hint: Pistachio ice cream covered in chocolate shell = la petite mort. I was going to add pics but sadly the cones did not make it.
Wow--so simple, but so good.  Why make more work, when this is so easy and delicious? Thanks for sharing, Leah.
I used milk chocolate chips[ it's what I had on hand]. I drizzled the sauce over 'Peanut Butter Sheet Cake' from this site. Wounderful.

This recipe was exactly what I needed to top a cheesecake- it was easy and came out tasting so good. I added about a tablespoon of milk to make it a bit thinner, like other commenters. Overall a really quick, easy recipe that is USEFUL and a must have for everyone's recipe box!
Delicious!!! My family loves it.
This was the perfect "sauce" for what I needed.  I made a bowling ball cake and iced it with the chocolate shell.  Easy to work with and way tastier than fondant.
Quick, Easy, and delicious! Save money, by not buying the shell sauce at the store! Great!
This recipe was perfect if it's just about how quick and beautiful the chocolate looked when it hardened. Taste wise however, it was pretty bitter.
Perfect!  Couldn't be easier.

So good and so simple.  A hit with the kids!
How delicious and cheap this is to make.  I don't think I will buy magic shell again.
This turned out perfect, it hardened just like the magic shell.  I poured this over a turtle cheesecake I made and it was beautiful. This was exactly what I was looking for.  Thanks

Easy, quick and exactly what my boys wanted for their ice cream.

I made a similar recipe but instead of evaporated milk the recipe calls for heavy whipping cream. I prefer that one over this one since it is creamier.
This was so super uper good! I LUV IT!! YUMMY IN MY TUMMY!!

I disagree that it tastes "just like" chocolate cheesecake, but it was still good. Bad. Bad, bad morning. I made this to feel better. I did cut it down to two servings and I added a tbsp. of instant coffee. This was nice. Thank you.

This is delicious! I liked it better thicker when I used only 1 cup of milk. (And it still wasn't very thick; you can easily sip it through a straw.) I think I'll definitely try this with non-fat cream cheese and with different types of ice cream sometime! Awesome!

No homemade whipped cream on hand, I used Cool Whip. I made no other changes. The kids told me that this was the best milkshake they'd ever had. They were still talking about how good it was this morning over breakfast.

Simple and tasty. My kids love to make and eat this.

Very good for my salmon loaf!

Excellent!!!!!
Very good! I added a pinch of sugar, but other than that it was very tasty!
This is awsome. I poach cod in this.

Too much Dijon for me (tangy).  I will try it again with less Dijon Mustard (and FRESH dill).  I actually ended up heating it up for a warm sauce with Salmon...added a splash of white wine and let it cook down a wee bit.  Thank you for submitting it.
very good---can be used as salad dressing if you add a bit more buttermilk to it!

Wonderful recipe, thanks for sharing.

this was great with salmon patties and easy.

This was AWESOME!!! I used more dill (1 tbsp)if not alittle more.  I chopped up 1/2 cucumber and added it.  WONDERFUL.

This is a really different and tasty sauce for fish.  I tried it with blackened tuna and it was great!

A delicious and complete breakfast. I did not add honey. Thank you for the recipe.
